reviews.author: Clareth Cañizales
reviews.text:
The facilities and the beach are excellent.

The beach service is spectacular, especially Antonia's. One hundred percent recommended. I would return a thousand times.

The service from Romeris and Franklin at the Sante restaurant was outstanding.

Equally outstanding was the service from Miguel and María at the Rum Bar.

Luis and Magda at the Sport Club also helped make the experience unforgettable.

Thank you to all the staff for providing us with the best service.

reviews.author: Fernando Martínez de Bedoya Jáudenes
reviews.text: Good hotel, excellent service. The food is average, what you'd expect from an all-inclusive resort. There are plenty of activities perfect for families with children. Special mention to Angela, who was always very attentive and helpful.

reviews.author: Giovanni Pierantozzi
reviews.text: Antonia, excellent!!! Thank you so much for your service and attention.

reviews.author: Camila Anaya Romero
reviews.text: Ramón's service on the beach was excellent, always attentive and very friendly.

reviews.author: Gael Anaya
reviews.text: Ramón on the beach is excellent, the best in this place, friendly and very attentive, he deserves a raise

reviews.author: Maria Jose Olvera Torres
reviews.text: Ramón at the beach is the best of all, very attentive and the best service. The best vacation ever thanks to Ramón!

reviews.author: Salavador Anaya
reviews.text: Ramoncito provides excellent service and attention; highly recommended. Ramoncito makes vacations spectacular.

reviews.author: Elysian Meadows LLC
reviews.text: Just got back from a lovely 6 day trip to Paradisus Palma with our family.  The resort is beautiful, the staff is helpful and courteous, and the weather was great.  We loved our suite.  It is a very expansive resort that does require a lot of walking to get to and from your room to the pool, beach, and restaurants etc.  The food was not really good for the first few days… we couldn’t really find anything we loved, though we did finally enjoy good meals towards the end of our trip (Blue Agave, the hibachi restaurant, and Flora were our favorites).  A few days they had really delicious hot buffets out by the pool with tacos, burritos, and nachos— truly delicious! The lunchbox buffet was pretty good overall and our teens were obsessed with stopping there multiple times a day. Our biggest struggle was finding good cocktails, oddly enough.  Most of the bars only have basement bottom of bottom shelf liquors and it really made for some terrible drinks.  We hunted around and found some bars that had better liquors and just had to be choosy with what we ordered.  They do not have fancy, craft cocktails and we never actually found a bartender that could make anything craft cocktail like.  We ended up sticking with safe bets like mimosas, beer, wine, and pina coladas. Admittedly, we are definitely picky and have high standards when it comes to cocktails.  The pool and beach are absolutely beautiful and the service great— we had a cabana out at the beach for several days with Angelo as our server.  He was fabulous, so attentive and very helpful. Great experience! Our server at the pool was Rosanna, who I absolutely loved.  She was so pleasant, sweet, and attentive… total gem! The resort had very good entertainment in the evening (and throughout the day poolside) and it was enjoyable to watch. Lots of talented musicians and singers…. Great opportunity to salsa! Overall, it was a beautiful experience that we all enjoyed very much. Biggest thank yous to Angelo and Rosanna for their help and care all week long— they both made our trip even more memorable!

reviews.author: Chava Ferrer
reviews.text:
The beach is paradisiac!!
The service to highlight of:
Antonia
Junior
Barnelis
Mary
Basilio
And especially Laura

reviews.author: Alejandro Iturbide Morales
reviews.text: Antonia Fernanda, Junior, and María from Circle provided excellent service. They were super nice and their service was amazing!

reviews.author: Marisol SOLIS HERNANDEZ
reviews.text: Yafreisy Soler's service was wonderful during our breakfasts during our stay. The food was delicious, and the hotel in general provided a peaceful environment for relaxation. The beach is the best. We will definitely return. Thank you from Mexico.

reviews.author: Felipe Espinoza
reviews.text:
Highly recommended. You'll have a unique experience. Everyone goes out of their way to make your stay comfortable and enjoyable. The staff is very friendly and helpful.

The hotel's infrastructure is excellent. The pool and beach are very clean. Everything is very well-equipped. Plenty of lounge chairs at both the pool and beach.
The rooms are spacious and comfortable.
The food is varied and delicious. They have a very extensive menu, as they have several themed restaurants.
The buffet could improve the table service.
The bars have a wide selection of good quality drinks and liquors.
Everything was beautiful, and the staff's effort to ensure you had an amazing vacation was evident. It's a place we would definitely return to.

reviews.author: laura gutierrez linero
reviews.text: Excellent experience thanks to Ericson, the best bartender at the Paradisus Palma Real. His service was friendly and professional, but the best thing, without a doubt, is that he makes the best margaritas in the hotel!

reviews.author: tatiana gomez
reviews.text:
Excellent service!
They take care of the children with so much love.

reviews.author: Thomas Garza
reviews.text:
Pools-awesome,  restaurants-meh,  buffet-ok, beach-outstanding service was good as long as you tipped. For excursions,  if you don't go to the first person you talk to, They get mad and blow up your phone.  Waiters and waitresses- every nice. The grounds were beautiful
Shows we're also good.

reviews.author: Melissa Smith
reviews.text:
Top notch service for an all-inclusive resort! The people they have working are excellent. They are very attentive and remember you from day to day. The beach and ocean are gorgeous. I love the adults only section, though some kids definitely trickled in and it dampened some of the experience....

The food in some of the restaurants is excellent, I would definitely talk to the customers and ask where they have had good meals! It makes all the difference!

I would definitely stay again and doing the adults only section is definitely worth it! Especially if you are looking for a break from kids, but wanting to stay on this side of Punta Cana.

(4 star for the room because they didn't always clean it fully when I asked. But otherwise the room was amazing!)

reviews.author: Neil Rippey
reviews.text: Rafael, Gilberto, Raul and Pedro were awesome! Made the beach experience great everyday! Can’t wait to come back and hang out with these guys! Much appreciated fellas and job well done!

reviews.author: Tray Lavo
reviews.text: Absolutely loved this hotel. Grounds are beautiful

reviews.author: Denise Riopel
reviews.text: A special thank you to Reynaldo from Nespresso for his warm welcome and delicious lattes every day! Muchos gracias!

reviews.author: Christian Cummings
reviews.text: Go see Luis at the Ginger bar! Great service and great drinks!! Yeimi was great too! Awesome team!

reviews.author: Ash Rafipour
reviews.text:
Cliff’s Notes: good amenities and grounds, terrible service, worse food, go book at Secrets instead. Thousands of fake reviews - servers will ask you to write a review and mention their name, not sure if there is an incentive, but after the third time it gets tiresome. Wonder how many are real reviews..

If I could rate this resort lower than 1 star, I would. The only good thing about it is really the layout, the main courtyard, and the beach.

Everything else is comically bad or outdated. Let’s go down the list…

1. The food is bar-none, the absolute worst food I have ever had the (dis)pleasure of eating. You can only make reservations same day, and only one restaurant per day..

The steak house (Mina) AT BEST is below average. Thin cuts, poor quality beef, impossibly tiny sides and appetizers (one empanada about a third the size of a pizza pocket, really???). Terrible wine selection unless you’re paying hundreds out of pocket. Service is sub-par, waited 45 minutes for my drink after reminding the server twice and he finally brings out two for some reason, with my dessert no less.

The lunch buffet is stale, bland food. The fruit has no flavour, meat is overcooked, but again… the service is below average at best. I sat there with my plate of food for 15 minutes before I got offered a coffee or a setting and utensils, had to go grab it off the cart myself.

Flora was okay for appetizers, but we waited 52 minutes (I counted) before we gave up and left since our main courses hadn’t arrived yet.

2. Service quality generally speaking isn’t great. I went to the front desk twice in an hour to request an ironing board (never arrived), and I had to go all the way there because the phone in the room doesn’t work…

The one highlight is the Cabana service, but then again we’re tipping $5 USD every interaction so it makes sense they’re constantly hovering around.

I think another review summed it up great: it’s an “I guess I can eat that” property, not a “I want to eat that” property.

3. Rooms are outdated. Almost no clothes hangers, terrible room service (sensing a pattern with the food?), air conditioning cools the room but just keeps things moist. Seemed like they need to drain the water. No garbage can in the room outside of the toilet room, so you’re constantly running back and forth.

In summary, spend your money elsewhere.

reviews.author: Nikki Mackenzie
reviews.text: Absolutely loved our stay here and special thanks to Arisleda at the pool bar she went above and beyond to take care of us. We will be back! Nikki, James, Edyta and Abby from Ontario Canada

reviews.author: Bobby Adam
reviews.text: Aris & alberto are the best bartenders at this resort!!! They go above and beyond for all the guests! Would go back here!!

reviews.author: Domingo Martinez
reviews.text:
At The Reserve, we arrived at 3 PM, checked in, and only at 7 PM, after searching several times for the concierge who never showed up, were we given our room. They gave us various explanations for the four-hour wait and the loss of our first day of vacation. The reality was that the room had a late checkout, meaning it had been booked twice. During our three-night stay, the concierge could only find us a restaurant for dinner at 6 PM, even though we had lunch at 3 PM! The 7 PM and 8 PM seatings were never even half full, but they claimed there was no space.
On our departure day, we flew at 8 AM, so we were leaving the hotel at 4 AM. The day before, the concierge had promised to order breakfast in our room, but the night before, we were informed by the lobby staff that they were full and asked if we could have a coffee in front of the lobby. At 3:00 AM, after calling three times to request luggage transfer, we went to breakfast only to find out the bar hasn't been open at night for six months, and there's no other bar in the hotel open at that hour. We left fasting and as bitter as the first day they made us waste our trip by not giving us a room. We've been traveling to Punta Cana with our children for 25 years, but this year, as we celebrate our 50th wedding anniversary, we decided to travel alone and change hotels. I wouldn't recommend this hotel to my worst enemy. Zero points for administrative service!

reviews.author: VIP Vichitra Indian Production
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at this resort. The pool area was beautiful, clean, and very well maintained — perfect for relaxing throughout the day. The beach was equally impressive, with soft sand and stunning water that made every moment feel like a true vacation.

What truly made the experience special was the welcoming and friendly hotel team. Every staff member we interacted with was professional, attentive, and genuinely cared about making our stay comfortable and enjoyable. Their warm hospitality created a very positive atmosphere.

Overall, this resort offers the perfect combination of a great pool, a gorgeous beach, and excellent service. We would definitely love to return and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a relaxing and memorable getaway.

reviews.author: Ryan Taft
reviews.text:
Staff friendliness was at the bottom end of acceptable, but did not meet my expectations at all. English ability enough to get by but difficult too often for me. Food was ok, rooms were very nice. Trash in bushes. Pool bar had 1x3' chunk of the top broken off with a giant rusty chunk of steel sticking out (right where people get in and out, very dangerous). We were there 5 days, it never got covered/roped off/fixed, nothing. The broken chunk was laying in the bushes behind the nearby bathroom. Solicitors on the beach very aggressive. One of them FREAKED OUT when I told him to leave us alone, started cursing at top of his lungs and even took steps towards me. For a few seconds we thought he was going to attack us. Totally ruined the beach for us. On checkout we told the staff that an overgrown palm tree was completely blocking the view from our balcony and suggested trimming it slightly. The staff did not thank me for letting them know, didn't care, and I'm positive that tree is not getting trimmed.

Comparing to prior experience in Mexico, I was disappointed and would not go back.

reviews.author: Maria Paz Diaz de Vivar
reviews.text: Fantastic time and especially the beach guys like Angelo, Johan and Ramón, impeccable service

reviews.author: Myriam Duchaine
reviews.text:
A very pleasant stay, meeting my expectations for the basic package (adults only, garden view). Good food. The activities (workshops and evening show) were of SUPERIOR QUALITY. The room was very comfortable (bed and air conditioning). Dedicated staff.

POINTS FOR IMPROVEMENT: The hotel's paper and electronic menus are difficult to read (too small), and the distinction between the "reserved" and "standard" sections is confusing. Aside from the scheduled activities and evening shows, there is no entertainment at all (like staff dancing with guests). For the first five days, the food was varied and gourmet at the buffet, but afterwards, there was less variety and it was less interesting. The same goes for the Italian restaurant: the first time was extraordinary, and the second time was disappointing. During the Japanese restaurant's show, we "chased" a cockroach right in front of us, on the chef's work surface...

reviews.author: Luke M
reviews.text: Kicks bar is an amazing place with amazing service definitely one of the best bars in the resort bar tenders are amazing the superior is friendly I would come again

reviews.author: Georgina Espinoza
reviews.text: The place lives up to its name; it's exactly what you'd expect Paradise to be, with extraordinary natural beauty, all needs met, and a charming and efficient staff, especially the Mini Cooper Dance Instructor and Miss Dana.

reviews.author: Efrain Puerta
reviews.text: Awesome staff

reviews.author: A B
reviews.text:
In addition to the doors and walls being super thin, I am unable to fall asleep tonight because they are blasting loud music in the lobby at 10:50 PM and the sound can be heard in our room. I can’t believe quiet hours have not begun at 10:00 PM or invest in better sound proofing so those of us who want to sleep in our hotel rooms at a reasonable hour can do so apart from late night parties.

Also I have called twice and requested an ironing board be sent to our room and no one has delivered it.

reviews.author: Tyler Day
reviews.text: Amazing resort with fantastic food, service, beach, rooms and more. This was our second Paradisus trip (first in the DR) and I couldn’t recommend more! Milquella was particularly great.

reviews.author: Estrella Sagarzazu
reviews.text:
Excellent service ant the coffee shop.  Alexandra is a great worker, friendly and always with a smile.

Chef Carlos Cruz gave us the opportunity to taste pastelón dominicano. He brought it to our table of 20 and personally walked us through how it’s prepared, making the experience even more special.

reviews.author: Lucy Bourne
reviews.text: Cheff Carlos Cruz went out of his way to treat us with an outstanding Dominican PASTELON... this was excellent... something to come back for....

reviews.author: Justin Drake
reviews.text: Rooms are very clean and spectacular . Kicks sports bar has an amazing staff that treats you like they have always known you. Great cocktails from the wonderful bartenders and the manager Luis goes above and beyond.

reviews.author: Martin Harris
reviews.text: Amazing resort, especially with the Reserve upgrade. Good service, especially at the beach - thanks for taking such good care of us Rafael!

reviews.author: Bryan Buitrago
reviews.text:
Our stay at Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana was simply spectacular. From the moment we arrived, everything exceeded our expectations.

We went as a family, with my wife and our two children, and we had an amazing time. The resort is super fun for kids; they have a park called Fun Republic that is large and spectacular, which made our vacation even more special.

The service is top-notch: all the staff are extremely professional, attentive, and always willing to help. The view is incredible, the beach is beautiful, and the pools are perfectly maintained—a true paradise for relaxation.

The rooms are luxurious, spacious, and very clean, which made our experience even more comfortable. In addition, the buffet food was excellent, with a wide variety and delicious flavors every day.

We want to give a special thanks to Ángela, our concierge, for her attention and dedication, and to Junior, the waiter who served us at breakfast, always with a smile and impeccable service. We also want to thank absolutely all the staff: bellhops, servers, bartenders, concierges, housekeeping… everyone made our experience unforgettable!

It was definitely an amazing family experience. 100% recommended!

reviews.author: sam alborz
reviews.text: Don’t  look any further and just book it. We have been to many all-inclusive resorts around the world and these folks do everything just right!

reviews.author: Jamie Dejuras
reviews.text: Jose y Julia at 36 (circa de poscina) the service and drinks were great!

reviews.author: Orjan Zylali
reviews.text:
Hello everyone Elvis Laureano it’s the best he explained and he showed me a lot of things about resort inside and outside. Thank you Elvis

Reynaldo and Katherine from the cafeteria they  both the best very  good communication always  happy thank you guys

reviews.author: Richard Gomez
reviews.text: Multiple stays at this amazing resort. Definitely recommend. Have some awesome drinks at Kicks Sports Bar. Be careful with the mamajuana. It’s addictive. Ask for Diorgenis. One of a kind bartender

reviews.author: Gaby
reviews.text:
Excellent!
We went swimming. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Elesa Aurelio
reviews.text:
Dana is such a lovely and sweet girl. She has a talent for dancing. I loved her aqua fitness, Salsa, and the music & dance at night. Mini Cooper was a great instructor too!

Mostly, I enjoyed the excellent food at The Lunch Box Buffet and the Flora Restaurant for local cuisine. I had an excellent stay and will definitely be returning.

Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Jessica Dorregaray
reviews.text:
Saylis and Alexandra always greeted me with a big smile every time I came for my coffee.
They're amazing.

reviews.author: Marcela J.Bendana
reviews.text: Alexandra and Saylis were amazing in the coffee shop!

reviews.author: Tomas Arteaga
reviews.text: Excellent service, especially from the sports bar team. Many thanks to Diogenes and everyone else. They're truly an excellent team, with great food and drinks. They have fantastic chemistry and provide top-notch service. Congratulations to everyone for their hard work! See you next time!

reviews.author: Christopher Garcia
reviews.text: Saylis and Alexandra. At the coffee shop, they were the best, great service, and their charisma made them wonderful. Thank you, I'll be back soon. The best hotel in Palma Real.

reviews.author: Diegas
reviews.text: Thank you Nespresso Coffee Shop! Saylis and Alexandra were super friendly at the cafe. Thank you for your service. This is the best hotel in the Meliá Palma Real complex. Thank you so much, girls!

reviews.author: Vane M
reviews.text: The experience was wonderful . This hotel is 100% recommendable

We are into our full first day here of a seven night stay.  And I just had to write a review!
We are in room 9252.  Avoid this room.
I presume that when one books with Air Canada Vacations these are the garden view rooms you are assigned?
I have christened this room, "THE ROOM MELIA FORGOT!"
Room size:  Ample
Bed/pillows:  King bed and pillows are comfortable.  Though I travel with my own pillow. My husband confirms that the pillows are comfortable.
Bathroom:  The w/c is separate to the shower and bathtub.  The shower has decent water pressure.
THERE ARE NO HOOKS TO HANG YOUR TOWEL.  VERY ODD. WE ARE DRAPPING USED TOWELS ON THE BATHTUB.
THE BATHTUB IS JUST SHOVED NEXT TO A WINDOW.
Room amenities:  the TV is oddly placed.  It is attached to a post rising out of the floor.  The fridge does not cool the drinks.  It has been reported and "repaired." When it was "repaired" someone helped themselves to a beer!🤣 Payment? 🤣
There were four hangers in the room.  Yes, we received more after requesting them.  But at least 10 hangers should be a given.
The dresser is old and dated.   The wood has received several coats of white paint to make it look like new?
Restaurants:  We can only review, Flora.  It is the specialty restaurant offering Dominican dishes.  The food and service were good.  Give it a try.  Reservations are required.

We had breakfast at "Lunch Box".  It is the buffet restaurant. There is something for everyone.   There was even gluten free bread. The service is lacking, no offer of water, coffee, tea.  I thought that I had to find it myself.  It turns out that  our server was just overwhelmed or not on top of things.

reviews.text: Paradisus Palma blew my expectations out of the water! My boyfriend and I came here for a week to celebrate our birthdays, job promotions, etc. We had a room at the reserve so we had a concierge named Adriel that helped us with restaurant bookings, activities, and everything in between, he was prompt with answering messages and was able to get us into all of the different restaurants at the resort!! Having the Reserve was definitely worth the value of paying a little bit of extra money. Our room was beautiful the location is absolutely beautiful, the hotel has 3 pools for reserve member only; where the atmosphere is a little more quiet, and a large pool where they do activities. The food was amazing, the Italian and Spanish restaurants being our favorites! Everybody at the resort was always working hard to ensure cleanliness of the pool areas, lobby, etc. we also enjoyed a lot of the activities the resort had to offer, we did paddle boarding, cigar and coconut oil making, and more! reviews.author: Ann Pack
reviews.text:
Just left yesterday & really couldn’t wait to review. We went for mother/daughter senior spring break. We had a wonderful experience & I want to review while it’s fresh in my mind! Resort is clean, beautiful, and safe. We stayed in the Reserve (adults only) and it was perfect. If you have children, staying in the regular part is truly great as well. The Reserve has a private lounge/check-in, 2 private pools, private bar, private beach section, and private restaurant (Sante). The best part of the Reserve is that you get a butler/concierge for your whole stay. They book your reservations, excursions, transportation, and they will help you with literally anything you need during your stay. Our concierge was Zenovia “Z” and we loved her! The communication is via “WhatsApp” so go ahead and download! Each day Raul was our beach person - he set up our chairs, brought us drinks, and checked on us frequently. Oh, Fernando is kind of like an events person. He is so kind and fun!

Insider tips:
-You do need to tip people. In the US, we are accustomed to 10-20%. It’s not that way in DR. Tip your bartender $2-3 per day, tip your beach person $5-10 per day, tip your bellman $1 per bag or $5 overall. Tip your driver $5-10 based on how far they drive you and the quality of service. We had two rooms, and we tipped our concierge $70 per family for a week ($210 total).
-You will be told that you can get a driver for “free” that will take you to a gift shop. DON’T DO IT! They are all networking together and the pressure is on to buy even though they say you don’t have to buy anything. This is my only negative experience from the whole trip!! Just don’t!
-Coco Bongo is a nite life experience off campus. Our teenagers wanted to go, so we spent the money (it’s expensive) and cautiously went. It was a great experience if you are up for a party/show experience. Ages 18-60s were there. Truly fun and a little out of the box. Buy tickets through Otium (on site).
-Arrange your transportation & outings through Otium! Do NOT get a taxi!
-Best restaurants - Italian, Mexican, Hibachi. The Main Buffet was SO good! Sante (The Reserve) has a good breakfast buffet, too. The Main Buffet never disappointed!
-Half of us only drank bottled water - other half drank the filtered water they bring to the table. No one in our crew got sick, it’s just preference.
-People say don’t buy off of the beach. We did…they WILL negotiate. Some almost 1/2 of what they first asked. Larimar is the stone of their country and it’s beautiful. You can tell who has real vs fake stone. Do a google search on how to tell.
-Kick’s sports bar (on site) turns into a club after 10 pm. It’s mostly 18-25 yr olds.
-Nespresso coffee shop was an unexpected delight every day!
-The spa was good - not as luxurious as one might hope, but good nonetheless. The massage was great! They don’t offer robes, so keep that in mind.
-Ginger bar is upstairs at the main entrance. They have a coffee, milkshake, and smoothie bar in the morning. At night it turns in to a bar with a show and dancing. It’s family friendly because it’s in an open area. All ages will enjoy the music & dancing.

Overall, I’d say this was one of the best trips we’ve ever taken! I highly recommend Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa! It is safe, food is great, grounds are beautiful, drinks are good, and there was lots to do. We attended a mixology class that was fun (free).
If you are not usually a “resort” vacationer, you will be blown away! We were!

I’m happy to answer any questions!

reviews.author: François Morandeau
reviews.text:
We spent the first 48 hours of our honeymoon at the resort.

The resort offers comfortable accommodations. The rooms are clean, modern, and well-decorated.

The staff is friendly and very helpful.

Important points to note:

1. Meliá “VIP Offer”
On the second day, Meliá “selected” and “invited” us to discover their “VIP offer.” The invitation, extended by a staff member, was unclear about its purpose, which made us hesitant. However, faced with a rather insistent approach and the person's friendliness, we accepted.

This “visit” ultimately turned out to be a sales presentation lasting approximately two and a half hours, during which a Meliá salesperson sat down with us to present their hotel offer and propose paying a fixed monthly fee that would grant access to a certain number of days per year at their resorts, with a demand for immediate signature or risk losing the offer.

Beyond the extremely aggressive sales tactics, it's detrimental to tie up guests for so long (especially when they're only staying for 48 hours) without transparency about the true purpose of the visit (to sell us something with an immediate commitment). A frankly unpleasant experience. I recommend that Meliá stop this type of practice or, at the very least, be transparent about the real objective of these "VIP visits."

2. Room Problem Upon Arrival
Upon arrival, we were given a substandard room (two single beds instead of a double, even though we were on our honeymoon), with non-functional air conditioning.

We asked to change rooms. The hotel made us wait an hour in the room without air conditioning. We finally had to go to reception ourselves (an 8-minute walk) to request the change, encountering some resistance and requiring us to insist.

The new room was clean but had a very strong musty smell…

3. Restaurant Reservations
Reservations must be made before 4:00 PM (or 5:00 PM, I'm not sure). Guests arriving after this time cannot use the restaurants on their first evening, which is very inconvenient.

4. Room Service
We ordered bottled water via room service around 9:30/10:00 PM. The order took 1 hour and 15 minutes to arrive. We had to call a second time to request expedited delivery.

5. Food Quality (Buffet)
The buffet food is well-presented and visually appealing. However, the quality and flavors are disappointing: dishes are very sweet, too salty, or bland. The meats are either dry or undercooked. We didn't like the pastries and cakes at all.

6. The Wi-Fi is slow and unreliable.

reviews.text:
A very good experience at this family resort, ideal for both couples and families with children, thanks to its variety of areas, restaurants, and amenities.

I want to highlight the staff first and foremost, who were always attentive, friendly, and willing to help. The service was consistent, and their effort to maintain the level of attention that characterizes the Paradisus brand was evident.
The culinary offerings were excellent, with good variety and quality in the restaurants and food areas. Compared to previous visits, adjustments and improvements in the selection were noticeable, which was much appreciated.
The hotel amenities are well-maintained, the common areas are spacious and pleasant, and the family atmosphere is well-balanced, allowing for both lively spaces and quieter areas for relaxation.
The resort maintains good overall organization, with activities for different age groups and an experience consistent with its high-end family hotel concept.

In short, Paradisus Palma Real is a very good option in Punta Cana for those looking for a complete resort, with excellent service, good food, and a family-oriented approach, without sacrificing comfort and quality.

If you want to see the full experience, I have the video of this visit on my channel Walking with JM.

reviews.author: Russell Durrant
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Our 4th Visit – And We’re Already Planning the 5th

This was our fourth time staying at Paradisus Palma Real, and there’s a reason we keep coming back. This resort consistently delivers an incredible experience.

The Nikté Suites are fantastic — spacious, beautifully designed, and extremely comfortable. The Nikté experience really elevates the stay with an extra level of service and attention that makes everything feel effortless and relaxed.

One of the things that continues to impress us is the quality of the food. Many all-inclusive resorts struggle here, but Paradisus Palma Real absolutely does not. The restaurants are consistently excellent with great menus, presentation, and service. Even room service is outstanding — fast, reliable, and always delicious.

What truly makes this place special, though, is the people.

Our concierge Cristian was incredible. When we had an issue with hot water in the shower, he had a maintenance technician in our room within 10 minutes and the problem was completely resolved. That level of responsiveness and care makes a huge difference during a stay.

We also want to thank Eduardo, the manager, who went above and beyond on our first day to make sure our rooms were set up exactly how we wanted them and located close to our parents. Andres who helped us at the front desk was superb.  That kind of attention to detail really set the tone for the entire trip.

And we absolutely have to recognize some of the amazing staff who made our days around the resort unforgettable.

Julia and Jose at the pool bar are phenomenal. They make incredible drinks, bring great energy, and made every afternoon at the pool one of the highlights of our trip. Their friendliness and hospitality are a big part of what makes the atmosphere here so special.

Junior and Frank are easily two of the best waiters on the property. Their service was impeccable — attentive, professional, and genuinely warm. Every meal with them was fantastic.

The resort itself is beautiful, incredibly well maintained, and set on a stunning beach. After four visits, we can confidently say Paradisus Palma Real remains one of our favorite resorts anywhere.

And thanks to amazing people like Cristian, Eduardo, Julia, Jose, Junior, and Frank, we already know we’ll be coming back again.

reviews.text:
The personal is RUDE.

I have to say my experience was so/so. The check-in process was awful. Jean was lost and Gheiddy was rude. They weren't helpful and made us ready to leave the hotel. Furthermore, it was 3:05pm and we were told we had to wait longer to get the room. Our room didn't get ready until 4.30pm when the check-in time is supposed to be at 3. We were provided a room and before we checked in, it was changed. Then, the key wasn't working. We had to go back to get it activated. They mixed up our personal information during check-in and my Melia information is attached to my sister's information. The bell boy that we had was acting like he didn't want to help us at all and that he was bothered.

The fridge wasn't working, we called multiple times for the issue and no one addressed it (even when we were told that someone was on the way), we had the green button on to receive room service and we didn't. It was my birthday and I spoke to several people at the concierge desk  (Franklin and Andres) and I was told that the hotel doesn't celebrate birthdays anymore. I even requested to receive the information for their outside vendor which I've never received so I was unable to have something done for my birthday. I ended up getting a cake from outside myself Angela was helpful and had them sing happy birthday to me at my dinner reservation and she sent me a bottle of champagne in my room.

I travel alot and I take the time to review hotels for future travelers.

The hotel is very beautiful and clean but for the service alone that I've receive, I would never recommend someone to stay at this property,

The ONLY great part of my experience was the ladies at the buffet. They were always smiling, ready to help and genuinely cared. Yafreisy deserves ALL her flowers and the 3 ladies working with her. Yafreisy always greeted us with a smile, made sure we were all set and she even had them sing happy birthday to me a desert. She is AMAZING and they truly deserve all their flowers! She is the only reason why I even considered giving my review 3 stars. She deserves 10 stars.

reviews.text:
The hotel is large and very nice. Perhaps it could use a bit more cleanliness in both the rooms and the main pool.
The lounge is too small for the number of guests, and it's not easy to find a seat.
Many of the employees argue amongst themselves; you can see a certain annoyance, and this is reflected in the service.
The evening activities are very quiet and family-oriented, a bit boring, perhaps if you're young.
The themed nights are good, but the service is somewhat lacking.
Access to the beach is very good; you can walk there in about 10 minutes or take a shuttle.
There's a restaurant on the beach. The umbrellas and lounge chairs are comfortable.
The breakfast is very good and varied. It's best to make restaurant reservations for the whole week in advance, as it will be difficult to find a table later. However, if you can't find a table, there's the general buffet.

reviews.author: Graziele Sodré
reviews.text:
Extremely disappointing experience — not recommended for honeymoon

We arrived at the hotel after more than 12 hours of travel expecting to finally relax and start our honeymoon in a beautiful place. Unfortunately, the experience began in a very frustrating way.

When we checked in, we were given a room with two single beds that could not be joined, even though we are a couple on our honeymoon. On top of that, the air conditioning was not working and the phone in the room also did not work, which meant we couldn’t even call reception for help.

After going to reception and asking for assistance, we waited over an hour with no solution. We were exhausted from the long journey and the situation became extremely stressful. Only after insisting several times did the staff offer a solution.

The “solution” was moving us to a lower category room, which felt like a downgrade. When we entered the new room, it had a strong smell of mold, so strong that I had to take an allergy medication. Because we were extremely tired, we had no choice but to accept it.

To make things worse, because we spent so much time trying to solve the room issue, we missed the reservation time for the restaurants, which closes at 5 pm. Now the hotel staff is being very bureaucratic about where we are allowed to have dinner.

This is supposed to be our honeymoon, and unfortunately what should have been a special experience has been extremely disappointing. I chose this hotel because of the good reviews, but our reality has been the opposite.

For couples planning a honeymoon, I would honestly not recommend this hotel. The service and the way this situation was handled were far below what we expected.

reviews.text:
Very nice all-inclusive resort with beautiful pools and great location by the sea. The resort offers several pool areas, including an adults only section, several restaurants, coffee shop, a small store, evening entertainment, etc

Modern and clean rooms providing most amenities you need during the stay. The rooms has a complimentary mini-bar which is supposed to be refilled every day but at least during our stay it was not. Wine bottle part of the minibar, but no opener available in the room.

Pool towels provided and the pool bar has a good selection of drinks.

The buffe restaurant is excellent providing a large variety of dishes for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Some difficulties to get cutleries and coffee gives a lower score on services.

The mexican BlueAgave restaurant provides great service however we expected the food to be more spicy or having more flavors.

The rock bottom is the Flora restaurant offering traditional dominican food. It was extremely difficult to get a reservation at this restaurant, still it was not half full when eating there and despite many empty tables we were placed at the ”worst” location. We asked to change table and were allowed to do so but with very grumpy staff as a result. Food was average, service almost acceptable although the waiter looked like she just wanted to end her shift, and after finishing main course we were told they did only have one dessert left.

The location and facilities are top class but there are many annoying small things missing or areas with low quality services which gives the lower overall grade.

ROOM: Swim Up, a complete success and incredibly comfortable for families with children. While they sleep, you can be in the pool since it's literally right outside the door. FUN REPUBLIK: wonderful for fun for both children and adults. BEACH: very well maintained, and the nets keep seaweed to a minimum in the water. From the STAFF, I'd like to highlight:
- Laura, the dining room manager in the blue dress. A sweetheart, super attentive. We were traveling with four children, and she took care of every detail in all the services she provided. FANTASTIC.

- Rocio, the buffet waitress. Very helpful and friendly. She made our breakfasts and lunches very comfortable.

- Jean Carlos, the waiter who served us at Kanna and Mina. A true professional, one of the few you'll find at the hotel. He manages the dining room service with superior quality. GREAT.

reviews.author: Patrick Campo
reviews.text:
My family and I just spent a week at Paradisus Palma Real and had a great experience overall.
The rooms were excellent—spacious, well laid out, and comfortable, with a separate bedroom and living area. The main pool is large and lively, but there are also several smaller pools if you’re looking for something quieter. The beach was beautiful and active, and the all‑inclusive setup was a real bonus. Service throughout the resort was consistently good.
Breakfast and lunch were mostly buffet‑based, and after a day or two you quickly find a rhythm that works. Dinner is a bit different: there are several restaurants, but reservations are required and they fill up fast. Our concierge, Rosmery de Jesus, was fantastic and made a huge difference. One tip is to download WhatsApp and exchange numbers—it made communication much easier. Rosmery was able to secure dinner reservations for us, which was no small feat, and every restaurant we visited was excellent and a lot of fun.
You can take a golf cart to the Rafa Nadal Tennis Center, which is a brand‑new and excellent addition. We played at night under the lights and also did morning drills with a pro. There’s also an off‑campus spa that’s easily accessible by golf cart.
All in all, it was a great experience and I would definitely go back. Being so well taken care of by Rosmery made the trip even better.

This was our first time in Punta Cana and we were initially concerned that the reviews were incentivized but the positive reviews turned out to be true!

First shoutout to Santo at Flor- he was very warm and provided us an amazing Mediterranean lunch at Sante.
Our rooms were spacious and clean.
Food was great- buffet had a wide selection for all meals and reservation required restaurants were decent quality: Mina steakhouse (would recommend skirt steak and picanha) Flor (recommend the flower basket, slow cooked ribs) Sante ( recommend the salmon, octopus salad, heard the shrimp rice was good too).
The spa was pretty good- thank you to my masseuse Dorka who was so nice!
The beach was amazing. Definitely the highlight. We had access to affiliated Melia resorts.
Overall this is an excellent deal.
The only thing that left us feeling off and disgusted was one of the girls in our group had her check out card labeled as Kim II Joong. This didn't feel like a reflection of the hotel chain as a whole but whoever wrote that should be held accountable for being unprofessional and frankly racist. reviews.text:
I want to express my sincere gratitude for the wonderful experience I had during my stay at the hotel.

First and foremost, I want to highlight the excellent work of the Guest Service Manager, Marc Tortosa. His professionalism, kindness, and dedication made all the difference. Always attentive to every detail and willing to help, he truly elevated our experience to another level.

I also want to acknowledge Vanessa, the young woman who works on the beach, for her friendliness and excellent service. Her positive attitude and helpfulness made every moment by the sea even more special.
The restaurants are very well organized, with impeccable service and food quality that, without exaggeration, is 6-star. Every dish exceeded our expectations. Furthermore, the premium quality of the drinks is truly noticeable and a major differentiator. Wonderful cocktails.

The beach is simply fantastic, perfectly maintained and beautiful. The rooms are renovated, practically brand new, very comfortable, and modern.

Another point worth highlighting is the hotel's security, which is excellent. We felt safe and well taken care of at all times. I've had the opportunity to stay at several hotels in Punta Cana, and I can definitely say that this is the best of them all. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a top-notch experience.

I will definitely return and recommend this hotel to family and friends.

Thank you!

reviews.author: Vanessa Fontoura
reviews.text:
We stayed at the resort on our honeymoon and unfortunately our experience wasn't the best!!

We split our trip between two resorts and Paradisus was the second one we stayed at.

I'll describe my experience in bullet points:

FOOD: Very poor, especially considering it's an all-inclusive Golf and Spa resort. I noticed that the food used at breakfast remained on the buffet all day, and in some parts, it wasn't refrigerated; they only changed the location where the food was prepared... we had food poisoning and spent an entire day in our room feeling unwell. The restaurants that required reservations for dinner were very weak compared to the other resort (Majestic Colonial, which I highly recommend, much better).

Deluxe Master Room/Suite: The room we stayed in was wonderful!!! The room had a kit with toothbrushes, toothpaste, soaps, shampoo, and conditioner – everything was very good quality!!

Room service: A disgrace! We only ordered fruit and they didn't even show up or give any feedback (we ordered because we were too unwell to leave the room).

Drinks: All the drinks were very good, and there was no need to tip, which is normal for Americans. I didn't feel any difference in service in that sense, nor in the quality of the drinks served.

Tipping: I didn't feel pressured to tip, but I felt that in the restaurants they treated Americans better, as they have the habit of giving a dollar or tips for service.

Pool: We felt that some of the pools were dirty.

Security: Second-class in several locations of the resort, a very good sense of security.

I didn't even take pictures of the place because we got sick and couldn't enjoy it!!

I recommend looking for another place because there are many other resort options!!!!

reviews.author: L P
reviews.text: Do not stay here. The workers are liars. The customer service is sub par. The resort is new and the rooms are nice but service leaves a lot to be desired. If you request any changes to your reservation make sure you get them in writing. No waiter service by the pool or beach. No food service by the pool or beach either. We booked directly through the hotel and stayed on the reserve side. Our butler / concierge made dinner reservations for us at times we did not prefer however the dinners were good. Room service menu is limited. The fridge in our room did not work all week and all they offered was an ode bucket that remained on the table all week after melting the first day. The hotel is not very crowded and no where near at capacity. Check in took forever despite having private check in at the vip suite. Skip this place and find somewhere with staff that is more accommodating. Rooms didn’t get cleaned until 530 one night. Finally got wash cloths on our last day. After our two hour check in, we were taken on a tour of the resort and when we finally got to our rooms our bags still weren’t there. Slow service. Stay elsewhere. Also you can’t turn the AC below 69F but the room only ever gets to 74F. Everything was very damp in our room.

reviews.text: The hotel is good for taking nice photos; it's pretty and offers activities, but the service was terrible and ruined my stay. I spoke with them and booked a room, and when I arrived, they gave me the wrong room three times. It wasn't the one I requested. After I showed them the receipt for the oceanfront room that was supposed to be child-friendly, they told me they couldn't give me that room, but when I called and bought it, they said yes. In the end, they gave me a room I didn't even want. They made me run around a lot on my first day when all I wanted was to relax. Also, the website promised many things the hotel had, like horses, and when I arrived, they told me they didn't have any of that. The website listed many things, but they had almost none of it. I'm very disappointed, to be honest. If you go, look around and write down the name of the person who serves you.

reviews.author: David Caro
reviews.text: I go to different resorts every year, and this one has some of the worst service relative to the price per night in Punta Cana. Look for other options, which will surely be cheaper. Here are some specific incidents that happened to me during my stay: they forgot room service orders more than once, you have to ask for everything two or three times, everything takes at least an hour, the restaurants have terrible service, and the best they do is apologize instead of taking action. As for the rooms, they are very spacious, however, the cleaning is poor, and the beds leave much to be desired. My mini-fridge was broken, and it took them four days to replace it, after multiple daily requests. There are many resorts in the area; look for one that doesn't belong to the Paradisius chain and where they care more about the customer.

Our first visit to this resort, and I must say—we were truly impressed by the level of service.
A special thank you to Raul on the beach and @AndresBalbuena, our personal concierge. Raul provided exceptional service and made our cabana experience absolutely enjoyable. Our friends have known him for over ten years, and thanks to them we were fortunate to meet him—he did not disappoint.
@AndresBalbuena took care of us from the moment we arrived, ensuring we were comfortably settled in our room, handling dinner reservations, and escorting us wherever we needed to go. His attention to detail, professionalism, and genuine care made our entire stay seamless.
This resort is truly a gem 💎
A quick note for anyone who purchased a timeshare years ago: be cautious. Resort names, access levels, and permitted areas can change over time. What may have once been sold as a “top-tier” or “second-best” package may not guarantee the same access today. It’s important to carefully review how your contract is written. That said, the grounds are immaculate, and the staff across the resort are incredibly kind and welcoming.

I am currently staying at Paradisus Palma Real and unfortunately this has been a disappointing experience.

The restaurants try to position themselves as upscale, but the service does not support that image. Staff at the restaurants and beach bars are often inattentive and slow. It doesn’t feel organized or guest-focused, especially for a resort in this price range.

What bothers me most is that every day a private company takes over the main courtyard area of the resort. Regular guests are pushed out of that space and made to feel unwelcome. That changes the atmosphere completely and makes it feel like hotel guests come second.

Cleanliness is also below what I would expect from a property marketed as luxury.

I still have five more days left in my stay, but I already wish I could go home. Sadly, I would not return.

reviews.author: Sergi Vilaro Rios
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real has undoubtedly been the best hotel experience we've ever had. Service, food, location, and facilities—everything was impeccable.

We arrived very late the first night, and Aldo attended to us with exceptional kindness (and coincidentally, he also checked us out on our last day). He perfectly understood that we were tired, offered help with our luggage, and suggested room service options if we wanted something to eat. That kind of thoughtfulness makes all the difference from the very first moment.

The next day, we met the two people who elevated our stay to something truly exceptional. Yaleidi, our Destination Concierge, left us a lovely welcome gift, gave us a comprehensive tour of the hotel, managed all our reservations, and provided very useful recommendations for making the most of our time. The level of care, attention to detail, and warmth with which she treats her guests is a source of pride for any company.

And Yuderi, at The Reserve beach bar, was simply outstanding. From day one, their friendliness, conversation, and constant concern for everyone's well-being made the beach and that bar our favorite spot. We weren't the only ones: it was the place other guests raved about.

We also want to mention Jimbert and Estebani at the main buffet; Pedro, Rafael, and Gilbert at the beach bar; Misael at Santé; our favorite barista, Katherine; and Jenifer, Franklin, and Zenovia, with whom we perhaps interacted less, but whose service was always excellent.

The food, in general, was incredible. We would only highlight two weaker points: Mascalzone, which we found disappointing considering it offered something as simple as pasta and pizza, and the sushi restaurant, both the teppanyaki experience and the à la carte menu. In contrast, the rest of the restaurants, including the buffet, offered truly outstanding quality and variety.

Finally, the housekeeping was impeccable. The common areas, bathrooms, and our room always met our expectations.

We will definitely return. And we say this with enthusiasm, because beyond the facilities, what makes this hotel special are the people who are part of it. We can't wait to see them again.

reviews.author: Scott
reviews.text:
Firstly, the ratings are heavily skewed because the waitresses and waiters supposedly need reviews with their names on it, but it doesn't review them, it reviews the entire hotel, so people put a 5 Star on it so those quickly glancing at the hotel to decide where to go, will see the review and think it applies to the entire hotel, when it really was just about that one server.  Scam.

The AC in the rooms are improperly installed.  They don't drain the condensation generated from cooling the room to the outside.  So, the rooms get incredibly humid, despite being a lower temperature, so everything gets sticky and uncomfortable.

Food is terrible.  I felt that everything I had was "I guess I can eat that" rather than a "I want to eat that" or "This looks great to try".

Paid the extra money for a Concierge that couldn't get a reservation for any decent times.  But that's a whole other thing.  You have to get a reservation at their restaurants for dinner, or you have to go to their buffet which is essentially recycled food.  The room service food was horrible.  They clearly just re-plated the leftover food that wasn't eaten during the buffet and warmed it up.

One of our guests got an infection from drinking some of the water.  Had to go on antiparasitics to get cured.

Service at the restaurants, if you could get in to them, was slow and uninspired.

Just back from an incredible stay at Paradisus Palma Real. Beautiful, upscale resort on one of the best beaches in Punta Cana. At the beach, Rafael took care of our every need - he had shaded chairs ready each morning and ensured everyone in the group had a drink in hand at every moment. Jairo taught a great dance lesson and the rest of the entertainment team worked hard to keep guests involved in activities such as morning yoga/stretch, painting, water sports and dancing.

reviews.author: Cecilia Osimanti
reviews.text:
We booked Paradisus as a family trip to celebrate a birthday.  Overall, the resort gets 2 stars from me, which I really wish I  could give more. My breakdown is below:

The Food:  for being a 5-star resort, I was expecting better food. The best food we had while on our trip was off the resort on an excursion (which wasn't even food based).  It was a real let down that we are more rice and beans at Paradisus Palma Real than anything else. The room service was below sub-par, and very inconsistent with quality and even ingredients.

The Atmosphere:  the pools were fine. Many options to choose from. The point where the atmosphere really diminished my enjoyment of a beach vacation was the bar tender on the Reserve side of the beach who consistently yipped to get attention and customers. This started the moment he got into the bar to the second he left. Non-stop. Every day. Consierge doesn't care about it, either.

Consierge:  there's a number of restaurants that are on property that I would have loved to try, but was unable to due to "no reservations" available. We got "the last reservation available on property" on Sunday, to find out that we were one of two couples in the restaurant. While I could understand limited reservations due to being packed, this resort was short of full and the demand for the restaurants was equally low.

The Spa:  I had a wonderful time at the spa, which I would like to give 5-stars to. This is the only thing saving my review from being a 1-star review.

Farming Reviews:  while dining, we were asked by waitstaff to complete a review of her services. When the QR code was scanned, it brought you to a document to review the entire resort. This felt scammy and left an overall bad taste in my mouth.

I will not return here, nor can I recommend others stay here.

reviews.author: Anastasiya Vardin
reviews.text:
As far as all-inclusives go, I'd give this resort a solid 4 out of 5. Here are my thoughts, broken down by category.

Family Friendliness: I would not strongly recommend this resort for families with young children. I traveled with a 1.5-year-old and felt there simply weren't enough activities for kids during the day or in the evening. The kids' club mainly accommodates children ages 3 and up, and you're required to leave your child there — something I wasn't yet comfortable doing with a toddler. There's also no water park or splash area; just your standard adult pools. This resort is better tailored for couples and adults.

Food: The quality of the food was generally great, though the buffet selection was identical from day to day. The seafood was the standout — the resort offered a wonderfully diverse selection of fish, octopus, sushi, and calamari. The meats were also excellent and well-prepared, with impressive variety including goat, beef, lamb, and chicken. The weak spot was the fried food, which was often lukewarm and stale, as if it had been sitting out too long.
We dined at three of the à la carte restaurants: Flora (Dominican), Agave (Mexican), and the Hibachi. The biggest surprise was Agave — the food was incredible. Flora, which is supposedly the crown jewel of the resort as it's owned by a famous chef, was actually the most disappointing. The service was poor and the food was just okay. We tried the goat and the beef; while the meat itself was well-prepared, the sides were embarrassingly sparse. My "salad" consisted of a few pieces of iceberg lettuce and two cherry tomatoes cut in half with no dressing — it looked like something you'd get at Taco Bell.

Drinks: We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real (not the Circle Club, Kanna Club, or the Reserve), which meant none of the top-shelf liquor was available to us. This was one of the most disappointing aspects of our stay. For the price we paid, I expected access to better-quality spirits, especially when some other all-inclusives in the area include them. The cocktail variety across the resort also felt limited. The only bar that impressed me was Rum Republic, where they garnished my drink with a smoked cinnamon stick — it's little touches like that that I appreciate.

Room: We opted for the junior suite to have some separation between us and the crib, and the room itself was fantastic. The layout was well thought out, the soaking tub was huge and deep, and the mattress and down pillows were incredibly comfortable. My one major complaint: the room's eco-friendly motion sensors. In the middle of the night, the baby monitor and AC would shut off when no motion was detected, forcing me to get up multiple times to turn everything back on. That was extremely frustrating.

Final Thoughts: I wished the overall service had been friendlier. Many staff members didn't seem as warm or accommodating as what I've experienced at other resorts. The resort also doesn't have a single jacuzzi, which was a letdown — we had a few rainy, cooler days where one would have been perfect. Even the spa lacked saunas, pools, or hot tubs. When it comes to value for the money, I believe there are other resorts in the area that offer the same experience, or more, at a lower price.

We arrived and had to wait for over an hour for our room, I believe it was close to 5 pm when it was ready. The room was nice enough. The biggest issue for us was the food. The Mexican restaurant served food that should not be for human consumption to be honest. The pork dish was all fat, we left mid-dinner because it was so bad. Most of the staff were not welcoming. Service was super slow at the beach, we actually had to get up and just go to the bar. I went to the coffee bar near the entrance for a drink and there were 3 women behind the counter and not one tried to help me..and when I left one yelled asking me to go back but I ignored it. Entertaining was okay but the DJ played the same songs every night...overall it was a very disappointing experience and we will not be back. If you are a foodie, avoid this place at all cost. Oh, and they will try to convince you to join presentation to become a Circle member...glad we did not go because we don't plan on staying at any other property of this group!

reviews.author: Anthony Altamura
reviews.text:
Today is Day 5 at Paradius Palma Real.   Our favorite restaurant is the Asian restaurant.   The food is delectable and the service is first rate.  Especially notable is the exceptional service provided by the manager Romeris.  She’s responsible for supervising the Hibachi and Japanese sushi parts of the Asian restaurant and does so flawlessly and with a smile.  ***** Food;  ***** service. We will be back!

Today is Day 6. We dined at the Italian Restaurant and absolutely loved it.  Our waiter, Felix, was exceptional.  He took care of all of our requests, quickly and with a smile that warms the soul. The food was surprisingly delicious.  We are NYC residents and know great Italian cuisine.

Tonight’s meal was on par with many top Italian restaurants in Manhattan.  The veal and eggplant parm starters were made to perfection.  The parm was so good that we reordered it in place of dessert.   Our pastas were expertly prepared (Al Dente, with fresh ingredients; simple and delicious).

Milton, the restaurant supervisor, was highly attentive and accommodating.

Bottom line: if you vacation at Paradius Palme Real Resort, you must dine at Italian Restaurant (Mascalzone)….ask for Felix as your waiter and make sure to order the eggplant parm and veal starters and any of the pastas.

reviews.author: David Kolumber
reviews.text:
Absolute satisfaction. From the very beginning everything was perfectly organized – transfer to the hotel, staff taking care of our luggage, and escorting us to the reception. At check-in we were offered an upgrade, but without any pressure at all. When we declined because of the price, it was completely fine.

The receptionist noticed (probably because of our wedding rings) and asked whether we really wanted two separate beds as booked. Of course, we wanted one bed as a couple, and after a very short wait she arranged a different room (1228) without any issue. The room was spacious, bright, and very comfortable. The only minor technical issue was the air conditioning, which occasionally didn’t work perfectly. The room had an excellent location, and even though there were music events in the hotel area, nothing could be heard inside. Only after a few days we noticed some noise from the room above us, likely due to a change of guests.

We mostly dined in the main restaurant. The food selection was extensive and of very high quality. I would like to commend the entire staff, especially the hostess Jessica and Laura, who appeared to be in a supervisory role. Even though she seemed to be there privately, she immediately stepped in to resolve a small issue when it arose – exactly the kind of attitude guests appreciate. Overall, the staff was attentive, professional, and genuinely engaged.

One small remark: when everything is running smoothly, it feels unnecessary for another supervisor to publicly reprimand staff, as it slightly disrupts the otherwise pleasant atmosphere.

The adults-only pool was excellent. Only once were children allowed in for a special occasion, but it started raining shortly after, so it didn’t really matter.

The stay was outstanding even without any upgrade. The only thing I would suggest is offering a late check-out option. Due to high occupancy, we had to wait several hours in the bar after check-out. Food and drinks were still available, but it’s not quite the same when you can no longer use everything. That said, I fully understand this given how busy the hotel was. Considering the size of the resort, the number of guests, and how smoothly everything operated, the organization was truly exemplary.

Overall, I rate the hotel extremely highly. Excellent value for money, high-quality services, and very attentive staff – including remembering our usual drinks at the pool bar. I can recommend this hotel one thousand percent.

reviews.author: Marisa Azevedo
reviews.text:
The hotel is very nice, clean, and pleasant. We had a good reception, but the services were terrible! It starts with the concierge service, which offers a differentiated service, but in our case, it was awful. The person who attended to us only had one interest: that we participate in the welcome meeting, which was nothing more than a sales pitch for a program of future stays. It was a pushy move, but it wasn't our intention, so we didn't sign up. However, we informed the concierge from the beginning that our intention was to enjoy the hotel, but that we would like to go to the city center sometime to stroll and explore, as we always do on our trips; since he said that this assistance service during our stay would be entirely provided by him, including transfers from the location to the hotel (at no cost). We loved the idea and arranged it two days before our departure. Not only did the transfer not arrive, but we lost an entire afternoon waiting, and "our concierge" had to leave because he had been called to a meeting. We were extremely upset. On the same day, before the day ended, "our concierge" sent a message apologizing and suggesting a new tour. I resisted because I didn't want to lose another day, and it was the day before our departure, but my husband convinced me, and we gave his booking another chance.
It was worse than the absence the previous day. The so-called Transfer van arrived, and I had to take a photo leaving the hotel, a photo upon arrival at the location, and a photo upon return (I felt like I was being tested for proof of life). The place was awful; it looked like one of those bus stops, just two shops with horrible, overpriced products (all in dollars). We didn't even stay 15 minutes. We requested to return to the hotel. I was indignant, and when I questioned our "concierge," he said that everything was dangerous, which we postponed later with other people, and this is not true.
The hotel service is very poor. I will mention a few points:
They didn't restock our room's mini-fridge. I had to call reception, and they feigned ignorance and didn't deliver what you asked for.
The hairdryer in the room was completely disassembled and didn't work. I requested a replacement, and another one only arrived two days later because I kept complaining and demanding it.
One day, they came to change towels and clean the room at almost 6:00 PM because we arrived from the beach and wanted to shower. I had to film it and complain.
The bathrobes in the room that are offered for use during the stay were all there. I had one that I used, and the next day they collected it with the towels; it never came back.
Drinks (all inclusive) were difficult to obtain at the pool bar or during any nighttime event, as it seems they don't want to improve this service so as not to replenish what they offer as "unlimited drinks." We even got tired of waiting and ended up without drinks (terrible service).
There are some restaurants within the complex that require advance booking. We managed to get a reservation after 3 days, and at the reception during our check-in, they informed us that we needed to book from one day to the next. There are 4 available, but only one restaurant had a reservation, and that was two days in advance. We booked a table at an Italian restaurant and it was disappointing. I ordered black pasta with shrimp, and the pasta was awful and spicy, very bad… I only ate the shrimp, which were good.
In short, my thoughts are that the Meliá chain only wants to create “members,” as they called them. If you are a simple guest who just wants a good stay and good service, forget it, because these privileges are only for members. The reserved areas in the hotel with clearly better infrastructure are for members, the better restaurants, the better service with drinks, in short, everything is better for members. I preferred it when we were just guests.
Therefore, this magnificent and beautiful hotel is not a place I would return to, and I do not recommend it to anyone looking for accommodation without discrimination based on whether they are a member or a guest.

I recently returned from a 4-day stay at Paradisus Palma Real and ended up in the ER. My experience was unfortunately overshadowed by a severe case of food poisoning or stomach flu that began on my final morning. The symptoms persisted throughout my travel day and flight home, which was incredibly difficult. For context, I ate at the main buffet six times and had dinner at Blue Agave the night before falling ill. I found the food quality to be below average overall, finding many of the "hot" buffet items frequently cold.

On a positive note, the resort itself was lovely. Our room was clean, well-located, and offered a beautiful balcony view of the pool. Note the walls are thin, so you could hear the neighboring room very well. The staff were kind and professional; however service in general felt very slow. I enjoyed the evening entertainment with dance shows.

reviews.text:
Paradissus Palma Real was an amazing experience from start to finish. The resort itself is beautiful, clean, and relaxing, with great pools, a gorgeous beach, and a fun but laid-back atmosphere. Everything felt well maintained and comfortable.

The staff really made the trip special. The waiters were friendly, attentive, and always made sure we had drinks and everything we needed without ever feeling rushed. A special shoutout to Milton, who went above and beyond every single time—super professional, genuinely kind, and always remembered us. He made every meal and bar stop better.

The cooks also deserve a lot of credit. The food was consistently delicious, fresh, and well prepared. There was a great variety, and you could tell the kitchen staff cared about quality and presentation.

Overall, Paradisus Palma Real delivers excellent service, great food, and an unforgettable vacation vibe. I would absolutely come back and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the Dominican Republic.

I could never fully mention all the staff who contributed to making our experience so wonderful. We stayed for seven days, and each day and each night the service was even better than the day before.

Special thanks to Chef Hugo Alberto Magaña for his dedication and excellent service, as well as to the Ginger Bar in the lobby, where bartenders Luis and Andreina, along with supervisor Yiri, provided outstanding service.

Without a doubt, a place you'll want to return to. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Gabriel Solomon
reviews.text:
My family and I have been coming to Punta Cana every January for the past five years, and after trying several resorts, Paradisus Palma Real remains our favorite.

The property is beautiful, well maintained, and relaxing, with stunning grounds, great pools, and a gorgeous beach. What truly sets this resort apart, however, is the outstanding level of personal service.

Upon arrival, we were assigned Ana Azcona, a personal guest concierge, which made the entire stay effortless. Even though we arrived before check-in, everything was handled smoothly — wristbands were provided, luggage was stored, and we were able to enjoy lunch and the pool immediately. Throughout our stay, Ana checked in regularly, arranged specialty restaurant restaurant reservations, and was available by phone or text anytime we needed assistance. The experience felt seamless, attentive, and truly luxurious.

Our family also has kosher dietary requirements, and the care shown by the head chef, Pedro was extraordinary. He provided dedicated cookware and utensils, sourced approved ingredients, and prepared our meals fresh in front of us so we felt completely comfortable. This level of accommodation is rare and allowed our family to fully relax and enjoy every meal together.

We return to Paradisus Palma Real year after year not only because the resort is beautiful, but because the staff consistently goes above and beyond to make families feel genuinely cared for.

We are already looking forward to our next visit and highly recommend this resort to anyone seeking exceptional service, personalized attention, and a truly memorable family vacation.

reviews.text:
Yuderi is amazing at the beach bar! He made our entire vacation. He is quick, friendly and we never had to worry about our beds being ready for us in the morning. He is the reason for the high rating! He deserves a huge raise.

Regarding the resort- it is beautiful, clean and easy to get around.

Service at the restaurants is slow. Often took 20+ minutes to get water or drinks filled. Food was great overall tho.

We did the reserve, it is nice to have a private pool and sante restaurant, but I would argue the buffet on the main side was much better for breakfast lunch and dinner. Room service food was also amazing, and quick which was a huge plus.

The concierge service was not worth it. We came for my birthday, and we were greeted with balloons in room which was amazing, but after that, we barely saw our concierge Gustavo. He set our reservations daily, at times we did not want and we had to argue to get the restaurants we wanted to eat at, because he was just picking for us for the first 3 days. We had wanted to book excursions but ended  up just handling it ourselves because he was not to be found.

Overall, the Dominican is amazing and I’d recommend this resort.

reviews.text: Kicks sport bar very good service and friendly staff, great food and drink. Luis and staff do very good job👍👍

reviews.author: juan zapata
reviews.text: Anhelo, Jefry, and Joahn were the best with the beach service; they made our stay a special experience. The best!

reviews.author: Gustavo Orozco
reviews.text: Angelo and Jefry are the best, we really enjoyed their service.

reviews.author: Wayne Howell III
reviews.text: We found the resort through Costco Travel, when we first arrived we knew we had picked a great place. When we got to the location our concierge(Emmanuel) took care of us from the check in desk. It’s full service with bellhops for luggage and servers that come to you. We bounced between buffets for breakfast and lunch. And for dinner we found Flora, Mina, and Blue Agave were our favorites. We were shocked to find that the package came with an excursion which was Yoga on a private beach. We kept more to the pools than the beach but did enjoy several sunsets at the beach. We didn’t have much desire to venture out as the daily events were engaging and fun with the bar tenders keeping you engaged at the bar with their drinks or conversation. The weather was great most days with only two days of sporadic rain or cool weather. We didn’t have a few issues with the room(lock battery low, phone not working, housekeeping missed our room) but all were fixed by our concierge within 30mins.

reviews.author: Emmanuel Pedra
reviews.text:
We were on a family trip, and honestly, the hotel's food, entertainment, and beach were top-notch. It was the best beach in the area, as far as we could walk.

The problem was with the service and the assigned concierge. We had a reservation through Expedia, which gives you some extra benefits, like complimentary Corona beer. The thing is, no one explained this to us; we had to figure it out on our own. No one seemed to know.

The other problem was our assigned concierge, Rossmary. She showed a complete lack of interest in customer service, did whatever she wanted with our restaurant reservations, and never cared about our preferences. When we expressed our dissatisfaction, she immediately cut off communication, and whenever we crossed paths at the hotel, she looked the other way. It was shameful of her. My recommendation: even if you're assigned a concierge, try to handle things yourself.
