reviews.text: Could not be more happy with the service at Paradisus Palma Real! Especially, Angelo who took care of us while we were at the beach and made our Bali cabana experience exceptional!

reviews.author: Mariana Gomez
reviews.text:
We want to congratulate and especially thank Carlos Enrique and Carlos Pinto, who made our stay truly excellent. From the very first moment, they stood out for their kindness, helpfulness, and constant attention. Always attentive to every detail, with a genuine smile and a palpable warmth. Thanks to them, our experience at the hotel was even more special and unforgettable. People like them make all the difference and leave a lasting impression.
We also want to thank Manuel and Yeri Rafaela, who served us at the event on December 31st and made our evening wonderful. They not only provide excellent service, but they also convey something much more valuable: a genuine desire for their guests to leave happy.

reviews.author: Agustin Reynoso
reviews.text:
I stayed at this hotel just a few days ago to celebrate the New Year.

"The hotel is all-inclusive." In terms of infrastructure, it's very good, and the facilities are very comfortable and clean.
What I didn't find convenient was that I paid $700 USD per night for something that wasn't truly all-inclusive. There were no signs indicating areas where access was restricted, and at one bar, they wouldn't serve us drinks because we didn't have a membership, which is very expensive for a once-a-year trip. On the beach, it cost at least $250 USD to park your belongings on a bed with a torn and very ugly top.

In the area that was supposedly included, they tried to charge us $70 USD, which was cheaper, but still not fair, and there were no signs indicating this, so the staff had to rush us around, which was a very disappointing aspect of the experience. The service at the bars is only good if you speak English and tip more than $5 USD per drink. Because we are Latino, we weren't greeted on several occasions. At the 90 Degrees bar, Mr. Alberto made a distasteful comment, which I understand was a reference to the homophobia some people at this hotel have. Similarly, at the Ginger bar, Mr. Miguel started cleaning the bar, which was already clean, both times we went to order drinks.

An unpleasant experience. In contrast, Luis, from the same bar, spoke to us very cordially and tried to alleviate our discomfort. Room service has a menu, but when you pick up the phone, nothing is available. They don't deliver alcohol to the room, and I waited until my departure for some ice I requested, which never arrived. They only delivered ice made with water. The minibar wasn't fully restocked; it didn't cool properly, and out of five days, it was only restocked twice because we called. Every time we complained, they pretended to listen and said they would take steps to improve, but clearly they didn't, because it kept happening.
The restaurants inside the hotel aren't what they seem. We went to the Asian restaurant and they served us rice with meat and chicken. There's more variety at the buffet.
And when we arrived two nights in a row, we couldn't enjoy these places because reservations are required two days in advance, and no one informs you before your arrival so you can at least make a choice and they can reserve your table.
When we passed by those places, they were empty, and even then, we couldn't have dinner until the third night.
There's no control over the towels, and most people used up to five just to lie down and then left them wet in the same spot. I recommend bringing your own towel to avoid the unpleasant experience of walking around wet all over the hotel. I don't want a response to this comment highlighting how good their service is because there are many things that need improvement, and I hope they take action instead of just writing a long, drawn-out response from behind a machine. Maybe we're all being politically correct these days. While the secluded The Reserve area seems better, this isn't the case because someone I know who's staying there agrees that the service, in terms of price and quality, has a lot of room for improvement.

To top it all off, on New Year's Day I asked for two glasses and they told me that ALL of them—yes, ALL of them—were allocated to a beach event with a minimum charge of $180 USD per table. This means a hotel as large as this one doesn't have enough glassware to cover everyone. I've attached a photo below of the two glasses they couldn't bring me; they were at the hotel staff bar.

reviews.author: Fabiano Zanetti
reviews.text:
I recently visited and had the pleasure of being served by Yasmailin and Enrique at the beach.
Their service was absolutely impeccable; they were professional yet maintained a warm and friendly approach that made the experience truly special.
If you are looking for top-quality service, I definitely recommend stopping by.
Best regards from Italy,
Fabiano Zanetti

reviews.author: Rima O.
reviews.text: Amazing experience all around. Staff and amenities have been top notch. The kids especially enjoyed the kids club. We will be back

reviews.author: Toni
reviews.text: We stayed for six days, from December 27th to January 2nd, with my family. I expected more from this hotel, being a Paradius, but it didn't disappoint. We had suite rooms that were very small for suites. Then there was the elevator—one was broken, and there was a queue to go up. The buffet was only good on the 31st night; the other two nights were very poor, and the 1st was shameful—everything was leftovers from the 31st night. My grandson couldn't enjoy the mini club. The opening hours were terrible. I've been a customer of the Meliá chain for years, but it disappoints me more and more each time. We travel quite a bit and stay at other hotels as well, and when they're 5-star, they're much better, but everyone has their own tastes. This Paradius in Gran Canaria has been a huge disappointment.

reviews.author: Emma Cameron
reviews.text:
We stayed in the reserve which is the adult only part of this hotel. The room was super clean and the beach was great.  Our concierge was very helpful.  Service was a bit hit and miss and the food was mostly good.  I am a vegetarian and there were occasions where there was no vegetarian option but I mostly managed to find something to eat.

We came for our 25th wedding anniversary and the staff made a deal effort to make us feel special on the day.

reviews.author: Miguel Sanz
reviews.text: We are very satisfied with the entire team, and especially with the Kidsdom team, who have taken excellent care of our daughters.

reviews.author: Alma Díaz -Delgado Muñoz
reviews.text: I loved the hotel, we were very well looked after and everything was beautiful.

reviews.author: Michael Messinger
reviews.text:
First, the cons: The front desk personnel and check in experience was terrible. We really struggled to speak English with 3 different front desk people. The room we booked with a king bed wasn’t available and we received no compensation other than the option to pay to upgrade the following day if we came back after 5pm. Also, they didn’t tell us anything about the resort or amenities other than circling our room on the map, saying very quickly where the restaurants were, and good luck. So day 1 and day 2 started off really poorly. We felt we were bothering the staff trying to figure out the essentials. Then you walk out to the beach and notice it’s not very full… well the main beach has cabanas and beds that are private and cost $250/day for the Kanna club which no one even mentioned during check in. However, we spent the money, and it honestly saved the trip. It was the best service and experience we could have had. The ladies there were amazing and highly recommend. The pools need more beds if you want to spend a day there and are first come first serve. They ran out of towels and when asking the front desk how we could get a couple for our family, they just say sorry we can’t help you. Lastly, the concierge was hit or miss. They text you on WhatsApp which is nice but felt nervous we would miss out on dinner because it was either last minute or not able to send us confirmation. He did help us exchange money and with some reservations so not all bad. Apparently there is a water park off the main resort which they didn’t tell us but costs over $100/person per day.

Now, the pros… the resort was squeaky clean and elegant. The pools were very nice (although very cold). Restaurant food was very good but the buffet wasn’t great. Rooms were very nice and clean as well. We did have a cockroach next to the bed one night but that was the only issue. It was so clean and tidy throughout the resort we could overlook it. Overall the staff was nice but clearly they work for tips and expect it if they are going to help you. We did not get a chance to play golf or tennis which seemed really nice.

Pro tips:
- Spend a little more and rent the large cabanas and tip the ladies well.
- Bring lots of $5 bills. They will change your experience dramatically. The staff will go out of their way and remember you. Don’t bring 20s or higher thinking you can easily get change at the front desk. They will look annoyed and tell you sorry good luck.

reviews.author: Cristinna C E
reviews.text:
We are delighted with Janilda from Kids Dom. She has an incredible way with children. Our 3-year-old daughter, after only 10 seconds with her, didn't want to leave her side. My daughter adores her!!! She's a 10 out of 10. We are so grateful.

And Dilania from the large pool bar is also spectacularly attentive, friendly, and helpful. Another 10 out of 10!
Another special mention goes to Carlos, the buffet chef, who has been preparing separate meals for our celiac friend (he even showed her a video of how he cooked for her).

reviews.author: renata paganini
reviews.text: The hotel is one of the best places I've ever stayed. Wonderful service. We stayed after a cruise to relax. The staff at the Santa restaurant are sensational. Everyone is smiling and attentive. The food on New Year's Eve was incomparable.

reviews.author: Tulio D.
reviews.text: I spent 3 days there for New Year's Eve 2025/2026 and the service from arrival onwards was sensational. I highly recommend the Sante restaurant, with Santos and his entire team.

reviews.author: Anand Sundararajan
reviews.text:
Overall, especially given that this experience was our honeymoon, this was by far the worst experience that I have experienced in a tropical resort. A few staff members improved our otherwise awful experience.

The problem started off in the beginning with our room.

1) This hotel has a clear, unwritten policy to confidently lie that complimentary upgrades are not available, especially when booking through Amex travel. We have clear proof of this unwritten policy as we came to know of several folks that were offered paid uogrades until they brought up complimentary upgrades and then magically, those rooms vanished. Now, despite this lie, we were given an "upgrade" to the Reserve, however, even this, considering the exceptionally poor customer service, did not make any improvement to our unremarkable stay.

2) Our concierge proved to be indifferent at best and unhelpful at worst.

3) Our honeymoon special consisted of two macaroons and some chocolate covered strawberries.

4) The location is very good, however, the inconsistency of service combined with an unclear tipping culture makes getting good service a near impossible task despite nearly $400 spent on tips over the course of a one week stay.

5) The food menus were poorly designed with no dietary restrictions or allergies in mind especially for vegetarians. Separately, the food was terrible.

6) Rooms were noisy and could hear everything from the neighbouring rooms.

7) The staff and middle management need clear training on how to de-escalate situations and actually find ways to make customers happy vs. trying to make everything the customer's fault. For example, getting our minibar refreshed or getting our room cleaned required multiple followups. The first question asked despite repeated follow-ups is whether we had left our "do not disturb" on.

8) We wasted our precious time filling out a form ahead of time and the staff were not informed of any of the requests on the form and there was no effort made to reach out regarding something as basic as an airport pick-up.

I would highly recommend that this resort take a fresh look at their staff training, menus and general approach to hospitality. The managerial staff can learn a thing or two from the servers and waiters who actually managed to put smiles on our faces. I will not visit any Melia or Paradisus property again in the future and waste my time / money.

reviews.author: Marta Lucas
reviews.text:
We stayed at this hotel for a week on a family trip and couldn't be happier. The first thing that surprised us upon arrival (besides the elegant Christmas decorations throughout the hotel) was the quality of the rooms, which were very spacious and offered every amenity. Everything looked brand new, clean, and well-maintained.
We also want to highlight the friendliness of the staff and their ability to remember the faces and personalities of all the guests (at least ours). I'd like to give a special mention to Basilio, our concierge at "The Reserve," who looked after us throughout our stay.
Finally, we must mention the quality of their themed restaurants, especially Mina and Flora, with their excellent ingredients and original dishes that made for some truly special dinners.
In short… we can't wait to return!

reviews.author: Ing. Enrique Monroy
reviews.text: Everything was excellent.

reviews.author: Miranda Moore
reviews.text: We had an excellent time celebrating our anniversary. Angelo was the best!! He made sure we were well taken care of out at the beach. He had our cabana setup perfectly with our favorites each day.

reviews.author: Samra Desevic
reviews.text:
From the moment we arrived, the service at this hotel was truly unmatched. The staff provided constant attention in the most professional and warm way — always present when needed, but never intrusive. Every detail felt thoughtfully handled, making our stay incredibly relaxing.

I have to highlight Arisleda, who was nothing short of amazing. She consistently checked up on us, made sure we had everything we needed, and went above and beyond to make us feel cared for. Her kindness, attentiveness, and genuine hospitality elevated our entire experience. It’s rare to meet someone so dedicated to their guests’ comfort.

I also want to mention Rosanna , who greeted us daily for breakfast and gave us the best service we would have asked for at the lunch box ! She made us feel so welcomed

If you’re looking for a hotel with exceptional service and staff who truly care, this is the one. We will absolutely be returning

reviews.author: Hanna Overholt
reviews.text: So fun! We love Fernando and polito!

reviews.author: Lisaury Marte
reviews.text: Paradisus is a beach oasis with golden sand and a bar that never stops serving good vibes. What truly sets it apart are the hosts: Fernando “Chispa,” with his infectious energy, and Alfredo, who puts on a show with his charisma and humor. The whole setting is fantastic, but it's them who make every day a party you'll want to repeat. A must-see!

reviews.author: Sr.Darling Frefire
reviews.text:
We just returned from a stay at the Paradisus, and while the facilities are top-notch, what truly makes it worthwhile to return is the staff.
In the restaurant, the service was impeccable; you can tell when there's good management because the service is friendly yet highly professional, making each dinner feel special and unhurried. It's not just about the food; it's about how they make you feel.

But what really brings the hotel to life is Fernando 'Chispa'. He's an entertainer of a kind you just don't find anymore: he has a natural charisma and an energy that doesn't feel forced, but rather genuinely spreads his good humor. He gets everyone to feel included and have fun without being intrusive.

reviews.author: Profeta Maldonado
reviews.text: My stay at the Paradisus was very positive: the hotel is beautiful, but the best thing about it is the staff. The restaurant service was particularly noteworthy—friendly and professional, making the experience truly enjoyable. A special mention goes to Fernando “Chispa,” an entertainer whose energy and charm make all the difference. Without a doubt, this is a hotel I would return to.

reviews.author: Darling Maldonado
reviews.text:
After spending a few days at the Paradisus, I'm left with a very positive impression. The hotel itself is fantastic, but what truly makes your stay special is the team.
We spent a lot of time in the restaurant, and the service was outstanding. The staff is incredibly attentive, quickly learns your preferences, and makes mealtimes incredibly relaxed and enjoyable. You can tell there's a great work environment, and that translates to the guests.
A special mention goes to Fernando 'Chispa'. If you go, you'll notice his energy immediately. He's an entertainer who genuinely enjoys making sure people have a good time, without any pressure, and with a natural flair. People like him and the restaurant team are what make a hotel of this caliber not just a beautiful building, but an experience you take home with you. I would return without hesitation.

reviews.author: Alberto Ramos Heredero
reviews.text:
A fantastic hotel for a family trip.

We stayed for a week. The rooms were spacious, clean, and had all the amenities.

There were plenty of activities to enjoy, including sports, dance, and arts.

The Christmas Eve gala dinner was perfect, and the themed restaurants were fantastic, especially Flora and Mina.

The staff was very attentive and friendly. Since we were at The Reserve, we had direct access to Basilio, who helped us with everything we needed during our stay.

We can't wait to return!

reviews.author: Claudia Monasterio
reviews.text:
A magnificent experience at a luxury hotel with a fantastic location to end the year with the family. It was a spectacular vacation, as always.

I'd also like to highlight Rafael in the adults-only area of ​​The Reserve, who made me the coco locos with his grandmother's recipe… made with love ❤️. Yudery and Bacilio, our concierge, were also wonderful and made our beach vacation truly enjoyable. We'll definitely be back.

reviews.author: Mauro Maresca
reviews.text: I appreciate the attentive and friendly service provided by María Ortiz, Yanira, and Rosanna at the breakfast bar in the morning. Luis and Víctor at the pool bar serve excellent drinks. I also want to commend the service provided by Hairo and Gregori at The Lunch Box. Finally, I'm grateful for the helpfulness of Mina, Wander, and Estebanni at the restaurant. I would definitely choose this hotel again, but they could improve some basic aspects of room service. I loved the entertainment provided by Dana, Alfredo, and Johan, both at the pool and in the evenings, who brought the hotel to life with their bachata, merengue, and salsa classes.

reviews.author: Shubhendu Tripathi
reviews.text:
I enjoyed the location but service wise - it’s kind of garbage . If you have been to any 5-7 star resorts in SE Asia, prepare to be underwhelmed. Other than a few good staff, most of the staff do not have a sense of what a good hospitality should be like. Better to go to Bahamas. And I say with full humility and keeping the bias out of it - for the money, this resort isn’t worth it .
For example - you get 24 hour in room dining - but the menu is only fries and soup.
Another example is - you pay for an all
Inclusive resort but most of the beaches - you have to pay in some kind of purchase to access .

reviews.author: Ed Barbour
reviews.text:
Family of 4 six night vacation 24-30 Dec 2025, we chose the (EJS) Reserve Junior Suite Garden View category room x 2 for two parents + 21 y/o daughter and 18 y/o son Christmas vacation.  This cost a lot but we enjoyed every minute.  Each restaurant offered delicious meals, we almost always ordered different entries, and shared the starters and desserts loved the whole food experience.  The pool experience was great, as long as you’re familiar with the resort style land grab, pick where you want to spend the day before you go to breakfast! That said, the pools and beach always have enough places to relax for everyone.  The staff throughout the property was always pleasant, helpful and accommodating, I could not ask for more from them.

Our visit included Father/son golf at Cocotal twice, easy going atmosphere, practice range is available, start time is not absolute, the reviews on cost are accurate, I was glad we brought our own clubs, drinks and food might be included in the cost of golf but we just drank water so maybe not.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

reviews.author: Eri Barbour
reviews.text:
Had a wonderful family vacation:)  all the staff were friendly and helpful.  All the a la carte restaurants were awesome!
We would love to come back ❤️

reviews.author: Gillian Sibley
reviews.text: Our service at the Mascalzone Restaurant tonight was amazing! We love it here and we will definitely be back. Our waiter Yeensenconfident and the supervisor Milton We’re very friendly and we’re very quick. Our food was delicious and the environment was beautiful.

reviews.author: Sam Beigi
reviews.text:
This was the 3rd Melia group hotel we’ve chosen for our vacation, initially in Grand Canaria, then Riviera Maya, and now in Punta Cana, despite the perfect experience we had with the first 2 hotels, Punta Cana was an absolute disappointment. I booked an ocean front suit which is among the most expensive room in their portfolio, and upon check in, we’ve been given room 9284, which was a nightmare, old, out dated, dirty, and so on. We had to leave the faucet running for five minutes to get hot water, beds were aweful, and it was an absolute mess. At check out, we realized that our room was not 9284 and the check in staff gave us the wrong room and their system shows our room was actually 9264. Not sure if it was an intentional error or not given that some rooms are renovated and some rooms not.

Melia hotels was our favourite hotel until this vacation, and going forward, we are going to explore other brands, since the consistency of quality for a 5-star group of hotels is the utmost priority to our family.

I should mention that all staff in all department gets a 5 star from us.

reviews.author: Claudia Wang
reviews.text: The room has issue with sound proof. Extremely noisy. We can hear exactly what the other room is doing and could not sleep at all. Even they are talking at normal voice. And we asked the front desk to change a room... Nobody takes care of us. We complained at the front desk and they said nobody will be living at the other room tonight, however, the room is occupied again and very noisy again. We called front desk and they said they will take a look and the phone was hanged off. the concierge service is very terrible!!! the vacation becomes too suffering, can’t sleep

reviews.author: Jay Walker
reviews.text:
I returned to Paradisus in the Dominican Republic to celebrate my 50th birthday, and after seven years away, I can say it absolutely did not disappoint! From the moment I arrived, the front desk provided an immediate, warm welcome that set the tone for the entire stay.
The highlight of my trip was being paired with the most amazing concierge, Alam. He is truly exceptional. Alam has an incredible spirit and a way of making you feel like his absolute priority, even though he was managing several other guests. He ensured every single one of my needs was taken care of with genuine care.
Alam’s level of service "caused an uproar" in the best way possible—he truly made the experience memorable. Anyone lucky enough to be helped by him will be well taken care of.
The resort itself is beautiful and breathtaking. It was the perfect backdrop to commemorate my 50th birthday. I had a truly amazing time and I will absolutely be back!

reviews.author: Giulio Fazzolari
reviews.text: Great resort with amazing food! Thank you Wilmena and Milton for the lovely service at the Italian restaurant

reviews.author: Owen Bernstein
reviews.text: Wilmina was a fantastic server. Food came very quickly and always had an eye on our empty glasses. Food was better than other restaurants on the resort so highly recommend.

reviews.author: Mary Bond
reviews.text: Incredible experience and service. Alexandra is fabulous!

reviews.author: Luis Ariel Herman
reviews.text:
A wonderful family vacation. I want to highlight the work of Concierge Guillermo, who was always very attentive to ensure we had a fantastic time.

My sons, Oscar, 9, and Álvaro, 3, were thrilled with the Kids Zone and our visits to Parque República and the Water Park; they were very well taken care of by Janilda, Sugenery, and Alexandra.
The hotel staff, and especially Juan Peña, were always attentive to our needs, particularly those of my wife, my mother-in-law, and my father and his wife.
We will definitely return for the next holidays there. As always, Meliá lived up to expectations by providing quality service and consistently exceeding our expectations.

reviews.author: Brian Goldberg
reviews.text: Fantastic service. Julia and Jose at 36 degrees were fantastic!  Great service, got us everything we needed

reviews.author: J D-Delgado C
reviews.text: Jilbert is a great professional, a 5-star.

reviews.author: BELEN SANZ TOLA
reviews.text:
Incredible vacation at a luxury resort, with countless thoughtful touches that make you feel pampered all day long.

It's impossible to get bored with so many activities, the food is delicious, and the themed restaurants are amazing.

We'll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Molly Mo
reviews.text: This is awesome!

reviews.author: Maxime Gazel
reviews.text:
At first glance, the hotel has some real advantages: a very good location, immediate proximity to the beach, several pleasant swimming pools, and a good selection of restaurants. The setting is beautiful and suggests a comfortable and relaxing stay.

Unfortunately, once there, the reality is quite different. Upon arrival, no shuttle service is offered between the airport and the hotel, forcing guests to manage on their own with taxis at clearly exorbitant prices. For an establishment of this standard, this is already a negative sign.

Housekeeping is careless, and communicating with the staff quickly becomes a real ordeal. They don't speak a word of English, and simple requests have to be repeated several times a day. It took us nine days to consistently receive three towels and a bath mat during our ten-night stay. Unacceptable at this price point.

The fact that two "Paradisus" hotels share the same name is utterly confusing. Sun loungers, clearly visible and located directly opposite our room, were off-limits to us, without any clear explanation. The opaque organization was frustrating for guests.

The atmosphere at the buffet was also very disappointing. The staff was often cold, sometimes downright unpleasant, giving the impression of being a nuisance with every request. Again, this was far from the welcome expected in a high-end establishment.

After only three days, our assigned hostess led us, under false pretenses, to a so-called "VIP" area, which turned out to be a sales pitch for Meliá offers. Once we declined, there was no further contact until the end of our stay. This was an inappropriate and rather undignified approach.

Finally, the most worrying point: our 16-month-old daughter contracted chickenpox. The hotel's "doctor" didn't even bother to examine him, focusing first on the payment method ($215) before referring us to an affiliated private clinic, with an upfront cost that could exceed $1,500. This was an extremely shocking and anxiety-inducing situation for parents.

In short, despite the pleasant setting, this stay was a series of disappointments: a lack of professionalism, poor organization, inadequate customer service, and inappropriate business practices. A far cry from the promised 5-star experience.

reviews.author: Yuliya P
reviews.text:
We had a great stay at this resort. The kids club was a huge highlight for our family. The staff were friendly, engaging, and made our kids feel comfortable right away. There were plenty of fun activities,

The swim-up pool was another favorite, thanks especially to Arisleida, who was incredibly friendly, attentive, and always made sure we were taken care of.

reviews.author: Rodrigo Sierra Ocampo
reviews.text:
The service was excellent, and the food was high quality. The specialty restaurants were very good. The rooms were spotless.
The only thing I would change, and request (because I intend to return), is that the pool water is freezing cold. We had a problem with the air conditioning; we wanted to lower the temperature, and it took them three days to address the issue. Our room phone never worked. I understand that I went during peak season, and they must be extremely busy with so many guests.
The Christmas dinner was lovely, and they completely change the buffet menu. Some of the waiters are very cheerful, energetic, and eager to work, but there are also many waiters who aren't very friendly or available, especially at the buffet.

Congratulations!

reviews.author: Hector Fernandez
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real, in The Reserve area. The hotel, in general terms, is fine, but the experience clearly falls short of expectations for a Paradisus, especially when compared to other properties in the chain in different locations.

The facilities are attractive: the pools are spacious and very pleasant, the beach area has one of the least sargassum seaweed areas in the region, and the room is modern, clean, and comfortable. As for the food, it's quite good in most restaurants, with one clear exception: Flora, where the quality is noticeably lower than the rest.

The main problem with the hotel is the service and management. Our concierge in The Reserve, Gustavo, gave us a very poor welcome: he barely explained how the hotel worked or the available services. We had several problems with restaurant reservations, which we had made three months in advance and were still poorly managed; we requested changes, and only one was corrected. Furthermore, the 23rd was our anniversary; we informed them beforehand, and they completely forgot. The gift arrived two days late, on the 25th, which completely undermines the gesture.

The minibar is restocked irregularly and incompletely, which is inconsistent with the hotel's category and the concept of The Reserve. During room cleaning, the doors were left open on several occasions, which is inappropriate from a privacy and security standpoint. Furthermore, the air conditioning system was quite noisy, disrupting our sleep.

The staff, in general, is friendly, but they clearly lack training and organization. The reception at The Reserve deserves special mention; the service is cold and unwelcoming.

As an additional negative point, the hotel's shuttle service is not operated directly by them, but by a third party, and its management is poor. They are inflexible regarding flight schedule changes, and despite being presented as a booking benefit, the hotel completely disclaims any responsibility for any issues, which is particularly disappointing for an establishment of this caliber.

We've stayed at many Meliá hotels, especially the Paradisus and Gran Meliá, and unfortunately, this one falls short compared to other properties in the same brand. It's a decent hotel with good facilities, but the management and customer service don't live up to expectations for the price and category.

reviews.author: Soumya Poduri
reviews.text:
Update: After my initial review, the resort manager took time to personally speak with us, listen to our concerns, and work toward addressing them. That effort was appreciated, and some staff did go out of their way to make us comfortable. Housekeeping made sure they did not use strong chemicals so it felt safe for our kids.

Eduard (customer relations) is new and is committed to elevating this property to Melia luxury standards.
Despite some initial hiccups we had a great time and hospitality was on point after our conversation with Eduard.

I am writing this review as I am staying at this property. I think all the positive reviews are from the folks staying at the reserve side - maybe?. We've stayed at luxury Melia resorts and this ain't one. Rooms are old and worn (they do not look like the images on the website at all), staff is rude, they didn't honor any of the extras that we were supposed to get with our booking, they never stocked our minibar, and the room had an extremely strong odor of chemicals when we entered - we had to air it for many hours and it still lingered (housekeeping didn't want to do anything about it - after several calls, we gave up). May be we are paying brown tax - because I see several reviews where folks got excellent service. I actually had to tell the person who was at the towel booth to be polite and not be rude to me. Food is decent for an all inclusive. Location is great - it is one of the resorts that clears all the sargassum using an automatic weed harvester.

reviews.author: Pradeepa Jayaprakash
reviews.text:
I am currently staying at Paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana, with checkout scheduled for December 26. I never imagined I would be writing a review like this during my holiday — and especially on Christmas Eve — but the experience so far has been deeply disappointing and has truly spoiled what was meant to be a special vacation.

It has become very clear that guests are treated differently based on bracelet color. While I understand the concept of tiered service, what I have experienced as a green-bracelet guest goes far beyond differences in amenities. I have repeatedly been ignored by servers, had difficulty getting restaurant reservations, and have been treated with noticeably less courtesy, while guests with brown bracelets are openly prioritized right in front of us.

One situation was especially upsetting. At one of the restaurants, when I tried to order dessert, the server abruptly took the menu out of my hands without any explanation. This is unacceptable in any hospitality environment, let alone a resort that advertises itself as “luxury.”

As an Asian guest, I am also left wondering whether some of this treatment may be influenced by racial bias or expectations around tipping. Either possibility is troubling. No guest should feel pressured to tip just to receive basic service, and no one should be treated differently because of their appearance, nationality, or perceived spending level.

Tiered service should never mean neglect, rudeness, or a lack of basic respect. Every paying guest deserves professionalism, courtesy, and dignity — regardless of bracelet color.

Sadly, this situation has overshadowed my stay and taken away much of the joy from what should have been a relaxing holiday vacation. Until these issues are addressed, I cannot recommend Paradisus Palma Real, particularly for travelers booking through third-party partners such as Costco Travel.

— A disappointed holiday guest

reviews.author: Elias Pianko
reviews.text:
We spent ten days at the Meliá Paradisus Palma Real, and the stay was a disaster from beginning to end. For a hotel advertised as 5-star, the level of service is simply shameful. I think they buy fake reviews!

The only positive point is the setting. The hotel is very beautiful, and the outdoor areas are pleasant and well-maintained. Unfortunately, that's absolutely the only thing worth mentioning.

From the very first days, the staff's behavior was problematic. In general, the employees are cold, unpleasant, and constantly give the impression that they are being bothered. On two occasions, at reception, an employee literally breathed in my face after a simple request for information about a late check-out. This kind of attitude is completely unacceptable, especially in an establishment of this caliber.

The hotel restaurants are another major source of frustration. On two separate occasions, we waited forty-five minutes before anyone even took our order, and then another hour and a half to be served. There were only three of us, and the hotel was clearly not full. Such slowness is unacceptable and demonstrates poor organization.

Before our arrival, we made a single, very simple request: a room with a pool or sea view, an option included in the room category we had booked. The hotel wasn't full, yet this request was ignored, without any explanation or compensation.

The laundry service was one of the worst aspects of our stay. Upon arrival, there were no bags or forms in the room. We had to call reception three times to get them. Once we had filled out the form, we called twice to have someone come and collect the laundry, but no one came. The next day, they finally arrived more than thirteen hours late, which meant the laundry couldn't be returned within the promised twenty-four hours. I had to call three more times. In the end, the whole situation dragged on for four days, and I washed clothes for nothing since I was leaving the next day. A completely disorganized and inefficient service. 100 euros paid for this service.

On the day of our departure, our flight was delayed, so we asked to stay in the room for two extra hours. The hotel was almost empty. Despite this, we were asked to pay, and no compensation was offered. No understanding, no flexibility, no consideration for the customer.

Another shocking point: the staff systematically refuse to speak English. They understand it perfectly well but deliberately respond in Spanish and force guests to speak in that language. For an international hotel claiming to be 5 stars, this is simply unacceptable.

Finally, the room wasn't even properly equipped. There was neither an iron nor a hairdryer upon our arrival. After three calls to reception, the equipment finally arrived two days later, and even then, only a hairdryer, without the requested iron.

This stay was a series of problems, delays, and inappropriate behavior. The service is unworthy of a hotel of this standard. I strongly advise against staying at this establishment. There are much better hotels in Punta Cana, for less money, and with a genuine commitment to customer service.

reviews.author: Camila Alejandra González
reviews.text:
Great experience! I highly recommend this hotel. All the facilities were working well, the view was beautiful, there was a wide variety of food, and the service was friendly. I'm leaving with wonderful handmade souvenirs. The staff were very kind to me; I remember "Pollito," "Alfredo," "Mini Cooper," "Tana," and others. Sincerely, Camila Alejandra González

reviews.author: Christine Kapo Ng
reviews.text:
I am staying here right now for my 40th birthday and I truly regret this decision. Upon check-in, we waited about 20 minutes until we were able to get to the desk (we were first in line). Everyone but us were offered beverages. When we finally go to the desk, I told him I was here for my 40th birthday and he just laughed at me and didn't really offer any amenities or special services. I tried to reach out to the hotel several times over the past few months to get a group rate and no one ever responded. All my friends booked their rooms individually.
We finally get to our room (which was very far away from the front desk) and both of our keys did not work. We try to go to eat at the Beach Club which stays open til 6pm (it is now 4:30pm), only to be told by an annoyed waiter that they stop serving in 15 minutes and if we don't order now we won't get any food. We order, some of the items are "sold out".
We tip him for helping us with the food and getting our friends drinks after 4:45pm, he then offers to help us make a reservation at the Mexican restaurant where he'll work that night. Another thing to note, you can only make restaurant reservations in the morning from 9a-4pm but didn't know that before arrival, we were not able to secure any reservations because the reservation desk was closed for the day. This is a huge flaw, when we book our room, we should be given the opportunity to make reservations for our first night so we have something to eat. The only other option is the buffet.
Luckily, our tipped server decides to help us and we get reservations to the Mexican restaurant. You walk in and there's good tequila bottles displayed everywhere but they're not for the "regular customers". You have to pay extra for Don Julio, Patron, Espalon - etc. We ordered a Margarita and a Paloma. They use premixed - homemade mixers, everything tastes weird and non-alcoholic. Food at dinner was fine, my vegetarian friend ordered the Mushroom tacos. We were all served our food and we were waiting for her plate to arrive so we can eat together. We asked about her plate and then the waiter says "oh it's sold out". Why would  you tell us now? So my friend can't eat when we all eat?
There are also no performances or entertainment at night. They had a saxaphone player at 730 play for like 20 minutes and then silent disco was offered.
Breakfast this morning was a mess, all the tables are not bussed and we had to walk around and grab our own utensils and cups so we could eat.
Service at the beach is slow, basically nonexistent... it seems like the waiters are only waiting on specific people (probably because they have been tipped). My biggest issue is, Tips are earned upon doing a good job - they seem to only do their job here once you Tip them.
Needless to say, this is not how I pictured my 40th birthday to go. I thought it would be relaxing with fun activities, delicious food and drinks. Now I am running around trying to figure out how to get water (because they didn't put any in my room) and how to get into my room (because the room key didn't work), how to make reservations (because the kiosks don't work), how to order a drink (because the wait staff doesn't want to take your order). This is truly disappointing for a place that isn't exactly cheap.
Please do better. And if you read everyone's reviews, they all point out specific people that made their experience better - most likely because they have all been tipped.
I stayed at the Paradisus La Perla in Mexico and that place was incredible. No complaints. I decided to come here because I was really expecting the same level of service, hospitality and quality of food and drinks because it is also a Paradisus. This is absolutely not the same at all.

reviews.author: Andy Terzyan
reviews.text:
Definitely one of our better vacations. First the good and then the bad: The hotel itself was great and a lot of areas had been newly remodeled. Pool was great, drinks were not watered down. The resort is right on the beach and has a dedicated area with sun-beds. Food overall wasn’t bad but they definitely need more consistency. I’ve learned to not trust dairy products outside of the US…

Now for the bad. Vendors are pretty annoying and aggressive. They will approach you every couple of minutes on the beach… the hotel needs to put an end to this. Tips are expected TO GET decent service, not the other way around. You’re not tipping because they were attentive and took care of you, you’re tipping to get decent service. The performances on the property in the evenings were hit and miss but mostly enjoyable. The construction was pretty annoying and in certain parts of the hotel you could smell a strong acetone smell and the dust particles from the sawing. Also, when we arrived our luggage was a few days late and upon talking with one of the front desk employees, they arranged for us to be taken to a local store to get some essentials. The store was a small gift shop and had nothing of value and wasted a few hours of time. Everyone is just trying to make a buck off tips and will do anything to cut deals with friends or people on the outside to make a couple extra bucks.

With all that being said, it was worth it and wouldn’t hesitate to come back again. Just needs a little touching up from management.

reviews.author: Ravi B
reviews.text:
Checked in late with a baby, and despite informing the hotel in advance, the room was not ready.

To make matters worse, none of the basic room amenities were functioning properly — the telephone, fridge, hair dryer, and even the safe lock. We contacted concierge four separate times, but since the room telephone wasn’t working, we were forced to walk from an extreme end of the property to the lobby each time and then wait to get assistance — an unacceptable experience when traveling with an infant.

2 days and 6 times we complained about replacing the fridge, each time they said they will send someone but no one showed up. All my baby food got spoiled. Room service was so slow that a few times my baby slept crying.

Basic 101- travelling couple with an infant - allotted us a room with 2 twin bed instead of a king bed and no baby crib (despite requesting it 3 weeks prior)

We requested a room change and also asked multiple times for the devices to be replaced. Even after giving the hotel over 24 hours to resolve these issues, no action was taken and there was no follow-up.

A property that calls itself 5-star should at the very least ensure basic room functionality and timely service. Unfortunately, both basic amenities and service response were severely lacking. This experience was frustrating, exhausting, and far below the standard expected of a hotel in this category.

I am at the hotel while writing this. Lets see if management reads this and resolves this.

Location wise its a great resort, service was poor.

reviews.author: Alexis Wafford
reviews.text:
Giving two starts because the property is so beautiful and in most cases the service was good. However the experience here was disappointing.

Let’s start with check in, I have the Amex platinum so I requested the room upgrade and the lady at the front told me they had upgraded my room, cool so I’m passed off to my concierge and then he looks at the room number and is confused and runs back to the desk to ask why I didn’t get an upgraded room and the same lady that informed me I had a upgrade told the concierge there were none available. So the lady just flat out lied to me.

Next the concierge. I stayed a total of 4 nights and was only able to reserve a restaurant on one night (reservation only restaurants) and it was horrible. He was supposed to follow up on multiple nights with our reservations and didn’t, so we ended up having to eat at the buffet just about every night, which was just decent, a lot of the food was cold but the desserts/fruit were good, omelet station and meat grill was about the best thing going since it’s freshly made. Service is good in the buffet and at Ginger though but unfortunately I didn’t get to experience many restaurants to provide any reviews on those.

Also they send this pre arrival form, that I don’t understand the point of. I informed them of my birthday and they told me I’d get a cake, never received that.. and also requested extra water in my room which they completely ignored and continuously had to request water.

What else, housekeeping was pretty good except for like one day where we didn’t get our room cleaned until 6pm which was annoying. Bell boys were great.

The only other issue I had was late check out, my Amex portal has guaranteed late checkout for THC AND FHR, however they informed me that it was not available for our room? I’ll definitely be reviewing through the Amex portal as well because this was not the best experience. I would love to give this property another chance when I return but not so sure about that.

reviews.text: Everything was excellent! Guillermo, the concierge, treated us wonderfully and was very attentive. We'll be back with the whole family. It's very spacious, the service is excellent, it's clean, and the shows are incredible!

reviews.author: CONSTANZA DIAZ AGUIRRE
reviews.text: The Paradisus Palma Real hotel is very beautiful, always offering a variety of fun activities for all ages. The only drawback is that they don't cater to lactose allergies at breakfast. We went to the beach, which is beautiful and clean; the staff is always there, which I love. The Flora and Mascalzone restaurants were my two favorites, but this vacation wouldn't have been so incredible without the entertainment team. We've stayed at many hotels, but this one impressed us with the quality of its staff. We fell in love with the country and are definitely planning to return for another vacation at this beautiful hotel. Thanks to the people who made my vacation unforgettable, especially Carlos, Alfredo, and Johan, because they are a fantastic dance and entertainment team. We would love to return to the Paradisus Palma Real Hotel next time.

reviews.author: Audrey Caron
reviews.text:
My 14th all inclusive experience. Would 100% recommend this hotel. We upgraded to The Reserve. I’m not sure if it’s worth. The private restaurant is nice for lunch, and the exclusive beach section and pool are nice. We just don’t know if we would recommend paying the upgrade.
There are many adult private pool sections. I would not come here if I had kids over 1 year old. There are no places for kids. A baby under 1 is fine, but other than that this is not a resort for kids.

Pros: the food was beyond excellent. (Better than Club Med Cancun). The Asian and Italian restaurants are EXCELLENT. The rooms are so beautiful with snacks and little extras (body lotion, etc). The pools are big. The chairs and sunbeds make the difference!! The beach section was beautiful! We walked further on the beach and the other hotels  did not have a machine to remove algae. This hotel removes algae every morning which makes a difference. The coffee at the Ginger bar is AMAZING. The drinks are AMAZING like I have never seen this. They are amazing at every bar.

Cons: the animation is not the best. The staff does not really seem to care if you give tip. Overall the staff is nice! There are A LOT of sellers on the beach and they are really annoying. Some of them even go into the resort which is too much. We understand it is their job but each day we were at the beach and the same vendors ask 3-4 times each if you want to buy their things or get a massage. It’s just harassement at this point. Each day we would have at least 30-40 vendors asking us to buy things.

Special mention to Andres which was so nice to us. Also special mention to Ciari I believe (hope I spell her name right). Also, Anthony every morning at the Ginger Bar for the coffee was so nice.

reviews.author: Sogand Ajami
reviews.text:
Stayed for 7 nights ( First week of DEC 2025)

Great resort with amazing staff, but buffet needs improvement

Overall, my stay at the resort was perfect. The staff were incredibly friendly and helpful, and the entire property was very clean and well maintained. The à la carte restaurants were very good and offered great quality and service.

The only area that really needs improvement is the buffet. The quality of the buffet food was low, and most of the time it didn’t feel fresh. Items like ribs, pork, chicken, and fish were often cold, which was disappointing.

Recommendation:
It would be great if the resort added soft-drink fountains and self-serve coffee machines. This would reduce the pressure on servers and allow them to provide better, more attentive service. Guests could still order alcoholic and specialty drinks from the staff, while handling simple beverages themselves.

Overall, I enjoyed my stay and hope to see these improvements in the future.

reviews.text:

reviews.author: Jake Schuldt
reviews.text:
We stayed at the resort for 3 nights in late November. The airport is only about 25 minutes away, so the ride in is fairly short. The resort is clean, beautiful, and quite large, but once you familiarize yourself with the main areas it's easily walkable. The staff was okay, definitely not as friendly as most other places I've been, but not bad. The basic room we got was plenty spacious, very nice, clean, and had some extra toiletries and stuff that made it on the higher end of rooms I've stayed in. Surprisingly nice and decently spacious gym.

A major disappointment for us was the food. The buffet food was mostly all cold. We tried the Dominican restaurant for a reserved dinner one night, the steak was horrible. It tasted like the cheapest cut of meat boiled. By the end of the stay, all I could really eat was omelettes and fruit. The coffee was burnt and gross everywhere. There isn't any quick dining places like many resorts for safe options, and being a bit far from the downtown area, it left us filling up on drinks.

The drink selection was impressive for an all-inclusive resort, having some mid-tier options, like Jameson, Tito's, etc at many bars. The bars were spread out well, except for the beach (none we saw). The beach is very spacious but full of salesmen for off-site excursions. I had some drinks and got suckered into one for a buggy ride, and it was more than the asking price and not worth it. Avoid them at all costs.

Top gotchas:
- the "club" they mention is just the sports bar where they move the DJ inside.
- there is no 24/7 bar. The main lobby bar is advertised as such and wasn't open late.
- the time of year we went, everything was eerily empty. It was nice for getting drinks, but I feel like that affected the food quality.
- don't buy anything from people going around with flyers. Go through Viator or the front desk.
- only one small convenience store in side.
- no hot tubs
- signage is non-existent, so it's hard to know where and when you can eat
- cabanas on the beach were all empty but we got asked to move as they were reservation only (again no signage)

reviews.author: Liana Stern
reviews.text: As someone who has traveled to a variety of places and stayed at many hotels, I was blown away from the service of Paradisus from the moment I arrived to the entrance. The dedication and willingness to help and accommodate from all the staff was something I have never experienced before! we stayed at the reserve side which I would definitely recommend. The reserve has a seperate beach and pool which was amazing, and bars that have higher shelf liquor and an extra restaurant with better food, and a fully inclusive mini bar restocked every day, which was so worth it! We had a small issue with our meal at Sante, and the staff there (Miasel, Melqui) went above and beyond to make up for this, and the chef made us a special dinner with lobster, champagne and more. Christopher was our concierge and he texted us every morning with the actives and found us in person every day to ask if we needed anything. He also decorated the bathtub with a happy birthday sign made out of flower petals! Johan, Alfredo and Fernando from the Entertainment team were great dancers and super fun to be around. Yuderi, Martin, Gilberto, Rafael, who were amazing beach servers and bartenders at the Reserve beach and made our bed/drinks everyday. Maximo who worked at the winery was very knowledgeable and fun to talk to. Pool bartenders, Alberto, Jonathan, and Jorge were amazing as well. Other bartenders and waiters that went above and beyond were, Miguel, Jhojan, Diorgenis, Victor, Jean, Eduardo, Luis, Yefry, Jean, Miguel, Richard, and Manolo. I have never had that much of a positive experience with a resort staff until I came here. I will definitely be back on service alone, but not to mention the amount of space in the room and the size of the pools. Everything was modern, up to date, and we had an amazing time. The food was a hit or miss, but that's expected at an all inclusive. 10/10 stay, thank you to all!

I was honestly shocked by the laundry prices at this hotel in the Dominican Republic. I just wanted to wash a few of my T-shirts and a pair of shorts — nothing special. But when they gave me the price list, I couldn’t believe it: each item costs 5 USD. One T-shirt – 5$, one pair of shorts – 5$, and so on for every single piece.

In the end, they tried to charge me almost 100 USD for laundry, even though this hotel advertises itself as All-Inclusive. It’s ridiculous. I never expected to pay that much just to wash a couple of light items in an all-inclusive hotel. Very disappointing and uncomfortable experience with their “extra services.”

Food is okay they didn’t really chip out on the selections of ingredients however it is not tasty compared to its competitor.

The beach is nice, however, it is always lacking towel provided to you.

Poor service: as I’ve mentioned previously language is an issues. However, I also find that they are very eager of tips if you don’t pay tips you don’t get good service which I think is a big no-no in this all-inclusive hotel that’s unprofessional. Plus, even when I put on the do not disturb light or one of the staff still knocks our door to ask if we need to refill our mini bar. Really unprofessional.

Overall, as a Hilton Gold member and Marriott Bonvoy Diamond member. I would not recommend this hotel to anyone even if they have discount.

I have no idea why it has 4.8 stars on google review actually. Tell me if you have a different opinion.

reviews.text:

The hotel is wonderful, with impeccable facilities, everything very clean, beautiful, and well-organized. The service is a major highlight: all the staff are polite, attentive, and extremely helpful.

reviews.author: Hortensia Cobo
reviews.text: We stayed at this fantastic hotel in October 2025—it was pure luxury! What I would highlight most is the attention from all the staff, starting with management, who provided very personalized service. This surprised us quite a bit, as in other hotels the management doesn't bother to speak to the guests. In this hotel, it was the complete opposite: they were incredibly friendly and attentive to our every need. The waiters were amazing, especially Ramón at the pool, the staff at the sports bar, Fior (the best!), and the staff at the Ginger bar—they were delightful. Pedro, who was in charge of the towels, was very kind and attentive to us. The entertainment team is small but incredibly attentive: Jairo, Fernando, Ayayay, and Carlos—thank you so much for all your attention and the dancing! The DJs were fantastic. The shows were quite good and entertaining. The rooms were beautiful, and The Reserve service was spectacular. The pool's location was superb, right next to the beach. The food was delicious and varied; I'd especially recommend the Flora y Santé restaurant. The drinks were excellent, particularly Miguel's cocktails at Rum Republic Spice & Sugar Bar—a 10 out of 10! We enjoyed it so much that we'll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Juan Jose
reviews.text:
First, I should mention that I've stayed at several Paradisus and many Meliá hotels, and this one was a huge disappointment.
The only good things about the hotel are the location, the size of the rooms, and the fact that it's not overcrowded.
We booked the highest category, a master suite.
The worst things, without a doubt, were the following:

1) Breakfast, lunch, and dinner were terrible. The dinners were so bad that it's better to go to the buffet than to the specialty restaurants. That says it all.

2) The service was the worst I've seen in 25 years of staying in Caribbean hotels, and that was even when it wasn't full. It's so bad that even having tea at breakfast is practically impossible.

3) The room was large and supposedly luxurious, but it turns out there's no water pressure in the showers, nor any hot water. The TVs didn't work. Unacceptable. After complaining repeatedly, they didn't offer a solution.

In short, I can't understand the good reviews.

reviews.author: SHELLY RAY
reviews.text:
Overall, I had a fun and enjoyable stay. The room was comfortable, the resort was quiet and relaxing, offered different activities such as yoga, paddle fitness, and workshops. The customer service was beyond excellent and everyone was very helpful, especially Carlos Alberto, who communicated with us every day, gave a great tour and made us feel very welcome.
I’ll start with all the pros: We went during off season, so the resort was not too crowded, extremely quiet with few children, wait times were minimal and service staff was excellent. The resort is beautiful and massive, with several pools and direct beach access. There were several things to do, although I had many external excursions planned, I wish i had more time to enjoy resort events. I experienced the paddle fitness class which was so much fun-the instructor was funny and it was a nice group experience. The coffee making taller was another quick but enjoyable experience. The room was clean and comfortable, and met all my needs. All the restaurants and the lobby were located in the central plaza so it was easy to navigate around the resort. Next, the excursions offered were all very fun and transportation was included.
I felt that my experience was parallel to the price I paid. Getting the Reserve would not have been worth it.

Now for the cons: The major issue being the food. There was breakfast, lunch, and dinner buffet, several gourmet restaurant options but I would rate the quality and taste of the food as less than ideal. The taste of the various meats-chicken, salmon, steak mainly - were very bland. If they wanted to keep food bland its fine, but then they should offer different local condiments for guests who want more flavor. I have had authentic Dominican food and I was disappointed that there wasn’t anything tasty or authentic at the restaurant. Even the salmon lacked something as basic as salt. The restaurants were disappointing as well, there wasn’t any flavor or authenticity and the desserts tasted very cheap. There were only 3 options for ice cream-lemon, vanilla, coconut-and they all tasted the same. The cafe near the lobby had great drink options, but the pastries left on display had bugs flying around and made the food appear less than appealing. The best food I ate was outside the resort at a nearby restaurant, Citrus, though taking the major risk of going out into the city.
Next, the check in process took a little longer than expected, and after they activated my bracelet, it didnt work to open my room.
Also, there was live music every single day, but no singer. Only on Friday there was a live band which was the most enjoyable performance.
On our final day, we went for breakfast and it was completely packed. The service was understaffed and we had to ask for every thing like utensils, cups for coffee etc.

reviews.text:
An update to this review from a couple of years ago. Unfortunately, not a good one. This is not a 5 star resort. Not even close. It’s important to note that we are members and are supposed to get a higher level of experience. There are significant maintenance issues- the property is neglected- broken tiles in the pool, banged up trash cans everywhere, work is needed on the exterior of the buildings, the beach huts are shabby  and the cushions need replacing. The staff does not pick up bottles and glasses left around the property. The food is worse than when we are here last. There is not much for healthy eaters or people who don’t eat beef or pork. The staff  is nice but they are understaffed and not well trained. Last night our food was served cold and the bottle of wine we ordered never came. Our bed and pillows were uncomfortable. The lovely Melia scent was nowhere to be found. People were noisy and there are smokers everywhere. I can’t imagine we would come back. Our experience at the Mexican properties has been better and we will try Spain. I’m already having second thoughts about our membership.

The Paradisus is a wonderful property. Incredible service, great pools, beach and activities. The staff is uniformly kind, friendly and service oriented. The buffet food is great. The restaurants are mixed- some good, some not good. I would hope management would work on improving them. A highlight of our trip was our concierge, Yaleidi Sims. She is such a lovely person and so efficient and helpful. She made our trip incredibly special. Ask for her!!

reviews.author: Luc Bibeau
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real – Adults Only “The Reserve” (November 5–14, 2025)

Upon choosing Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana, my wife and I were initially hesitant about the resort’s scale. However, staying at The Reserve—the adults-only section—transformed our experience. This area brings the resort down to a human scale, offering a self-contained oasis with everything one could wish for, and then some.
Tennis courts were conveniently located a short walk away at an adjacent property, and the same area hosted the spa’s hydrotherapy pools. That said, excellent spa services were also available directly onsite. Guests can also enjoy a 27-hole golf course or access the renowned Rafael Nadal Tennis Center, both available for an additional fee.

What truly sets the resort apart is its people. Every staff member went out of their way to know us and ensure our comfort. A special mention goes to Martin, the best beach valet we’ve encountered in over 30 years of all-inclusive travel. His personal attention elevated our stay—our favorite beach spot was always ready, with fresh towels, drinks flowing, and everything impeccably clean, even on days we were away on excursions.

We’d also like to recognize Gustavo, Barnelis, and Luz along with the entire crew at Santé, our preferred spot for breakfast and lunch just steps from the beach. Barnelis, the always-smiling hostess, set the tone each morning, while Luz and Gustavo made sure service flowed perfectly throughout our meals. Their warmth, professionalism, and attention to detail made dining there an absolute pleasure.

Evening dining options were varied, including Japanese hibachi, Mexican, Italian, steakhouse, and international buffets. Most dishes were well executed, though not extraordinary—admittedly, our expectations are high as seasoned foodies. The fine dining restaurant, curated by local chef Leandro Díaz, offered refined takes on Dominican specialties and was a pleasant highlight. However, the overall evening dining service fell short of the resort’s otherwise high standards, which slightly impacted our overall rating.

Members of the hotel’s loyalty program enjoy a private area and an extended wine list accessible via points or direct payment. While the table wines (red, rosé, and white) were decent, true wine enthusiasts may prefer to explore the premium options.
Facilities throughout the resort were exceptional: multiple clean and expansive pools, many featuring swim-up bars; a well-equipped gym suited for maintaining fitness routines; and effortless access to non-motorized water sports equipment (with a refundable deposit). The Reserve guests also benefit from dedicated concierge service—ours, Yaleidy, consistently demonstrated care, attention, and professionalism.

Although our late flight arrival delayed initial check-in and the orientation tour, everything was quickly remedied the next morning. The resort also offers hospitality showers for guests with late departures—a thoughtful touch.

The beach itself was spectacular: clean, beautifully maintained each morning, and thoroughly enjoyable throughout the day. Entertainment staff kept things lively with optional activities at both beach and poolside.

In short, Paradisus Palma Real delivers a luxurious and relaxing experience where service excellence stands out, facilities impress, and staff genuinely care. While a few aspects of dining and evening service could improve, the overall experience far exceeded expectations.

Our rating: 4.8 out of 5. Highly recommended for couples seeking tranquility, attentive service, and an upscale beach escape.

reviews.text:
I loved the food, it was very good and there was a lot of variety. The Flora restaurant and the Japanese restaurant were the highlights. There's a lot of entertainment, various activities, and the entertainment was really cool, especially Carlos, Fernando, and the chef at the Japanese restaurant—he's very funny and cooks phenomenally. Juan, who makes the omelets at the buffet, was also great. The room was very nice, and there are always live singers at night.

The only bad thing was that many of the outlets in the room didn't work, so the refrigerator didn't work. I also didn't like the waiters; they would bring you water and then you wouldn't ask for anything else. I never saw any waiters on the beach, and at the beach restaurant, the service was very slow. Except for José at the Japanese restaurant; he's very nice and a very good waiter.

reviews.text:
🌴 I had an excellent stay at this resort. The facilities are very well maintained, the rooms are comfortable and clean, and the restaurant offers very good food and variety.

The overall experience was wonderful.

I especially want to highlight the entertainment team: Ayayay, Fernando “Chispa” and Jairo are incredible, super attentive, fun, and their energy makes every activity unforgettable. My congratulations to them!

As for Juan Carlos, I'm sure he's part of the entertainment team, but I think there are things he could improve, especially regarding his interaction with guests. On one occasion, I felt harassed and uncomfortable when he asked for my contact information after we finished dancing. It wasn't a bad experience overall, but I think it's important to pay attention to these kinds of details so that all guests feel comfortable.

Despite that, my stay was excellent, and I definitely recommend the resort and its team. I would love to return.

reviews.text: Our family of four had a great time at Paradisus Palma Real. All the staff members were very attentive and friendly, especially at the Kidsdom. There were also six restaurants and two buffets at the property, all the food was nicely prepared and very delicious. We liked that a lot of them were local dishes and authentic. Overall it was a great stay for us, I would definitely recommend this resort.

Without your dedication and commitment, this event would not have been such a success, especially thanks to the Groups Department, and in particular to Miss Germania Esther Castro. We would also like to thank Beatriz López from the Groups Department and, in a very special way, Yakelin Reyes.

We are extremely grateful to the reception team, especially Bioni, who showed exceptional dedication and was extremely helpful at all times.

As for the Ginyer bar team, consisting of Antonio, Andrecita, and Altagracia, they were always attentive to our needs, providing us with exceptional service.

Finally, I would like to highlight the cuisine at the Santé restaurant. The quality, flavor, preparation, and variety of the food have reached a level well deserving of a 9/10, coming very close to perfection.

reviews.author: MIGUEL ANGEL TAGLIAPIETRA
reviews.text:
The service I received upon check-in was extremely unpleasant. The person who helped me wanted to charge me for an extra day's stay, given that our return flight was in the afternoon, and if I stayed until noon, I would have to pay for a new room. We argued for over half an hour until I asked someone else to help me. It was a terrible introduction to my vacation. Furthermore, I wanted to use my membership credits to cancel the All-Inclusive package, which they refused to accept, and I canceled with USD.
The saddest thing was that in a later conversation with another member of the staff, they asked me why I didn't use my points to cancel.
As for the service at the apartment, it left a lot to be desired.
They provided a complimentary coffee maker with very good coffee capsules, but they didn't even leave a teaspoon; in fact, they didn't leave any items at all. And finally, this happened on the third or fourth day of my stay. Upon leaving the apartment, I ran into the room service person and politely asked if I could leave the door open, to which she indicated it wasn't necessary and would take care of it in a moment. Conclusion: the room wasn't made up. When I complained about the unfinished service, they sent me a photo of a red sensor outside the apartment indicating do not disturb. (Speechless)
I still love the place and the attention most of the staff provides. I'll definitely return to this place again, since I have four weeks a year.

reviews.author: Samarkand City
reviews.text:
🏝️🏝️🏝️An Unforgettable Stay at Paradisus Palma Real! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

My stay at Paradisus Palma Real was absolutely incredible from start to finish. The resort is stunning beautifully maintained grounds, lush tropical gardens, and a breathtaking beachfront that looks straight out of a postcard.

The staff deserve special mention everyone was warm, welcoming, and went above and beyond to make sure every detail was perfect. From the front desk to the restaurant teams, service was consistently top-notch.

The rooms were spacious, spotless, and luxurious, with comfortable beds and modern amenities. I especially loved waking up to ocean views and enjoying my morning coffee on the balcony.

The food and drinks were outstanding plenty of delicious options for every taste, from international buffets to elegant à la carte dining. The cocktails were creative and refreshing, and the atmosphere at every restaurant was lively yet relaxing.

Whether you’re looking to unwind by the pool, enjoy beach activities, or indulge at the spa, there’s something for everyone here. The entertainment team also did a fantastic job keeping guests engaged without it ever feeling intrusive.

Overall, Paradisus Palma Real delivers the perfect mix of luxury, relaxation, and world-class service. I can’t wait to come back🌺✨
Special thanks to Gustavo and Gilberto!!!

The combination of elegance, the scenery, and unsurpassed service has us truly enchanted by the hotel and its staff: Arisleida and Jesus at Paradisus Palma Real beach were unparalleled in their warmth and attention, not to mention Luis Garcés, the supervisor, who was always attentive to our needs. And at the Sante restaurant, the service from Santo and the entire staff was very friendly and attentive. Thank you so much. And Leonela was always attentive to make sure everything was fine in our room, that nothing was missing, that we were kept informed, and that many details were provided. Everything has been wonderful, beyond words. Spectacular!!! Highly recommended. Friends, family, beach, tranquility, elegance... Enjoy it all!! ☺️

reviews.author: Florencia Gonzalez
reviews.text:
We stayed with friends for a week and had a great experience, from the food to the service, everything was top-notch. I'd like to highlight Fer's attention from the entertainment team. He invited us and accompanied us through all the activities, making us have fun at every single one.
On the other hand, Christopher, our concierge, took care of us and made sure everything was in order during our stay.

I highly recommend it!!!

When we were by the reserve pool all of the staff were amazing and would come to us so that we never needed to go to the bar, although it was nice to go up and chat with them as they were really friendly and made such amazing drinks! Also the drinks from the rum republic bar in the evening were always outstanding especially from Miguel and Melvin who really perfects each drink and makes it taste incredible. reviews.author: Anthony White
reviews.text:
I'm not sure how this resort has such a high rating. The hotel service is good and that's about it. The rooms are nice, but you only have a glass door in the water closet for privacy. Your significant other will hear EVERYTHING when you are using the toilet.

The food and the service was horrible. A lot of the food dishes are local, and the American food is bland and unseasoned. Mashed potatoes at breakfast (yeah breakfast), were literally boiled and smashed, not blended. They did not have any butter or seasoning. The ribeye steak at one of the resaurants was tough and only about .5" thick.

Some of the restaurants are not open every day. The steak restaurant was closed when we arrived Saturday. The large buffet was closed as well two of the days that we were there.

There aren't many activities here. They had a cheesy concert in front of the main pool. Speaking of pools, the pools and the beach close at 6:00 PM. Really, I couldn't believe it.

I will definitely do more homework if I go back to the DR. Don't believe these reviews.

reviews.author: Aida Kamali
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real – Extremely Disappointing Experience

I would never recommend this hotel. We booked what was advertised as an all-inclusive package, but it was far from it. Food was only available at very limited times and in specific locations, leaving us with no real options throughout the day. The staff was unhelpful and in many cases outright rude. Service by the pool was nonexistent—no one ever checked on guests, and when we asked for help, most employees didn’t seem to know anything.

On top of that, there were no basic amenities such as a shop for essentials or even an emergency convenience store within the hotel. For a resort of this size and price, this was shocking. My husband and I travel four times a year for quick getaways, and this was by far the worst experience we’ve had anywhere.

We expected a relaxing, stress-free stay, but instead we dealt with poor service, lack of food options, and no sense of hospitality. This was our first and last visit to Paradisus Palma real
