reviews.text: Beautiful hotel! Food was amazing! Rooms are extremely clean and impeccable. Our guest concierge Guillermo Joshua is an amazing person with lots to show and knows all about the hotel and all the activities the hotel provides to you. He is available at all times with any concerns.

reviews.author: Nick Petroni
reviews.text:
My wife and I just returned from a 7-night stay at Paradisus Palma Real. We loved so much about our stay but wanted to point out a few of the highlights and maybe just a few slight notes.

Hotel:
The hotel itself was beautiful and felt very elevated. In fact each morning when I would walk through the lobby to grab coffee I either verbally or in my head said "damn, this place is so nice." I'm not big on social media, but I felt that just about every corner of the hotel was photo worthy.

Rooms:
We had a very spacious master king suite room with beautiful furnishings, panoramic windows and a large balcony.  The room felt very clean and provided a very pleasant place to be when we weren't roaming the hotel.

Restaurants:
The hotel has several awesome restaurants (Mexican, Italian, Asian, Steakhouse, Dominican, Mediterranean, Japanese) that provided excellent food and beautiful spaces to dine. We enjoyed the diverse offerings in fare and always looked forward to evening dinners.

Entertainment:
The hotel sort of mimics a cruise with a vast array of entertainment. There were daily activities (painting, water aerobics, yoga, etc) and nightly shows that were pretty full-scale productions. All were really wonderful and we were amazed at the talent.

Service:
The service was impeccable across the board. Whether it was front desk team, the waiters and waitresses, bartenders and entertainment team, they were all so wonderful. They all played such a huge part in making our trip one to remember. I do have to show out a few staff that went far and beyond to make everything extra special.

Bioli: Front Desk
Wander: Waiter Lunch & Dinner
Luis: Waiter Lunch & Dinner
Luis: Pool Bartender
Quintino: Pool Bartender
Guillermo: Guest Services
Juan: Breakfast/Lunch Waiter

Each of the aforementioned really made us feel special and well-appreciated throughout our stay. I could probably write another 10 paragraphs about these wonderful people, but just know you will be in good hands with the Paradisus Palma Real team.

A few quick notes on things weren't so great.

Concierge: Apparently, we were suppose to be provided with a guest services concierge at check-in who could serve as a POC for reservations, activities, transfer services and so on. That didn't happen. Not a big deal and we were pretty easily able to figure this out our own, but a concierge may have helped a bit.

The Beach: Nothing to do with the hotel, but the sea water is pretty well covered in sea weed.  The hotels do make an effort to alleviate the issue, but the seaweed is persistent. Just a callout if you're hoping to swim in the Caribbean.

Overall, our stay was amazing and we'd love to one day return.

reviews.author: Ana M
reviews.text:
We stayed at this hotel between November and December 2024. Enjoying our honeymoon, we booked one of the Master Suite Swim-Up rooms.

The hotel is quiet, clean, beautiful, and elegant, with facilities that exude comfort and make for a pleasant stay.

The service from the waiters was terrible: they only showed interest if they received a tip or dollars; otherwise, they practically ignored you and didn't bother to offer proper service. This attitude created a feeling of complete disinterest and left much to be desired in terms of professionalism.

The most disappointing thing for us was the service we received in the Chinese show cooking area. The chef, Rafa, was particularly unpleasant with my husband, displaying a rude and even discourteous attitude. This behavior created an uncomfortable situation that completely marred our experience.

In contrast, we want to highlight Salvador, the young man in charge of excursions. He was very kind and helpful at all times.

This demonstrates his professionalism and positive attitude towards guests.

And to add to that, the steakhouse was a definite plus, where the waiters were exemplary and the meat was delicious.

In contrast, the Italian restaurant left much to be desired.

This hotel desperately needs more oversight. It gives the impression that management is either unaware of what's going on or, worse, that they prefer to turn a blind eye. When you spend such a large sum of money on a honeymoon, the least you expect is a good experience, not poor service and unprofessional attitudes. It's unacceptable that a place with such beautiful and tranquil facilities ends up failing due to poor management.

reviews.author: Jimmy Ciprian
reviews.text:
We stayed 3 nights at this hotel for a medical conference.

Without a doubt, this hotel urgently needs renovation in several areas:
1. The infrastructure is old and worn.

2. HYGIENE: This is a crucial point, and this hotel is sorely lacking in hygiene. The rooms are very dusty and full of mites. In the buffet restaurant, the heat and poor organization of all the food—cheeses and cold cuts that were clearly not kept refrigerated—are unbelievable. (Several attendees experienced gastrointestinal issues.)
3. SERVICE: If you're looking for service, this is definitely not the place. With the exception of Anthony at the lobby bar and Eduardo from guest services, everyone else was grumpy and tried to make your stay difficult.

4. FOOD: Generally of VERY poor quality.

I had an unforgettable stay at Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort! From the moment I arrived, I was blown away by the beauty of the property — the white sandy beaches, crystal-clear pools, and stunning gardens made it feel like paradise. 🌴

The rooms were spacious, spotless, and very comfortable, giving me everything I needed to relax and recharge. The staff was incredibly friendly and attentive, always greeting us with a smile and going above and beyond to make sure we had the best experience possible.

The food was absolutely delicious — fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented at every meal. On top of that, the drinks were exceptional; refreshing cocktails by the pool and beach made the whole experience even better. 🍹

Between the gorgeous beachfront sunsets, relaxing by the pool, and exploring the peaceful lagoons and gardens, every moment here was memorable. Whether you’re looking for relaxation, amazing service, or picture-perfect views, this resort truly delivers.

I can’t recommend Paradisus Palma Real enough — I’ll definitely be coming back!

reviews.text: Compared to Paradisus hotels in Mexico, this one falls far short. In Playa del Carmen, Mexico, they clean up the seaweed. Here, they don't. You can't even go into the sea. Even the best Michelin-starred chef can have a mistake or an off day, but unfortunately, it's not the first time we've expressed our dissatisfaction. Unacceptable in a hotel of this category. reviews.author: H
reviews.text:
Would not recommend this resort.

Pros: Beautiful location. Look at the photos for how surreal the location and architecture is. The facilities are aesthetically beautiful.

There’s always some sort of entertainment in the square of the resort every night - eg acrobats, bands, DJ, etc. Pretty chill. And it changes daily.

Cons:
1) When we first arrived, we were told to leave our luggage at the entrance to the lobby for it to be taken to our room…It was never taken to our room. We waited in the room for hours until the evening and still our baggage hadn’t arrived despite contacting the concierge regarding such and being told someone will be by to drop the bags. We had to go and get our bags that were sitting where we left them. Because at a certain point we really just wanted to change clothes.
2) There aren’t many activities offered. Would have been nice to have more options offered. Some of the activities like the sports or dancing - no other guest tended to show up for which is not the resorts fault. But when we were there for one of the activities, the activities coordinator indicated they were leaving to get something and would be back (they never came back). Also ensure to get to activities somewhat on time because they can run out of materials. There are activities like painting certain objects which they can run out of said object. Spa is good but very expensive.
3) The safe and the room phone were not working. Someone came to try to fix the safe but not the room phone. The safe still had issues but was usable. Would recommend ordering breakfast room service the day before. It was nice sitting on the balcony and eating in the morning. But ended up having to order the food through the concierge since the phone to call room service didn’t work. Also had to ask the concierge for the room service menu since the QR code in the room that we were told was the menu didn’t include breakfast options.
4) Restaurants are not great. There are only about 2 places open for breakfast and lunch while there are more options for dinner. You do need to make reservations for dinner or else you cannot dine there. It was difficult to make a reservation prior to getting to the resort but if you do contact them you should be able to. There is a limited number of reservations but some places can be closed so either way you may not get the place you want to dine. Just give the resort a few options of the places you would want to dine at. Anyway, the food was ehhh. Not great. Not amazing. Mediocre. And most guests we spoke to had the same sentiment. If you are a foodie, would 100% say do not come here. Go to a resort in Mexico or somewhere else because this is not the place for you. Hibachi didn’t have much of a show (there wasn’t any egg juggling, no volcano onion fun, etc), the food was mostly cooked with some sort of sauce that made it all taste the same (sauce was not great tasting).  Steak house was somewhat better than the other places we went but still not amazing. Would recommend the ice cream - it was pretty good. Would recommend the lunch box as a slightly better lunch spot. Be mindful that some places don’t allow you to eat at the restaurant in swim suits so bring a coverup/other clothes unless you want to go back to the room following swimming.
5) Can get drinks by the pool. You can ask for a coconut to drink coconut water out of. But drinks like Coke tasted off and flat despite coming straight from the bottle and the bottle wasn’t expired. They do have a premixed pina colada which was ehh not amazing.

6) There is a casino and sauna that you are allowed to access but it’s at a different property “nearby” which you need to ask the front desk to have a golf cart take you over there. We did not try to check it out.

The sun was baking us for most of the day. Make sure to wear lots of sun screen.

If you have someone in your party who speaks Spanish, that’s ideal. Most staff knew at least a small amount of English but with most it was difficult to communicate without someone who can speak Spanish in the party.

reviews.author: Chris Rollins
reviews.text:
After 10 years we return to continued excellence at Paradisus Palma Real, and once again this resort exceeded all of our expectations. From the moment we arrived, the beauty of the property was undeniable—the lush tropical gardens, the pristine turquoise waters, and the timeless elegance of the resort’s design reminded us why we fell in love with this place a decade ago.

But what truly sets Paradisus Palma Real apart is not only the magnificent setting, but the people who bring the experience to life. Over the years, this resort has continued to raise the bar for luxury and hospitality, and the credit goes to the incredible team whose passion and professionalism ensure that every guest feels valued and cared for.

We would like to recognize and sincerely thank the following outstanding team members who went above and beyond to make our stay so memorable:
•Rafelin, Eduardo, Franklin, Rosanna, Yanira, Daniel – Chef (Buffet), Anderson, Vicente, Baron, Leannie, Freilyn, Tony, Rosa, Maria, Cesar – Flora, José Murillo – Flora Chef, Enrique – Flora, Ebony, Richard – Chef, Maria – Mina, Melina – Flora, Jonathan – Flora, Raider – Flora, Gustavo – Santé, Jean – Flora / Santé,  Noriandro - Sante, Franklin - Sante, Jeffrey – Pool, and Angelo– Pool, and Fernando and Anderson, bringing the best entertainment.

Each one of these individuals made an impact on our experience. The culinary team—from the artistry of the buffet and specialty chefs to the vibrant flavors at Flora, Mina, and Santé—elevated dining to an unforgettable part of our stay. Poolside service, led with warmth and attentiveness, ensured that relaxation was always effortless. From warm greetings at every turn to the personal touches that showed genuine care, this team proved that hospitality here is not just a job, but a calling.

It is rare to find such consistency after so many years, but Paradisus Palma Real continues to shine as a world-class destination. The staff’s dedication, kindness, and professionalism reflect the very essence of five-star service.

To the team we recognized above: thank you for welcoming us back after 10 years and reminding us why Paradisus Palma Real is truly one of the best resorts in the Caribbean. You are the reason we will continue to return.

Five stars, without hesitation! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

reviews.author: Jose Antonio Gonzalez Aguirre
reviews.text:
A Substandard Experience at Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa (by Meliá)

We recently stayed at Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa (by Meliá) expecting a high-end brand, but unfortunately, the experience fell far short of expectations. From day one, the food was poor: dinner at the Japanese restaurant was unacceptably bad, and several members of our group suffered from stomach upset and diarrhea the following day. Overall, the à la carte restaurants offered neither adequate quality nor superior to the buffet, which is unbecoming of a five-star hotel.

The snack bar service was equally subpar: we waited over an hour for a hamburger and two sandwiches, which, when they arrived, were not what we had ordered. The hamburger was burnt, and the sandwiches didn't match our order. When we reported the problem, we received no explanation or proposed solutions, and to top it all off, we were met with jokes and laughter from the staff. The treatment we received as customers was unacceptable.

In addition, the gym's air conditioning was inadequate throughout our stay. Despite repeatedly requesting an adjustment to the temperature and airflow, our requests were ignored, making it very uncomfortable to work out and causing one of us to develop a sore throat.

The room service also fell short of expectations. Cleaning was insufficient, and one day, at 6:00 PM, our room still hadn't been cleaned, forcing us to go down to reception. The worst experience was the laundry service: it took a day and a half to collect our clothes despite our reminders, and when they returned them, they were only ironed, with the previous stains still visible. Overall, an experience clearly below what one would expect from a five-star establishment.

We are publishing this review to reflect what happened and with the hope that improvements will be made. We await contact from the hotel chain to offer explanations and ensure that situations like this do not happen again.

reviews.text:
My stay at the Palma Real this year was a mixed experience. At the breakfast and lunch buffets, the staff was very indifferent. It was difficult to order anything, and it was rarely brought. On other occasions, there was no service at all. We were promised that upgrading to swim-up rooms would give us access to the Grand Cana water park at no extra cost, which turned out to be incorrect, and in the end, we couldn't enjoy that amenity due to a lack of information. This is something management should take into account and provide better training for the staff to offer better service. Shout-out to Ricky and Junior at the buffet, who always provided excellent service.

On the other hand, we had a unique experience visiting Kicks. The entire staff—Jose, Yeimi, Altagracia, and others—always greeted us warmly, chatted with us, offered us drinks according to our preferences, and the atmosphere was always pleasant. It was the best place to be in the evenings after the main show.

Anthony always welcomed us with great energy at Ginger. Great conversations, excellent coffee, and lots of laughs in the afternoons.

Sandra always left our room spotless and provided excellent service.

I congratulate the staff who are doing a great job and encourage them to continue providing such excellent service.

reviews.author: Willie Harrington
reviews.text: There were many reasons for my dislike of the resort. First, when trying to upgrade my room online, it kept denying my card despite it being the same card I used for the initial reservations with AND. When I arrived at the resort, I used the very same card, but now additional steps were needed. Additionally, the service was poor. Some staff members were okay, but many made me feel as though I was irritating them. Third, the beach could not be accessed. The brown seaweed and its smell made going to the beach pointless. Lastly, the food was HORRIBLE. Many items, such as fries, hashbrowns, and cooked meats like the breakfast sausage, were reused the next day. They were cold, dry, and clearly old. The charcuterie section had all the proteins and cheeses out in the open, but they were not kept on cold displays or on ice. The meats were hot and sweaty, and the cheeses were melting. The bartenders at certain pools were not welcoming. No poolside food service, which I have never experienced at other resorts, was also a disappointment. Overall, I cannot recommend this resort, and I will never visit again.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Exceptional Service at Blue Agave – Thanks to Melqui!

During our stay at the Paradisus Palma Real, we had the pleasure of dining at Blue Agave, and our experience was made truly memorable thanks to our server, Melqui. From the moment we were seated, Melqui went above and beyond to ensure everything was perfect.

He was warm, attentive, and genuinely cared about making our evening special. He took the time to explain the menu, offered thoughtful recommendations, and anticipated our needs before we even had to ask. His friendly personality and professionalism stood out, making us feel both welcomed and well taken care of.

The food at Blue Agave was delicious, but what really made the evening shine was the service. Melqui’s attention to detail, kindness, and hospitality turned a wonderful meal into one of the highlights of our trip.

We are so grateful to him for making our night so enjoyable, and we highly recommend asking for Melqui if you have the chance to dine at Blue Agave. He truly represents the best of Paradisus Palma Real’s service and hospitality.

reviews.author: Cindy Rasines
reviews.text:
Our family vacation at Paradisus Palma Real was TERRIBLE extremely disappointing from the very beginning. We had booked a one-week stay, but we left after only three days due to multiple issues.

First, upon arrival, there was no staff available to assist us with our luggage. A large group had arrived before us, so we were left to carry our own bags, even though we had two small children (ages 2 and 5). This was unacceptable for a so-called luxury family resort.

The housekeeping service was another major failure. We checked in on Friday, and by Saturday at 3:30 p.m. our room still had not been cleaned. I specifically requested service since my 2-year-old uses diapers and the trash already smelled unpleasant from the previous day. No one came until 10:00 p.m., after I had to leave the trash bin outside the door and go to the lobby to complain. This level of neglect is completely inexcusable.

On Saturday morning, while having breakfast, we even found a small cockroach walking on our table — absolutely disgusting and unacceptable for any resort, let alone one that claims to be high-end.

To make matters worse, on Sunday night, while I was in the room with my children quietly watching TV, security knocked on our door to tell us that our baby had been crying and we were “making too much noise.” I was shocked, frustrated, and outraged. This is supposed to be a family resort — babies cry, and that is a normal part of family life. For security to harass us for this was humiliating and deeply upsetting.

This entire experience was uncomfortable, frustrating, and incredibly disappointing. I requested a refund because what was supposed to be a relaxing family vacation turned into a stressful nightmare. I will never return to this property and strongly advise families to reconsider before booking here.

reviews.author: Rodrigo Sousa
reviews.text:
I stayed with my family from July 25, 2025 to August 1, 2025 and we had an excellent experience. We stayed in the Swim-up suite with the pool right outside the room and the children loved it, especially in the late afternoon when we returned and could have a little more fun while my wife started getting ready. Regarding the service, we had mixed experiences. There was a bit of a delay at check-in and the Expedia concierge (we booked through Hotels.com, which belongs to Expedia) wasn't very helpful, but the next day I replaced the service with concierge Guillermo, who completely changed this experience. Guillermo was extremely welcoming and always concerned about helping. He helped me prepare a surprise dinner on the beach to celebrate my daughter's birthday and became friends with my son, who was eager to see him every day, making our perception of the service much better from his interactions. In the end, he made a point of meeting our family at the hotel exit and even moved us as if we were saying goodbye to a long-time friend.

I also want to praise Wander from Kanna Bar, who was always fun and went out of his way to serve us well. For those visiting the hotel, I recommend looking for him and asking him to prepare a Rum Punch, which was a great suggestion from him, and I drank several during this week there.

As a tip for those traveling from Brazil, the direct GOL flight arrives and departs very late. At checkout at 12:00, I recommend looking for a late checkout and then reserving a room for a few hours until departure for the airport, in our case at 7:00 pm. They charge US$20.00/hour, but it's worth it to be able to have dinner and shower properly before going to the airport, which has few options for dinner.

ENGLISH:
I stayed with my family from July 25th to August 1st, 2025, and we had an excellent experience. We stayed in the Swim-up Suite, which had a pool right at the door of the room, and the children absolutely loved it—especially in the late afternoons when we returned and they could enjoy some extra fun while my wife started getting ready.

Regarding the service, we had mixed experiences. At check-in, there was a bit of a delay, and the Expedia concierge (we booked through Hotels.com, which is part of Expedia) was not very helpful. However, the next day, our experience changed completely thanks to concierge Guillermo. He was extremely welcoming and consistently attentive. He helped me organize a surprise dinner on the beach to celebrate my daughter’s birthday and became a friend to my son, who looked forward to seeing him every day. Guillermo’s interactions significantly improved our perception of the service. At the end of our stay, he made a point of saying goodbye to our family, and it was such a heartfelt moment that it felt like we were parting ways with a longtime friend.

Special mention also goes to Wander from the Kanna Bar, who was always cheerful and made a great effort to serve us well. For those visiting the hotel, I highly recommend asking him to prepare a Rum Punch—it was a fantastic suggestion, and I had several throughout the week.

A tip for travelers coming from Brazil: the direct GOL flight arrives and departs quite late. Since checkout is at 12:00 PM, I recommend arranging a late checkout and then booking a room for a few extra hours until your departure to the airport—in our case, at 7:00 PM. The hotel charges USD 20.00 per hour, but it's worth it to be able to have dinner and shower properly before heading to the airport, which has limited dining options.

reviews.author: Amy Milo
reviews.text:
I would give this place a thousand stars if I could. We stayed at a Paradisus in Mexico in March and had a fabulous time so we chose one in Punta Cana for this vacation in August and couldn't have been happier.  The rooms were fabulous and really clean. Food was great, and the staff was extremely friendly and accommodating.  The pools were huge and the perfect temp.  The drinks were strong and delicious. We upgraded to "reserve" when we got there. So private pools and restaurants as well as beach areas were ours for an additional $350 ish for a garden view. There were night time turn downs with chocolates on our pillows as well as our own concierge to book our dinners (which we didn't use much as we like to do things when the mood strikes) The resort was not very busy so reservations were not really necessary. And most of the time we were the only ones in the private pools. They did have some of the seaweed which I guess is pretty common now as we are polluting the oceans, but they were out every morning raking it up. We swam in the  ocean and had no issues with it, There were small clumps floating around but nothing terrible.
If you are looking for an affordable resort that has top notch amenities, this is it! Highly recommend!!!! (If you are traveling to the DR, do not forget to get your E ticket.  No one really tells you about it, but you must have it to board your flight from the US, and it is free. I used a site that charged $40 a person.  Don't make my mistake..go to a free site)

reviews.text:
We returned a few days ago and had a fabulous stay at The Paradisus.
We were on the adults only side but not The Reserve.
The overall experience was excellent despite a few hiccups. One being the room was not exactly ready for us, as the mini fridge was not fully stocked when we checked in. The safe was left in the locked position but left open by the previous guest. Not knowing their code, it required service to be reset. Lastly, the hair dryer was broken and needed replacing. These are items that a routine check would have picked up on.
That said, all else was pretty much spot on.
The buffets were filled with many great options. I was surprised to find 2 whole salmon being carved upon demand for lunch.
Breakfast selections were usual egg stations plus other good options including some local foods like mangu. A plantain based dish. That was a nice find. Fruit was plentiful too. Yogurt, cereal also.
The restaurants...
The steak restaurant was excellent. The Dominican restaurant was as well. We hit it 2x. The Asian Fusion left a little to be desired. The meal was a bit over done. The show put on by the chef was the highlight there.
We didn't go to the Italian unfortunately.
The Brisas restaurant was not available to us.
The hospitality of the staff was top shelf. They all work hard and their aim is to make their guest happy. What's more is that they would go out of their way to make things right or to help you If needed.
The private pool (adult side) was fantastic. Plenty of chairs under umbrellas. No towel game. We did not use the Reserve pool. It was not available to us.
The beach was well kept and chairs under shade were plentiful during our stay. They have a berm to keep large amounts of seaweed off the beach. We did not see much at all.
The family side pool offered activities available to all.
The nightly shows are on a smaller scale but very entertaining.
If your looking for top shelf alcohol mixed drinks, you won't find that here. Perhaps if you paid extra for it. We are not big drinkers.
Yes the drinks might be a little watered down, like many all inclusives, but all were still good.
The resort layout is well done and we'll kept. It's a beautiful place.
It's not a large resort so there's not as much walking as some of the larger places.
The rooms on the adults side had an updated feel. Spacious and the bed was firm and comfortable.
I could say more...
I will simply say that we would return to The Paradisus.

reviews.text:
During our stay at Paradisus Palma Real, the highlight of our pool days was hands-down the incredible service from Julia and Edickson at the 34° Pool Bar. From the moment we sat down, they made us feel like VIPs — remembering our names, our favorite drinks, and always greeting us with huge smiles and genuine warmth.

Their energy is contagious, their drinks are perfectly made, and they somehow keep the bar fun and lively while still making sure everyone gets quick service. Whether it was a tropical cocktail, a cold beer, or something off-menu, they made it flawlessly. They go above and beyond, and you can tell they truly love what they do.

If you’re at the resort, make your way to the 34° Pool Bar and look for Julia and Eddie — they’ll turn a good vacation into an unforgettable one.

Exceptional Stay at Meliá Paradisus Palma Real – Punta Cana

We just spent 10 days at the Meliá Paradisus Palma Real and it was incredible from start to finish.

Guillermo Joshua, our main concierge, was outstanding — warm, welcoming, and incredibly helpful. He guided us through our stay and even stepped in with medical assistance (I like to say he saved my life!). Truly the perfect host.

Jean made our transition into the Meliá Circle membership easy and exciting. We hadn’t planned on joining, but his insight and approach showed us the real value, and we’re glad we did.

Vanessa at the members pool and bar treated our family like royalty — attentive, genuine, and always with a smile.

The resort itself is beautiful: spotless grounds, fantastic rooms, and food that’s a solid 10/10 — the best buffet I’ve seen in over a decade.

We’ll definitely be back. Thank you to everyone who made this trip unforgettable!
Danny

reviews.author: Ro Indy Realtor
reviews.text: I booked a junior suite on the adults only side as I was traveling for my birthday. When I arrived, I was advised that my room had been upgraded and I was put on the family side. There was a screaming baby next to my room. I opted for this room so that I didnt have to be around kids while traveling. They switched my room. I opened the door to a man walking with food in his hand. He yelled, ummm hello. I freaked out and closed the door so fast. They then put me in a 3rd room. The room was nice but I was smacked in the face with a mildew smell when I opened the door. At this point, I was exhausted and wanted to find food. I did make them aware kf the smell and they said housekeeping would check it out. I also let them know the hot water in the shower, tv, and fridge wasn't working. At this point, I was over it and my birthday trip was not pleasant. I made the best out of a bad situation. I wouldnt agree that it's a 5 star resort. They didnt offer a turn down service. The room came with a loofah, robes, slippers, toothbrush/toothpaste, shaving cream and razors. The room was nice outside of the mildew smell. It was amount 30 minutes away from the airport. I've been to plenty of resorts, and this by far had the best food. I was thoroughly impressed. The view was so beautiful. Everyone was so nice and helpful. I'd definitely want to visit the DR again. I also had an amazing massage. They have a company on-site that can help you with excursions. I didnt receive a welcome drink as advertised in my reservation. I put in the reservation when I booked that I was coming for my birthday. They didnt make me feel special at all. The last night, I walked in to a treat. At the restaurants, they sang hbd for other guests and when I asked if they could do the same for me bc it was my birthday, I was brushed off. I was able to get some beautiful pictures.

Everything at our stay in July was very nice. The resort, the food, the rooms and the service. Our only complaint was the beach
As beautiful as it is it Not a private beach for the resort. It’s a public beach. Meaning locals who are not staying at the beach have access to it. This we found to be very, very annoying. As soon as we got on the beach the first day we were hounded constantly to buy things, to have foot massages and to have hair braids put in
Even just have locals begging for money
I’d thought maybe the resort would try to do something about it but said they couldn’t. Anyway with that said we won’t be back since we can’t tolerate the public beach

reviews.text:
We had the absolute pleasure of being taken care of by two incredible staff members during our stay — Rafael at the beach and Harry, our room concierge — and they truly made our vacation unforgettable.
Rafael took care of us every single day at the beach, and his service was nothing short of exceptional. He was so attentive, always making sure we were comfortable, had everything we needed, and felt completely pampered. We celebrated my birthday during the trip, and Rafael went above and beyond by surprising us with champagne and creating a beautiful beach setup that made the day feel even more special. His kindness, attention to detail, and warm energy will definitely be missed!
Harry, our room concierge, was just as amazing. He completely catered to us from the moment we arrived and made my birthday so memorable by decorating our room and surprising us with champagne and chocolate-covered strawberries. He handled everything with such genuine care and attentiveness — we never had to ask twice for anything. His thoughtful gestures and warm personality made us feel so welcomed and celebrated.
These two truly went above and beyond and are a huge part of why our stay was so incredible. We can’t wait to come back and see them again — they are gems of this resort!

reviews.author: Soheil Maroufi
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisus Palma Real from July 26–31 with our small dog. While the hotel grounds were beautiful and the restaurant staff were friendly and professional, our overall experience was disappointing due to poor communication and rude behavior from management.

The website clearly states that bringing a dog costs $120 USD per night and includes services like food, treats, and bowls. Despite staff seeing our dog from day one, no one mentioned the charge or services until day 3, when I was suddenly asked to pay the full amount. I paid in full, but we still didn’t receive any of the promised services.

When I spoke to the supervisor (Rafelin), he was extremely rude, accused me of hiding the dog (which was clearly untrue), and dismissed our complaint by saying, “At least your dog drank water here.” We only received pet services for the last two nights, even though we paid for five.

Thankfully, the restaurant and cleaning staff helped make up for the frustration, and the buffet food was excellent.

⸻

Dear [Hotel Management / Guest Services],

I am writing to express my deep dissatisfaction with the pet services provided during my recent stay at your hotel.

I was charged for six nights for bringing my dog, yet I only received pet services for two days. This is extremely disappointing and unacceptable. I believe your team should be aware that your guests travel from all around the world to stay at your hotel, and in most other countries, customer service and client satisfaction are treated with much more care and professionalism.

Whenever I travel with my family, I always make sure to choose hotels that are pet-friendly. Unfortunately, my experience at your property was the worst I’ve ever had in terms of pet accommodation and service.

I had truly hoped to recommend your hotel chain to my friends, clients, and business partners in Canada, the United States, and Iran, but after this experience, I am certain that I will no longer do so.

I kindly ask you to review this matter seriously and take appropriate action. At the very least, I believe a partial refund for the unused pet services would be fair.

reviews.text: Overall, the service from the moment we arrived was excellent. We were assigned a person (Andres) to assist us with our dinner reservations, and thanks to him, we were able to get them. reviews.text: Incredible experience at Bar Run Republic! Miguel and Melvin are simply the best: super friendly, attentive, and with such great energy that you want to stay all night. reviews.author: Aitana Griffin
reviews.text: Excellent service at the Between bar. Jensy makes delicious cocktails. We'll definitely be back.

reviews.author: AF
reviews.text:
We've been staying at The Reserve at the Paradisus Palma Real for several years now, and we always return for many reasons: the facilities, the surroundings, the beach, the amenities… But what truly makes the difference is the staff.

We want to start by thanking Álvaro, who has always been attentive to us on every visit. This time, due to a sudden change, we met some of the new management, and the experience was equally wonderful. We especially want to highlight Carolina, whose kindness and warmth made our vacation unforgettable. We also want to thank Alexia, a key player in ensuring everything runs smoothly. Always with a smile, taking care of every detail.
Our concierge, Gustavo, deserves a special mention: attentive, polite, helpful… undoubtedly one of the best butlers in the hotel.
This time, although we're already familiar with all the restaurants, we went straight to Flora, the Dominican restaurant, where Eduardo works. We appreciate him immensely and already consider him a friend.
At The Reserve, you have access to the Santé restaurant for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. The experience there is always excellent: Barnelis welcomes you with a warmth that is greatly appreciated, and chefs Santos and Rafa surprise you with delicious and beautifully presented dishes. Enrique is a true showman, and Reinaldo's service (whom we affectionately call "our Mario Casas") is top-notch. And Misael, with his kindness and politeness, has become one of our favorite waiters.
A very special mention also goes to Wendy, who always serves us with a smile, making us feel right at home. Her dedication and attention elevate your experience.
In the exclusive beach area, the service is excellent thanks to Pedro, Martín, Rafa, and Yuderis, who are always ready to help you with anything you need.
However, we do want to mention something that slightly marred our stay: the so-called "photographers" with animals like macaws or iguanas, who don't take no for an answer and are quite aggressive. Unfortunately, we had to request security almost daily due to this situation, which became very uncomfortable. Therefore, we want to thank Juan, Elisaldo, and the other members of the security team for their professionalism. This is an issue the hotel should seriously review: these types of people should not have access to private areas.
As a suggestion for improvement, we believe a hotel of this category should reinstate the dress code that existed previously. It's not pleasant to see people dining in swimsuits and flip-flops, or with their feet up on the tables in the Plaza Colonial. They are small details, yes, but in a 5-star luxury hotel, these details are what make the difference between a good experience and an excellent one.
In short, we continue to choose The Reserve not only because of its beauty, but also because of the people who make everything run smoothly and ensure each visit is special. Thank you for always making us feel at home!

reviews.author: Fiorella Patricia Morey Rotalde
reviews.text: The resort has all the amenities. We were very grateful for Raúl's service at the pool; he's a very kind and helpful person. We were also served by Hanzel at the 32 Degrees Bar, whose service was top-notch!

reviews.text: Everything has been spectacular from the moment we arrived. The facilities, the rooms... everything luxurious. The pools, the beach, incredible. We stayed with The Reserve, and the service and support were top-notch. Furthermore, the food at the restaurants (Santé, Flora, Blue Agave...) was of excellent quality, full of flavor, and prepared with great care. We must also mention the outstanding service at the Rum Republic bar, and everyone who works there (Miguel, Melvin, the supervisor) is not only incredibly friendly and professional, but their signature cocktail, Passion Mamajuana, is one of the best we've ever tasted. We also want to highlight the excellent service at Ginger, always ready to innovate and serve amazing products. In short, a fantastic experience that we will definitely repeat.

reviews.author: Luis Ortega
reviews.text: The hotel is incredible, the service is super friendly, and in the "Reserve" section, the service is personalized. The views from the rooms are fantastic. There's a great variety of restaurants with excellent and varied food. All the bars have very helpful staff, but we especially recommend the "Rum Republic" bar, with the hotel's best signature cocktail, "Pasión Mamajuana"—you can't leave without trying it. Always take advantage of the opportunity to ask the bartender for your favorite cocktails; they'll surprise you with wonderful combinations.

reviews.author: adriana piccioli
reviews.text:
Beware! At Meliá Wellness, they wouldn't let us leave unless we paid for what we had already paid for. One day, due to a flight advance, they kept harassing us about our remaining days until we had to pay to leave... A total rip-off. The place itself is excellent, and the service is very good. The staff is impeccable.
Yesterday, my family arrived from the Paradisus Palma Real. The comfort and ambiance were excellent. However, the buffet service was terrible. We would finish eating and there would be no drinks, only warm Corona beer. The water was also warm. The chain is in a very bad state.

reviews.author: PhillyR2
reviews.text:
I have just returned from my visit to the Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Resort Spa with a group of friends.  The experience was unforgettable in the best way possible.  The rooms were beautiful and the grounds were magical to walk around.  The food was incredible as well.  I feel what really made the resort so special though was the friendliness and professionalism of the staff there.

First there was Ariel, our concierge.  He really helped to make our visit there perfect.  Ariel was always checking in on our group and made sure we were taken care of and answered any questions we may have had.  Was nice to know we had someone we could reach out to and count on consistently.  He felt like part of our family as we had to leave.

When we would visit the beach we had our favorite attendent Yuderi, who made sure we got the drinks we needed and would help set up our chairs and lounging area.  He was always happy to greet us as we arrived and checked in on us to make sure we had everything we needed while taking in the sun on the beautiful beach.  He was outstanding.

There were 2 guys in the entertainment department that really stood out.  Their names were Joeffry and Fernando.  They were always out and about the resort leading dances and getting the guests to smile and enjoy themselves.    Super outgoing and had great positive energy that was infectious.

Our favorite spot to eat breakfast and lunch was Sante.  The atmosphere was beautiful and so was the service and staff.  Barnelis, the hostess, always greeted us with her infectious smile and charm.  Wendy, Gustavo, Reynaldo, and Jesus on the wait staff were also super friendly and kind.

We got to experience a rum tasting at Rum Republic Spice and Sugar Bar.  The tasting was lead by Maria who was very knowledgable with the different rums we tasted and Joeffry from the entertainment staff was there as well to help translate.  Was a very nice experience that ended with some traditional Dominican Republic dancers performing outside in the lobby who were wonderful to watch.

Morning coffee was very nice at Ginger Bar and Anthony never disappointed with his fantastic service there.

The staff and food at Flora, Mascalzone, Blue Agave, Between Lounge Bar, and The Winery were all incredible as well.  I wish I could remember our waiters and staff names but my memory fails me.  Great service though all around and delicious food!

We had an amazing time at Tokimeku.  Not only was the food delectable, the waiters, staff and cook were very entertaining.  Felix, our cook, was so much fun and Luis, our server was hilarious and kept us very happy throughout the meal.

Our visit to Mina, the steakhouse, was equally amazing and our server, Junior, was very nice and accommodating.

Kicks Sports and Fun Bar was always a nice stop for a nightcap before heading back to the room.

The resort was also spacious enough that although there were many guests there, it still felt as if you had the place to yourself.  It was very expansive and gorgeous.  I would definitely return.

reviews.author: Melissa De la Rosa
reviews.text:
Excellent service, not to be missed, thanks to Dennys and Raúl in the 32 Degrees area, very attentive and friendly!

The lobby staff were also top-notch, Dileydi Batista! 1A

reviews.author: Ruben xx
reviews.text:
Since 1994, we've visited various hotels in Punta Cana with family and friends. But we've never experienced service like that of Jorge, Luis, Edy, Víctor, and Quintino. We don't want to leave the Dominican Republic.

Jhonatan

reviews.author: Muskan Harpalani
reviews.text:
A far below expectations, with a few exceptions worth mentioning.

Our recent stay at this Punta Cana hotel was, overall, disappointing. While the surroundings are beautiful and some facilities are well-maintained, the service leaves much to be desired for a resort that promises quality and excellence.

Many of the waiters were rude, with an unprofessional and even offensive attitude at times. Wait times at the restaurants were excessive—more than an hour for breakfast on several occasions—and even then, the orders arrived incorrectly. The most serious incident occurred at the Italian restaurant, where three members of our group suffered food poisoning after dining there. This is unacceptable and should be investigated urgently.

That said, it's also fair to acknowledge those who did their jobs well. Special thanks to Altagracia, Elexander, Jean Carlos, Alberto, and Greivin, who were attentive, friendly, and professional throughout our stay. Thanks also to Teófilo at the pool bar in the Reserve area, who always served us with a smile and excellent service.

Regarding the food options, we particularly liked the Mina restaurant (specializing in meats) and the Mexican restaurant, where the service was more efficient and the food of better quality.

In short: a hotel with potential, but with serious problems in management, staff training, and health and safety. I wouldn't recommend it in its current state unless significant improvements are made.

reviews.author: Mile Ga
reviews.text: We spent a week as a family at Paradisus Palma Real, and it was an incredible experience. They treated us like family, especially Dionys, who provided excellent service! My advisor, Anayely, was the best; she made our stay so enjoyable. Santos was very kind and charismatic, and his service was excellent. Cirilo's service at Kana was impeccable, and Rossana was amazing with my children. There were many more, and everyone made it my best vacation of the year—an absolutely wonderful experience.

reviews.text: Wonderful experience at this resort.  We were in the Reserve section and the service and accommodations were top notch. reviews.author: Renee Michelle
reviews.text: I needed this trip. I lost my brother, my mother, 2 cousins, a beloved aunt and my job all in 18 months, among other troubles. At check-in, it was recommended to my MIL Sylvia and I, seeing as we have stayed at Paradisus Palma Real several times before, to upgrade to the Reserve. We are so grateful that we accepted. It opened up for us more restaurants, private spaces, and a private concierge among other surprises. Reynaldo, Gustavo, Berneli at Sante are delightful. Rafael was our angel concierge at the beach. Kelvin was our experience manager, and everyone was wonderful with flawless communication. Alba at the Yhi spa is an experience not to be missed. Every space was spotless, I was comfortable going barefoot everywhere. The accomodations were 5 star. I was very pleased to see Melia choosing environmentally sustainable choices for amenities. Everyone makes magic here, with a sweet spirit. I am crying as I type this. 💠😭💠 We cannot come back soon enough. God bless the Dominican people.

reviews.author: Luis Carlos Zavala Manzano
reviews.text: Excellent service, especially on the beach. Arisleida was particularly helpful. The staff was very friendly. All within the Meliá's standards. Highly recommended. The best beach in the Caribbean. Luckily, we had fantastic weather.

reviews.author: Adriana Alejandra Manzano Guerrero
reviews.text: Excellent service and Arisleida was very kind and attentive at all times; she helped us on the beach.

reviews.author: Paula Maldonado
reviews.text: The room was lovely. But the service was terrible. You have to ask for everything a thousand times, and even then they don't deliver. Basic things. In the restaurants, they turn off the air conditioning and take forever to bring the food—an hour and a half. The staff are unhelpful, with bad attitudes and a negative demeanor.

reviews.author: Maria Aurora Cuan
reviews.text: Ramón Rivas provided excellent service, a great sense of humor, and a positive attitude; we loved the attention.

reviews.author: Denise Lawson
reviews.text: Johnathan and Jorge are the best swim up pool bartenders.  Very in tentative and make you feel really good and make really good drinks.

reviews.author: Heather Ratkiewicz
reviews.text: Rosanna is excellent!  Best of the best!!  We miss her!

reviews.author: Jeff Ratkiewicz
reviews.text: Rosanna is the absolute best!  We love her!  Best service and best smile ever!

reviews.author: Federico Jose
reviews.text: Fantastic experience and for Guillermo Joshua, who has served us extraordinarily well. I earnestly request a promotion.

reviews.author: lucy pereira iglesias
reviews.text: Very good resort. Excellent service. From the entertainment staff and waiters to the cleaning staff, reception, and waiters... Guillermo Joshua is a great professional, attentive, and resourceful—a delightful person.

reviews.author: Gustavo Pimenta
reviews.text:
Excellent poolside bar. Great service.

Special mention to Jonathan and Jorge. Those guys are fantastic!!!

reviews.author: Brian Pilkington
reviews.text:
I stayed at the Paradisius Palma Real for 10 days. Just returned on the 20th of July. Cristian was my concierge, he was awesome. He did everything he said he was going to do was always there if we needed anything. Took care of all of our dinner reservations. Checked in with us at least once a day through text and then usually stop by to see us during the course of the day.
We ateed all the a la carte restaurants for dinner because he was able to take care of our reservations and we did not have a bad meal the entire time we were there.

reviews.author: Mehul Desai
reviews.text: This was my 4th stay at an all inclusive resort with my wife and two sons. Our concierge, Cristian Gonzalez, went above and beyond to make sure we had an amazing experience. The best concierge so far. Our room had a small balcony compared to the photos and he found additional rooms to make sure it met our needs. He made all of dinner reservations and would check in at the restaurants to make sure we got a table. The resort is clean and quiet. It doesn't have as many activities as others we've been to, but we liked it. There were no lines at the various bars, which was great. The main pool is huge and didn't feel crowded during peak hours. If we had to complain about anything, we wish the main buffet would be available for dinner. As vegetarians, we find it easier to find food we like and can eat at buffets. Additionally, the hot tube on our balcony nor the tub in our bathroom held any water. The drain always stayed open. We didn't mention it to anyone there so can't say they didn't address the issue, but when paying $3,000+ I would like for these items to be tested and maintained.

reviews.author: Jorge Reyes
reviews.text: A true 5-star resort. Very close to the beach, with great pools, good bars with premium liquors, and a variety of activities to entertain children and adults. The service was good.

reviews.author: Helen Carrillo
reviews.text:
We stayed two nights at Paradisus Palma Real and had the best time, especially at the 90 Degrees swim-up bar in the adults-only pool. We spent most of our day there and were lucky to be served by two amazing bartenders, Leticia and Greivin.

They were so fun, charismatic, and attentive — seriously, no one ever had an empty drink. They created such a welcoming and lively vibe that we only left the pool to eat and stayed until it closed every day.

If you’re visiting, definitely check out the 90 Degrees bar and hope you get Leticia and Greivin — they made our experience unforgettable!

reviews.author: Barbario
reviews.text:
If you’re looking for an unforgettable day at the pool, 90 Degrees delivers — and the real stars of the show are Greivin and Leticia. These two are top-tier bartenders who bring energy, charisma, and killer cocktail skills to the table.

From the moment we arrived, they made us feel like VIPs. Our drinks were never empty, service was lightning fast, and the stories they shared? Absolutely hilarious and surprisingly heartfelt. They kept our whole group entertained without ever missing a beat behind the bar.

Whether you’re there for a casual drink or a wild night out, Greivin and Leticia know how to read the room and elevate the experience. Great drinks, great vibes, and hands-down some of the best bar staff I’ve ever encountered.

Highly recommend if you’re in the area — and especially if you want your night handled by professionals who know how to mix both drinks and a good time.

reviews.author: larry fee
reviews.text:
We were at paradisus Palma real with our kids and grandkids for a week in July of 25.
The resort itself was great!  We had 2 deluxe suites and 2 two bedroom suites.  Accommodations were large, clean and well appointed.   The pools, beachfront, and restaurants were all wonderful.
What really stood out was the staff.  Our concierge for the week was Zanovia.  She was soo attentive.  Took  care of dinner reservations,  helped with transportation,  and personally took charge of throwing two birthday celebrations for us!  Cannot say enough things about how helpful she was!
All the staff was great!  Richard at the front, Arisleida at the pool/beach, and the lady at the buffet ( whose name I didn't get).
We'll go there again!

reviews.author: Rolvin Garcia
reviews.text:
The best service experience ever! We received such friendly and helpful treatment from Leticia and Greivin at the 90 Decres bar in the Paradisus Hotel. I would definitely repeat this wonderful experience.

Thank you for everything! 🥰

reviews.author: Edgar Zavala
reviews.text:
Amazing experience, I highly recommend this to anyone that’s comes by Resort Paridisus @ the 90 DEGREESE BAR is fantastic. Excellent service and quality by Leticia & Greivin

Thank you for the birthday surprise

reviews.author: Rocio Maria Perez M.
reviews.text: The 90 Decres bar at the Paradisus Hotel is the best experience in terms of quality, service, and friendly staff. Thanks to Leticia and Greivin for their excellent service. The best! 🫶🫶🫶

reviews.author: carolina court
reviews.text: Excellent service! Very attentive! Guillermo Joshua provides incredible service! He was very concerned that our stay was perfect!

reviews.author: Flor Almonte
reviews.text: Great service, great people, great food, great entertainment and super cute property!!! These people will make you feel like home, and like you’re a queen/king! I absolutely loved everyone, specially Jonathan at the swim up pool, Christopher was my concierge and I couldn’t get a better one! He was super helpful throughout my whole stay! I also had the pleasure of meeting a bunch of great human beings including Wanda, Martin, Allan, Jorge, Norjandro, Fernando, Erickson Ramon! They were all great! Definitely will be coming back here 🤗❤️

reviews.author: Danielle Morales
reviews.text: Excellent service!! Very friendly staff. Stood in the swim up suite. Jose and Edison by 34 degrees bar!!!  Are the best!!. Swim up bars are a must love the atmosphere!

reviews.author: Romel Maldonado
reviews.text:
Great experience, my girlfriend and I opted to upgrade to the reserve. The adults only area of the resort. And it was so worth it! With it it included a concierge service. I had a wonderful experience thanks to the concierge. Cristian was incredibly kind and helpful, but what stood out the most was his warm gummy smile — it instantly reminded me of my grandfather, who I loved dearly. It made the interaction feel personal and comforting. Small gestures like that leave a lasting impression.

We went in July and woke up at 5am for the sunrise which can be seen beautifully from the beach area. Not crowded at that time with tons of space to lounge and beds with towels.

Thank you!

reviews.author: Mikaela Ward
reviews.text: Amazing Staff! So nice and caring!!

reviews.author: Justin Stone
reviews.text: Flora restaurant was excellente. We had Caesar as a waiter and he crushed it. Well done

reviews.author: ari
reviews.text: Wanda Rafael Martín and Cristopher were sooooo amazing . Grateful to have been with such an amazing staff . Such an amazing time . Full of life !! This was a great stay . Beautiful beaches , hotels , and people ! Thank you for such An amazing time

reviews.author: Andrew Hill
reviews.text: Alberto and Eddy at the pool bar are great

reviews.author: Carlos Canales / InGe!
reviews.text: Rosanna provided excellent service during our vacation; it was a pleasure to be with her and the entire team during this holiday.

reviews.author: Maria Victoria Issa
reviews.text: The hotel is very nice, it's a shame the service is so terrible. Check-in was delayed by about 20 minutes because they wanted to charge us again for the room. The breakfast service is very slow. We asked for the capsules in our room to be replaced two days ago and nothing has been done. On top of that, it was 3 pm and they still hadn't cleaned our room. Most of the staff are unfriendly. I don't recommend it.

reviews.author: Andrea Lorenzo
reviews.text: We had a lovely time at the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana. We started off in the main adults-only hotel. When a series of things went wrong, we were moved to The Reserve - it was excellent after that. Great service and set up at the pool, lovely staff at Sante including Enrique, Rosa, and Gustavo, among others. I would recommend being at The Reserve.

reviews.author: Juan Jose Wipe
reviews.text: Everything was excellent! Especially the service on the beach, thanks to Ramon Rivas's attention!

reviews.author: Jillian Pencinger
reviews.text: Very friendly staff! We upgraded and it was totally worth it. Sante was so yummy, and Enrique is the most fabulous server, he always made us smile every day. Zenovia was a fabulous concierge, always answering all our questions, reserving yummy dinners, and helping with all our needs! Definitely recommend upgrading to get the concierge as it helps so much to be comfortable when traveling! Pools very clean rooms clean, towels are fresh, service is great at the pool and the boat ride was very fun. You don’t even need to leave even though we did a few excursions provided at the front and it seemed like the best options compared to the beach. The Otium guy (we forgot to get his name) who helped with booking excursions was great and assisted with rides and everything. Overall would recommend for a family, a young couple, or anyone who wants a relaxing week. Party vibes at night and fun dancing but mostly family vibes.

reviews.author: Angela Carroll
reviews.text:
Cons:  bottled waters are never cold! you have to ask for ice every time!   room fridge not very cold.  restaurant portion sizes are very small except for hybachi and steak house.  Deserts are very small as well.   We had teenage boys and it was not enough food for them.   Not much alcohol in mixed drinks.  better off ordering cans.  Needs a bigger sports bar area - it was way too small.  No night club to hang out in.  We  went in July and beach had a lot of seaweed.  we never went in the water - very disappointing.  they were cleaning it up but it remained murky at the shoreline.  Some buffet food is sitting out and it's so hot there I wound't bother to eat certain things if you don't get there early enough.  most staff speaks english but some are very hard to understand.  we all had upset stomachs but never drank the water!

Pros:  Staff very friendly and helpful, some hard to understand.  Neat and clean beautiful resort.  Excellent entertainment at night!  Alot of fun!  Food was fairly good but didn't care for a few things.  buffet has a large selection.  Best food was hybachi,  steak house and italian (small portions tho). didn't care for mexican restaurant.  large beautiful pools.  Had to get a spot early at main pool.  beach has tons of spots with shade.

reviews.author: Chris Manning
reviews.text: The staff at Sante was incredibly respectful. Anything you needed they would get to make sure you have the best experience ever. Enrique was the best very funny and love doing his job. We came for almost every meal to see him and the staff. 10/10 would recommend to anyone

reviews.author: Rodrigo Leaes
reviews.text: We had an excellent experience at Blue Agave, inside the Paradisus Hotel. The food was delicious, with authentic flavors and impeccable presentation. But what really made the difference was Yamilet's service, who was spectacular from the start. Friendly, attentive, and always smiling, she made us feel right at home. Definitely a place we would return to!

reviews.author: PAULA MONTOYA
reviews.text:
Beautiful hotel, the food is incredible, the drinks and cocktails are amazing, and the staff is super attentive and friendly, especially Fernando (Chipa), a delightful guy who was incredibly helpful at all times. Another special mention for the mattress—it was wonderful!
Without a doubt, a luxurious hotel, highly recommended!

reviews.author: paula hadad
reviews.text: Very good hotel and staff

reviews.author: Jean Luis Marrero González
reviews.text: The best bar and cocktails with a really great attention to detail and Dominican nights, the people is really great and welcoming. Specifically in customer service thanks to Jairo (el animal)

reviews.author: juanca martinez
reviews.text:
Everything was spectacular.
Everything was very special.
Jairo's service was top-notch.

reviews.author: Ivanna Odarba
reviews.text:
We had the the best experience at the Blue Agave Mexican restaurant at the Paradisus Palma Real Hotel in Punta Cana Dominican Republic. All their restaurants are great, but the Blue Agave is the best because of the good food but most importantly because of our server Yamilet ! Super friendly, great food choices and took excellent care of us. Probably one of the best servers I’ve ever encountered.
Check it out for yourselves !

reviews.author: KARINA MORALES SILVA
reviews.text: Wonderful stay at Paradisus and everything was excellent, especially the attention and kindness shown by Rosanna at the pool… I highly recommend it!

reviews.author: M P

Anthony at ginger coffee bar has always greeted us with warmth and excellent service .
Maria was a cheerful morning welcome. She was the sweetest - lunch box cafe. At 90 degrees- we loved Germaine (sp) offered excellent service.
Room was always clean. Pools were fantastic! Our family enjoyed our vacation. Thank you.

reviews.author: Eli Pawlowski
reviews.text: Antonio, samari, anyi, and clary at the ginger bar were great. Coffee and smoothies were amazing. Great stay. Rooms were good enough and food was good enough but drinks and pool were amazing.

reviews.author: Giovanni O
reviews.text: We had a great time at the paradise Palma Real. The rooms are beautiful. The service is excellent and the food is extremely delicious. You love the accommodations the pool, the beach everything is top-notch. I highly recommend it. Also if you’re in the pool area, please visit Rosanna, She will get you the best drinks with the most beautiful smile thank you for all your service.

reviews.author: Kevin Super

reviews.author: Paul Quintero
