reviews.text: Ginger bar awesome service! Specially Luis Vilorio… Andreina and Lucia… kind and warm people!

reviews.author: Danney Nunez
reviews.text: The best service overall came from the amazing Jairo. He was always attentive and made sure we were well taken care of at all times. His warm personality and dedication truly made us feel special. Without a doubt, he’s one of the best we’ve encountered. Jairo deserves every recognition and perk you can offer—he absolutely earned it!

reviews.author: Dennis Dacquel
reviews.text: Marileisy was awesome! Great service and attentive!

reviews.author: Damien Druce
reviews.text: Marileisy and Teófilo at the Palma Real Reserve Pool were so attentive whilst we were there. All done with a smile on their faces, look for these two beautiful human beings if you visit.

reviews.author: Sofia Fernandez
reviews.text: Jesús was amazing and very sweet we made bracelets and painted pictures it was all around a fun and beautiful time

reviews.author: Anvar Raufov
reviews.text: Awesome place.  Great family resort. Shout out to my man Teofilio. Good job.

reviews.author: Susan Diaz
reviews.text: Enrique and Idelka are the sweetest people at Sante (the Mediterranean restaurant)!!! Attentive and truly helpful. And today we haven't forgotten Juan 🙂

reviews.author: faty Braz
reviews.text:
Amamos o resort, tudo muito bonito e de muita qualidade! Os restaurantes para jantar são de alta qualidade,  o Mina (de churrasco) e o Blue Agave (de mexicano) com o atendimento do Melqui que fez toda diferença, o Tokimeku (asiático) um show a parte com o Felix fazendo e apresentando os pratos, recomendo. Os quartos e áreas comuns são simplesmente sensacionais!
Queria agradecer especialmente o Melqui do Blue Agave com sua simpatia e atendimento, Melvin do restaurante Mina, que nos proporcionou o melhor drink e o Felix do Tokimeku com suas apresentações gastronômicas, que foram espetaculares. No bar da piscina Jorge e Jonathan excelentes com seus drinks e atendimento.Sempre um funcionário perguntando se está tudo certo, muito atenciosos e preocupados em oferecer uma ótima estadia.
Recomendamos

reviews.author: Krishna Patel
reviews.text: Beautiful resort, amazing service and food. Great location! Loved it! Sante is an amazing restaurant in the resort. They prepared a wonderful meal especially for us after we told them we are vegetarian and the service was great!

reviews.author: Ankit Patel
reviews.text: Great experience and service. We absolutely loved it. The staff was really great and addressed all our needs. Highly recommend Sante restaurant while you are there. The chef and the staff is phenomenal and prepared a great meal for us.

reviews.author: Alicia Ceda
reviews.text: My husband and I visited Paradisus Palma Real and had a fabulous and relaxing vacation. All of the staff were polite, friendly and helpful. You can really tell that they just want everyone to fully enjoy their vacation. There were many good activities and restaurants were easy to book. Two people particularly made our stay extra special, Vanessa from the beach bar and Wander from the buffet/snack bar. Both Wander and Vanessa made sure that we wanted for nothing and had the best time. They were so helpful, friendly, and fun, they truly made us feel welcomed and like family. With service like they provided, I would definitely go back and recommend the resort to others.

reviews.author: miky silva
reviews.text:
Hotel is beautifulll, staff is excellent.
Kanna restaurant is very good, Stormin will help you decide among the options, also the other staff is very deligent and nice.

reviews.author: David de Sá Antunes
reviews.text: The staff at the pool bar, Jorge and Jonathan Viotor Luiz Quintino and Alberto, were very nice people and served us very well. Congratulations to the professionals!

reviews.author: Lindsey Ransom
reviews.text: Very good experience. Both of my boys had an amazing time at kidsdom and made new friends as well!

reviews.author: ashlie beiter
reviews.text: The staff here made me feel like a queen. My converge was Zendova and she provided so much care i felt like we were friends.

reviews.author: Emilyx Florencio
reviews.text: A very good experience, Alexandra and her team at the Kids Club are excellent, the children loved them.

reviews.author: Francisco Garcia
reviews.text: Excellent hotel, excellent service, thank you so much for everything!! Derny provided very good service at the 32 Degrees bar; we enjoyed it very much.

reviews.author: Sofi García Galán
reviews.text: Everything was great, the facilities, the view and the service, especially from Derny at the 32 Degrees bar, who was very friendly.

reviews.author: Daniel Bautista Lopez
reviews.text:
The service was terrible. Only the reception staff and bartenders treated me well. The food was nowhere near what I expected for spending $571 for one night. I must say the room was very comfortable, but I would have preferred to sleep on hot asphalt at noon as long as I was treated well and had good quality, tasty food. I ordered room service—what a mistake! The man who answered the phone treated me like I was his hostage, and I'm begging him for a little food after a month of being held captive. In short, I doubt there's anyone in charge of quality at that resort, but if there is, I'd completely rethink the operation of this all-inclusive. And if an investor reads this, I would recommend they withdraw all their assets from this hotel—fast! It's a ticking time bomb.

Daniel López - stayed in room 3314 from July 12-13, 2025

reviews.author: Tauland Hoxholli
reviews.text: This place is amazing! Restaurant Kanna is amazing. Louis did a great job serving is. The entire staff was very good. Louis you are a rockstar

reviews.author: Jaci Silva-Netto
reviews.text:
We are still here at the resort but I needed to make a review for Jesus at the pool area. He is fantastic and made sure everyday to take care of us. Always checked in on us and made sure my son (6) always had
His favorite smoothies. He even secured us seats by the pool. Love his attention to detail and going above. Remember ask for Jesus at the main pool area!

reviews.author: Daniela Alarcon
reviews.text: I'm leaving this comment emphasizing Melvin from the Rum Republic bar, the driest and very good at his job, he serves with kindness regardless of the color of the bracelet, the best of all.

reviews.author: Haley Ruvalcaba
reviews.text: Anhelo was amazing very attentive always making sure we were well feed and had drinks would definitely recommend and come back, resort was clean, food was amazing!

reviews.author: Veronica Ruvalcaba
reviews.text:
Everything was great! Excellent service from everyone.
Angelo provided great service on the beach with food and drinks. We'll be back whenever God wills!

reviews.author: Yanira C. Diaz
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ An unforgettable experience thanks to Idelka and Enrique!

We had the privilege of enjoying a spectacular dinner at the Sante restaurant, located within the Paradisus resort in the Dominican Republic, and what truly elevated our experience was the exceptional service provided by Idelka and Enrique.

From the moment we arrived, Idelka greeted us with charming warmth and elegance. Her attention to detail, her knowledge of the menu, and her constant smile made us feel like VIP guests. Every recommendation she offered was spot-on and helped us fully enjoy each dish.

For his part, Enrique demonstrated impressive efficiency and a friendly yet professional demeanor. He was always attentive without being intrusive, anticipating our needs and ensuring that everything flowed perfectly. His manner was respectful, cheerful, and genuine.

They both worked with impeccable coordination, creating a welcoming, friendly, and refined atmosphere. The love and passion they put into their work was evident!

We would recommend Sante a thousand times over, but above all, we recommend asking to be served by Idelka and Enrique. They made our evening truly memorable and worth repeating.

Thank you for making our experience so special!

reviews.author: Wilmer Rodriguez
reviews.text: Sante Mediterranean Restaurant. Excellent service, good food, and atmosphere. Idelka and Enrique served us and were attentive to our preferences at all times.

reviews.author: julian vasquez
reviews.text: Idelca was excellent and Enrique was always professional.

reviews.author: Leslie Ruvalcaba
reviews.text:
Muy bien todo! Angleo los estaba manteniendo muy bien con bebidas y comida. El buffet was very good and had so many options for everyone. Everyone was so inviting and felt very safe for the whole family!
Amazing drinks and the sports bar was great to just walk in and grab a quick one!
Primera ves pero no la última🤗🤗

reviews.author: Faby
reviews.text: Wonderful. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Jair Montalvo Hernández
reviews.text: My stay at the Hotel Palma Real was excellent, and a large part of that experience was due to the incredible service from the staff. From day one, everyone was kind, attentive, and always willing to help. However, I want to give a very special mention to Guillermo Joshua, who truly stood out for his professionalism and warmth.

reviews.author: Lucio Risini
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time, right on the sea, with large desalinated water pools, a buffet, and a variety of restaurants, all offering excellent dishes and friendly, efficient service. The kindness and dedication of the staff ensured a relaxing stay at all times. The poolside bars were fantastic, where you can sip a piña colada while soaking in the water on comfortable stools in the shade. We could have stayed a little longer!

reviews.author: Katharine Pichardo-Erskine
reviews.text: Such a great stay for the entire family! The RESERVE adults only experience is exclusive. Jendry, our concierge, was super attentive and ensured we had an amazing time. The regular rooms are well-appointed too and we had activities for both young and old. The service all around was great. Yiri at the sports bar went out of her way to make us feel special. The food was delicious and plentiful in every restaurant. A great experience all around!

reviews.author: FRANCES GONZALEZ
reviews.text: Italian Restaurant - Delicious food. The waiter Felix was very attentive. He had extensive knowledge of the menu. The food arrived quickly. Excellent atmosphere.

reviews.author: elisa risini
reviews.text:
We had the absolute best time — not just because of the beautiful location and the amazing resort, but mostly because of the incredible staff who took such great care of us and made us feel completely at home.

My family and I want to give a big thank you to a few special people who really made our stay unforgettable. For us, true luxury is all about how people make you feel, and this team went above and beyond.

First, a huge shoutout to Fernando Chiva — thank you for your energy, your positivity, and all the thoughtful little details that made such a difference. To Eddy at the main pool bar — thanks for making the best Cocoloco and for always being such a great person to chat with in the mornings. And to the two awesome guys at the winery — we could have talked with you for hours about wine and local Dominican traditions. Your great wine recommendations and warm conversation made every visit something we looked forward to.

And of course, thank you to everyone else who greeted us with a smile and made us feel the warmth and kindness of the Dominican Republic.

We’re already looking forward to coming back!

reviews.author: Pier Cas
reviews.text: Angelo was an absolutely awesome with making us feel at home here in Melia Palma Real. Top notch service, great quality products!

reviews.author: Jane Isobell
reviews.text: Rossana, Maria, and Luis treated us with great warmth and were very attentive in considering the special requests we made.

reviews.author: Aminta Lapaix
reviews.text:
Sante Restaurant.

Excellent service, friendliness, and a warm welcome.
Thanks to Wendy and Enriqueta for always greeting us with a smile.
See you soon! 🖐️

reviews.author: Lisa Latirofian
reviews.text: Great poolside service from Rosanna and Jesus!! They always made sure we had a great experience by the pool and somewhere to sit.they were wonderful. Look out for them when you come. And the kidsdom activities with Martha and the rest of the staff were excellent!

reviews.author: Elli Valdez
reviews.text: The kids club is excellent, the staff are very friendly, especially Martha, unlike the restaurant service which is very poor, not to say nonexistent, from the waiters.

reviews.author: Jaime Cadena
reviews.text: We were accompanied throughout our stay by Reynaldo Martínez. We ran into him at every restaurant, and he provided personalized service every time. Besides the hotel being excellent, he added so much value to our trip, exceeding all our expectations. We had stayed at the hotel last year, but meeting Reynaldo this year made our experience far superior. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Natalie Price
reviews.text:
Me, my husband and our son spent 7 days in the Reserve side of the resort. We thoroughly enjoyed our time there. Rafael with the beach crew was absolutely amazing!! He had us setup in the same spot on the beach everyday. He knew what we drank and had our drinks ready for us when we arrived. He was so friendly and always welcomed us with a smile and high five. The other beach crew were also helpful and willing to help if needed.
We really liked having the private pools in the reserve and the private area of the beach with the cabana.
Our concierge Alam was the best! He was always readily available. Our son’s room had a big water leak and he made sure to get him a new room quickly. He checked in with us multiple times a day and made sure we had reservations for dinner each night.
The overall resort was nice, not overly crowded, it was relaxing and fun at the same time.

reviews.author: aurenny mesa
reviews.text: Bluagabe good service attended by Mr. Santos, good atmosphere and tasty food and Virtudes good service.

reviews.author: Doriceli Méndez
reviews.text: We went to the Mexican restaurant (Blue Agave) and Mr. Santos served us very kindly!

reviews.author: Christian Ramos Baez
reviews.text:
✨ 5-Star Experience at Rum Republic and Restaurant! ✨

I want to give a big shoutout to María, an outstanding bartender at the Rum Republic bar. Her energy, charisma, and mixology skills made every drink feel like a personalized experience. She’s truly an artist behind the bar!

And at the restaurant, Reynaldo provided exceptional service. His attention to detail, kindness, and professionalism made us feel right at home. Top-notch hospitality!

We’ll definitely be back. Thank you for making our visit unforgettable! 💯🍸🍽️

reviews.author: John Kenney
reviews.text: Best family vacation ever!  Our favorite part was the beach every day with beautiful views and amazing service from Yuderi and Martin!  They had our chairs ready for us every morning and just kept checking on us all day!  So nice!  Food is pretty good.  Our concierge, Adriel, was amazing as well.  Especially getting us into the restaurants every night!  Resort is truly beautiful and we want to come back!

reviews.author: ana paula ribeiro melo
reviews.text:
The staff from the activities: Yayaya, Fernando, Joel, Figther, Rafael, and Jairo, made all the difference in our fun. Very polite, attentive, fun, and sensational.
The Kingsdom staff: Jesus, Martha, Lisbe, Alexandra, Charline, Lorena, and Yesmaily brightened and colored our daughter Raquel's vacation, who loved meeting and spending these days in their company.
At all our meals, we were served with great affection and attention by Betty, Edsson, Luiz, Franklin, and Arileida.
In short, a place to rest, play, have fun, and spend wonderful moments with the family.
We will certainly return with the family, God willing.

reviews.author: Julia Cash
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful and kept very clean. The staff is VERY kind and friendly, as well as helpful. The food is great, too, with tons of options available. My family upgraded to the Reserve group, and it was amazing. Our personal concierge, Adriel Cabrera, was fantastic. He made our meal reservations, gave us a personal tour of the resort, and was a friendly face during our stay. I also enjoyed Yuderi and Martin, bartenders at the Reserve beach. They were so kind and helpful! Also, Fernando was a great staff member. He went on a catamaran with us and became a friend!

reviews.author: Morgan Kenney
reviews.text: Yuderi & Martin provided wonderful service for us at the reserve beach and pool, and they always were so kind and had fun energy! I always felt cared for and enjoyed talking with them! Our concierge, Adriel, was so helpful with getting our dinners scheduled and was always a lot of fun to talk to. The staff set the tone of a fun and welcoming environment where you feel cared for receive excellent service. We went on a catamaran excursion with Fernando, who did every activity with us, including swimming and hanging out with us. I would come here again in a heartbeat!

reviews.author: kiara edmunds
reviews.text: my amigo alberto is the best. he is the bartender at the pool bar celsio and he brings the best drinks and energy!!!! he has a great smile and is lots of fun!!! try and get him if you can as a tender! everyone at the bar celsius is amazing! also victor was great and deserves a shout out too

reviews.author: ROCKY ENCARNACION
reviews.text:
Once again, I returned to the Paradisus Palma Real Hotel, and as always, the magic began from the very first moment. Upon entering the Ginger Bar, the beloved Antony, with his unique charisma and unforgettable smile, recognized me instantly. That sincere and spontaneous gesture made me feel valued and welcomed, right at home. What a privilege to be received with such warmth!

Shortly after, Ismael, always impeccable and passionate about his work, also greeted me enthusiastically. Both are true ambassadors of service excellence, and seeing how they remember guests by name and preference is simply admirable.

I also want to extend my appreciation to Luis (captain), Margaret (waitress), and Inés (activities coordinator), whose professionalism and kindness complete this enchanting experience, accompanied as always by the musical atmosphere that transforms the Ginger Bar into a magical corner.

Thank you for continuing to make each visit unforgettable. I'm already counting down the days until I can return!

reviews.author: Tati Garcia
reviews.text: Ismael, Anthony and Luis are the best great people great drink and even better service.  Olga and Quintino at the adult pool are also some of the best people we have meet.  Ask for them on your next visit

reviews.author: Antonio Augusto Viana
reviews.text:
The hotel and the beach are amazing. The sea and pool water is warm and very pleasant to spend hours laughing.
We were well taken care of throughout the hotel, and I want to send a special hug to our friends at GingerBar, who are the most cheerful team, son los más cheveres. Incredible drinks, plus they lovingly taught my son Gabriel how to prepare the cocoloco and the piña colada. A big hug to Antonio, Ismael, Dominga, Jorge and Clari. A hug also to my concierge Juan Castillo who helped get the best times at the restaurants.

reviews.author: Camila Mejia
reviews.text: Sante Restaurant: Enrique's service was exceptional!! The best service.

reviews.author: Fabio Carvalho
reviews.text:
The COST is not worth the BENEFIT in THE RESERVE package!

I stayed from June 4th to 18th, 2025 and did not have a good experience.

Bad check-in, dirty room, and a 1 hour and 30 minute delay to change rooms. They wanted to put us in an inferior room; we insisted that this was not what we paid for. Terrible welcome!

Halfway through the stay we upgraded our room and had to wait 4 hours for the new suite to be available, which could have been an attempt to correct the terrible check-in experience, but it didn't happen!

Again, dirty room, unsanitary minibar!

Nothing new, bad experience!

Bad reception, unprepared staff!

Concierge doesn't work, only makes restaurant reservations!

Pool/beach service does not include food.

Room service does not include alcoholic beverages in the all-inclusive package.

Vouchers earned only work if you pay something in cash!

During a day trip provided by Meliá at the hotel next door, I received terrible service from the beach manager, Hulery Gonzales, which made me cancel the trip and return!

It could have been better!

FC

reviews.text: My wife and I spent an amazing 5 days 4 night at Paradisus Palma Real. Everything was fantastic. Our concierge, Alam, made our stay exceptional. He took care of our every need. We got several upgrades through the hotel's partnership with American Express, so that was a great bonus. I highly recommend this report for families and adult-only travelers. Most of the spaces are mixed, but there are adults only segregated pools and guest rooms. Don't miss out on getting massage at the spa!

reviews.text: Five days of pure peace and happiness at this dream resort! I especially want to thank the KICKS SPORTS BAR, which had the BEST drinks and the best Coca-Cola, just like in Brazil! reviews.author: cesar zayas
reviews.text:
⭐ 1 star
📍 Paradisus Royal Club Golf Resort – Punta Cana

A disastrous experience.
We received the worst service we've ever had at a hotel, especially as a family with children celebrating a birthday. From 6:00 pm until midnight, we were left without a room, despite having a full reservation. No one helped us, no one offered any solutions. The staff was indifferent, rude, and completely unprofessional.

The rooms they finally offered were dirty, smelled bad, and were completely neglected. The food was cold and of poor quality, and the service in the restaurants was slow and disorganized.

Furthermore, the hotel is not safe for families. We saw suspicious people, inappropriate behavior, and even what appeared to be drug sales within the hotel. It's unbelievable that this happens in a place that claims to be 5 stars.

There is no peace and quiet, no attentive service, no quality. All there is is terrible management and an unpleasant atmosphere. We feel completely cheated. This is not a 5-star hotel—it barely reaches 2.5 stars.

👉 I wouldn't recommend it to anyone. We'll never return.

reviews.author: Gabrielle Pereira
reviews.text: We loved the resort, everything was beautiful and of very high quality! We spent a lot of time at Kicks, the resort's sports bar, because it has the best atmosphere and the best bar. I especially want to thank Elidania and Luís, who provided us with the best drinks! The best restaurants for dinner are Mina (barbecue) and Blue Agave (Mexican), and the rooms and common areas are simply sensational! I already want to go back!

reviews.author: Marlene Zuñiga
reviews.text:
An Unforgettable Experience at the Ginger Bar

Ismael, Dominga, Clari, and Margaret from the Ginger Bar staff treated us incredibly well. Everyone was so friendly. An unforgettable experience. We really enjoyed the service and the variety of drinks and food :) We highly recommend coming here to try the diverse selection of drinks. Of course, we ordered lots of micheladas!!!

reviews.author: Tiffany Beltre
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5 – Awesome Sports Bar at Paradisus Palma Real!

Kicks Sports Bar is a great spot to hang out if you’re staying at Paradisus Palma Real. Elidania was absolutely the BEST bartender. She made me fall in love with Gin & Tonic. The energy is fun and relaxed, with tons of big screens showing all kinds of sports — perfect for catching a game or just chilling with friends.

The service was excellent — super friendly and fast. Our server made us feel right at home, and the drinks were on point. The cocktails were well-made, and the local beers were served ice-cold.

The food was surprisingly great for a bar setting! We had the wings, sliders, and nachos — all delicious, fresh, and full of flavor.

There’s both indoor and outdoor seating, and the music added a nice vibe without being too loud. Whether you’re into sports or just looking for a cool place to relax, Kicks is definitely worth a visit.

Highly recommend checking it out while you’re at the resort!

Shout out to a few other special people who helped make the week wonderful.  Arisleida and Yefry who took care of us poolside, Robinson at the Spa, Luis boundless energy at lunch at Kanna, Maximo and Ismael outstanding dinner service.
The property itself is beautiful, rooms spacious and comfortable, food options endless and excellent, great activities and entertainment, but the service is what sets this place a level above, really wonderful people!

reviews.author: Felipe Gallo
reviews.text: It's difficult to rate this hotel because if you compare it to other famous chains like Riu, Iberostar, or Wyndham, this one is far superior. But to truly compare it, you have to do so with an ultra-luxury hotel, and I don't think it even comes close. However, if you're considering it over one of those, don't hesitate. This is the one. The rooms are modern, enormous, and the amenities are luxurious. The food at the à la carte restaurants is very good, and the buffet is average. The cocktails and the staff's service in general are outstanding. They treat you very well. The kids' club is also fantastic. My 4-year-old daughter didn't want to leave. As for the beach, if you go during sargassum season, this is the best because they have a barrier that protects against the seaweed. reviews.author: David McCracken
reviews.text: Highly recommend this resort, however I must be fully transparent about my review. We were on property for a short stay which was a benefit of my company making reservations at this property for some of our clients. I have no doubt that the service for everyone else Would have been equal to our better than the service we received but just want to make sure that readers of this review are aware of how we came to this property. We arrived for our three nights stay and were greeted at the check-in with a delicious refreshing welcoming drink, nonalcoholic. Our room was not quite ready however the staff directed us to one of the restaurants where we had lunch waiting for our room to be ready. We did receive an upgraded room which was the swim up suite in the family section. This room was absolutely amazing, being able to walk right out of bed a few steps and into the pool was incredible. Once our room was ready staff came and got us we got into our room we provided information about some of the events were happening on property we put on our swimsuits and began to enjoy but at that time seem to be our private pool. There was a large group on property which was using the convention center facilities which made the property seem less occupied. We were also there during one of the slower seasons so things may be slightly different and the busier seasons. The food and the à la cart restaurants was outstanding. The buffets were above average and typical buffet environment. The fresh omelettes were delicious and hot most all of the food during breakfast or lunch on the buffets was good and they seem to keep it rotating in and out. As mentioned it was not as busy so all of the buffets were not open at the same time although we were able to experience each of them on different days. The beach was wonderful lots of lounge chairs, this was during Sargasm season and they had the beach as clean as I believe they could keep it. Their barriers did a good job of keeping the sarcasm off of the beach and out of the water closest to the beach however there was still sarcasm around which is to be expected during the season. But that being said they were more than enough swimming pools and lounge chairs at the pools to enjoy them and also enough lounge chairs on the beach to enjoy the beach. Our checkout process was seamless we checked out online our luggage was picked up tagged and waiting for our transfer to the airport. A couple of things to keep in mind when you do the online checkout security will probably want to see the Email  before you leave the property. Also even though tipping is not required we felt very generous and blessed to have been able to stay there so we did tip most of the staff make sure you have plenty of ones as change was a little difficult to come by. Holly recommend reserving a room and upgrading to concierge service our concierge Eriol was amazing Definitely worth the extra cost in my opinion. We will return and continue to offer this property as one of our favorite for our clients

reviews.author: Ana Assis
reviews.text:
Our experience at Paradisus Palma Real was truly exceptional from start to finish. Every detail from booking to check-out, was handled with professionalism and care, making our stay unforgettable for the entire family.

As loyal Circle by Meliá members since 2007, we are always impressed by the consistent excellence, personalized service, and warm hospitality that keep us coming back.

From the moment we arrived, check-in at the private lounge was smooth and welcoming. Our suite was immaculate, spacious, and beautifully maintained. Our concierge ensured every detail was taken care of, from special surprises to dinner reservations.

The staff is the heart of this resort. A few standout names:
•	Julia at Bar 36 Degrees provided incredible service with a warm smile.
•	The Entertainment team—Soranyi, Jairo, Jesus, Fernando Chipa, and Mr. AYAYAY—brought energy and joy daily. They were fantastic with our children and made us feel like family.
•	Soranyi and Joanna Santana at the Kids Club created a fun and nurturing space our child loved.
•	At Yhi Spa, Maria, Dorka, and Jaimy gave us the best treatments we’ve ever experienced.
•	Rosanna Hernandez, Osvaldo, and Junior Jose were always friendly and attentive.
•	At Blue Agave, Delvin, Melvin and bartender Salomón (maker of the best Paloma Cocktail) truly impressed.
•	Cocktails at Rum Republic with Juan Vicente was a highlight thanks to his professionalism and creativity.
•	We spent most days at the main pool bar, where Jonathan Rodriguez, Eddy De los Santos, Jorge Chan, Victor Feliz, and Luis Diaz brought fun, hospitality, and top-notch service.
•	Maria, Lucia, and both Luis bartenders at Bar Ginger also provided exceptional attention and care.

Paradisus Palma Real sets the standard for luxury, relaxation, and genuine hospitality. We’re so grateful for another perfect stay and can’t wait to return.

reviews.author: Maria Amelia Machin
reviews.text:
As a travel advisor with over 30 years of experience curating luxury stays for discerning travelers, I’ve learned to recognize the true gems in hospitality — those that go far beyond expectations. Paradisus Palma Real is one of those rare finds.

From the moment you arrive, the experience is elevated. The rooms are spacious, spotless, and thoughtfully designed for maximum comfort. I pay close attention to beds and pillows (a detail my clients know I never overlook), and here, the bedding is simply perfect — soft, supportive, and luxurious.

The layout of the resort makes all common areas easily accessible, inviting guests to relax and move about effortlessly. Whether you’re heading to the pool, spa, beach, or a restaurant, it all feels seamless and serene.

Now, when it comes to all-inclusive properties, people often imagine large quantities of average food — but not here. At Paradisus Palma Real, each restaurant is a fine dining experience. Every dish is beautifully crafted, and best of all, personalized service is at the heart of the culinary journey. The chefs and staff take the time to understand each guest’s preferences, including dietary needs and special touches, delivering meals that feel tailored and memorable.

What truly sets this property apart is the attentive and enthusiastic team. Each guest is cared for by a dedicated staff member who brings genuine warmth, empathy, and joy to their service. Whether you’re traveling solo or with a large family, the staff makes it their mission to ensure everyone feels seen and celebrated.

And the activities? Simply fantastic. They’re diverse, creative, and fun — from relaxing moments to energizing adventures. I was truly impressed by the balance of luxury and playfulness.

✨ In short, Paradisus Palma Real redefines what it means to be all-inclusive. It’s an experience of personalized luxury, heartfelt hospitality, and thoughtful details that make all the difference. Highly recommended.
@viajesprincipal.usa

🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 PARADISUS PALMA REAL: WHERE EXCELLENCE ISN'T OPTIONAL, IT'S A CULTURE

Words cannot adequately describe our experience at the Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort. This is not just a luxury resort… it's a sanctuary of hospitality, dedication, and human excellence. Here, every smile, every gesture, and every detail was executed with heart.

From the moment we arrived, we were welcomed like family by a team that works not out of routine, but out of vocation. I want to give special and lasting recognition to the following stars who made our experience heavenly:

🔹 Antonio, Rodolfo, and Richard, the guardians of welcome. Attentive, helpful, and genuinely kind porters. They were our first impression… and what an extraordinary impression they left!

🔹 In the restaurant area, the incomparable Cirilo shone brightly. A true gentleman of service, he was attentive, respectful, and always present without being intrusive. He was accompanied by Luis, Alexis, Máximos, and the wonderful Arisleida, all committed to providing impeccable service.

🔹 At the Italian restaurant, Daniela treated us with exquisite warmth and elegance. And at the Mexican restaurant, the energy, passion, and good taste were palpable thanks to Milton, Alexander González, and Síguel.

🔹 At the Sports Bar, the atmosphere was elevated by the charisma and impeccable service of Yiri and Fior, who turned every visit into a celebration.

🔹 At the buffet, the service was simply spectacular thanks to the charisma, efficiency, and dedication of Yadiel and Maira. Yadiel stood out for his impeccable presence, always attentive, always willing, anticipating our needs with a genuine smile. And Maira, whose sweetness, warmth, and professionalism left an indelible mark on our hearts. Her dedication wasn't just service; it was love in action. She didn't just work... she made us feel at home, like family.

🔹 Special mention for the talent and human warmth of Creini, Yuleni, Miledy, Laura, and, most especially, Samaria at Ginger Restaurant, who was a true angel to me. I arrived at the hotel with a very bad stomach ache, and it was she who, with a combination of care, experience, and generosity, prepared a home remedy that miraculously relieved my symptoms.

Thank you, Samaria. May God always fill you with health and bless you for your help, your dedication, and your loving service. I will never forget what you did for me.

🔹 And I can't close this review without acknowledging a truly unique person, my coordinator, Dileydi Batista A. A professional like few others, and a human being like no other. Always attentive, diligent, smiling, and resourceful. She helped us with all the dinner reservations at the restaurants and was always attentive to my and my family's every need.

But I also want to express my deepest gratitude for her loving coordination of my sister-in-law's birthday. It was a thoughtful touch that made all the difference and made us feel even more special.
Her support was total, constant, and exemplary in its kindness.

I don't think there's another coordinator like her. Dileydi was a true guide, an ally, and a vital part of making everything perfect. Thank you so much!

And if the resort has a heart, it's embodied by two exceptional men:

💠 Hipólito, head waiter, a truly humble, wise, and deeply respected leader. His example is felt by every member of the team.

💠 José María “Chema,” the soul of the resort. A manager who leads with humanity, who walks alongside his people, not above them. His vision is evident in every corner of the hotel.

The Paradisus Palma Real is not just a place to stay; it's a transformative experience. Here, we weren't guests, we were family. And when you find something like this, all you can say is:

Thank you. We will be back. For the luxury, yes. But above all, for you.

With eternal gratitude,
Nestor Melendez

reviews.author: Kazi Hassan
reviews.text:
My wife, our 17-month-old daughter, and I stayed at Palma Real from June 8–14 in a Junior Suite Swim-Up. I’d like to share an honest review of our experience.

Check-In: Upon arrival, we were warmly greeted by the front desk staff and assisted with our check-in. We had upgraded to a Junior Suite Swim-Up with a king-size bed, but were initially
given a room with two smaller beds. After a long day of travel, we had to request a room change, which was inconvenient but ultimately resolved. For reference, this resort is operated
by Meliá, a Spanish hotel group.

The Room: The room itself was spacious, well-maintained, and well-suited for a family. Housekeeping did a great job keeping it clean. Room service was slower than what we experienced at other resorts (usually 30–45 minutes), but still acceptable. The biggest issue was the air conditioning—it consistently felt warm despite being set to 69°F. It seemed as though the thermostat or AC unit wasn’t functioning properly, and at times the room became uncomfortably hot. The bathroom also had drainage issues; whenever we showered, water would leak into other areas, requiring extra towels to manage the mess. Additionally, although we had mentioned we were celebrating our anniversary, there were no acknowledgments or gestures from the resort, which was disappointing.

The Concierge and Timeshare Experience: Unfortunately, our experience with the concierge was the most upsetting part of our trip. From the beginning, we were persistently approached about attending a Meliá membership presentation. Despite repeatedly declining, we eventually agreed to attend out of courtesy—this turned out to be a major regret. The sales pitch was aggressive and pushy. We made it clear we were not interested in purchasing a $15,000 membership, yet the salespeople continued to pressure us, citing their quotas. During this
presentation, our daughter fell from a chair and injured her forehead, which required attention and has since left a scar. The concierge assured us he would speak with his manager regarding compensation. However, we received no follow-up or support despite repeated communication (we have messages and photos documenting this). After returning home, the concierge reached out, but gave conflicting explanations about the manager’s availability. Ultimately, no compensation or real acknowledgment was provided. We plan to file a formal complaint with Costco, through whom we booked.

The Resort Grounds: The resort itself is beautiful and well-maintained, with plenty of available lounge chairs at the beach and pool, even on busy days. The swim-up suite was a great option for convenience and privacy. That said, there isn’t much catered to young children, and the spa was minimal—more of a massage cabana setup than a full-service spa.

Food and Dining: The dining experience was mixed. The buffet and most restaurants were average—decent, but nothing exceptional. The steakhouse stood out as excellent, and the Japanese à la carte option was also very enjoyable. The coffee shop, Ginger, was fantastic. For contrast, we had an incredible meal off-site at a local Dominican chain, Doña Pula, which we
highly recommend. One frustration was having to make all reservations through the concierge, rather than using an
app or streamlined system.

Wi-Fi: The wi-fi was terrible at this location, if you are planning on using anything please buy your own data.

Summary: While we appreciated some relaxing moments during our stay, there were several shortcomings that left us disappointed. Between the room issues, unfulfilled promises, and especially the negative experience with the sales presentation and lack of follow-up regarding our daughter’s injury, we do not plan to return to this property. We hope our feedback helps future travelers make informed decisions.

We spent 6 days at this amazing hotel and had a fantastic time from start to finish. The food was a definite highlight — with a great variety of delicious options and refreshing drinks available throughout our stay. Even though the Mediterranean restaurant was temporarily closed for renovations, there were still plenty of dining choices to enjoy every day.

The staff were consistently warm and welcoming, always ready to help with a smile. We especially appreciated the cabanas around the pool, which were a lovely touch and made for relaxing afternoons in the sun.

One small downside was that the cabana usage rules weren’t very well enforced. Unfortunately, a particular family managed to reserve the cabana closest to the pool every day, apparently overnight, which was frustrating — especially as I made an effort to be up as early as 6 AM to find a spot. It felt a bit unfair, and I hope the hotel can improve monitoring this in the future so everyone has a fair chance to enjoy these great amenities.

Despite that, we had an overall wonderful experience and would definitely return. Thank you for a lovely stay!

reviews.text: We just spent a week here for our honeymoon and it was nothing short of amazing. We were in the reserve (if you don't have kids, its worth every penny) and our concierge , Yalady was INCREDIBLE. She went above and beyond making sure we had everything we needed from setting up all our dinners, boat rides, special request, etc. My birthday happened to be our last day there and she made it so special, with balloons, cake, champagne, treats. It was something I'll never forget. Pedro was also so exceptional by the beach, always setting us up with towels, drinks and really making us feel welcome. Angelo and Marilesy were also shining stars by the pool and beach checking on us and making sure we had everything we needed. This is one of the few all inclusive resorts with GOOD food. Going to dinner every night to a new place was so fun. Also theres a seaweed boom happening right now where a lot of it washes up on shore and in the water and this resort somehow had none of it, which was amazing. Most resorts are covered in it right now, so beware. Highly recommend this place if you don't want a trashy inclusive experience.

reviews.author: Pablo BC
reviews.text:
We spent 11 days on a family vacation with our two children (8 and 19 months old). We were looking for a hotel with a nursery and hesitated between several… finally choosing Palma Real because they accept children from 1 year old and younger with a nanny hired by the hour.

Highlights:

HOTEL: Perfect. It was renovated a few years ago, so everything is in excellent condition. Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. Extremely attentive and friendly staff. Large hotel without any crowds in any of its areas (pools, bars and restaurants, beach, etc.).

ROOMS: Spacious, bright, and clean, with a bathtub, complimentary minibar service that is restocked every morning, large TV, good air conditioning, and a comfortable bed.

HIGHLIGHTS:

- The nursery staff (essential for us so that our children could enjoy their first vacation) were a real treat; the attention from each member of the team was outstanding. How loving and attentive they were with the children. Always smiling and ready to play with them. They are one of the hotel's greatest assets. Without a doubt, and thanks in part to them, we will be back next year!

- The breakfast staff were all very attentive, but a special mention for Edisson. What a wonderful person, so loving and attentive with our children! It makes waking up to such a pleasant experience.

CONS:

- Perhaps a little slow in resolving issues (sometimes you have to call several times or wait an excessive amount of time for them to be resolved).

- They mistakenly took an AirPod along with the sheets when changing them (I've been asking for it for three days) and it still hasn't turned up!

reviews.author: Laura R
reviews.text:
This place is absolutely incredible!!!!  Best resort/rooms we've been in.  Cleanest all inclusive ever (and we've been to several in Mexico).  We stayed in a suite which was perfect for us and our teenager.  Plenty of room.   3 bathroom sinks plus a sink in the kitchenette.  2 doors to balcony.  Perfect shower although short for my 6' 4" husband.  Huge plush bath towels and beach towels.   Tough to get face cloths so you might want to bring your own.   Huge bottles of liquid soap at each sink and lotion so no need to bring your own.

Beach had perfectly powdery sand.  No need for water shoes.... no rocks or shells.  Can't go shelling here if you're looking for that.   Lots of seaweed though although they clean it up daily on the beach... just can't avoid having it in the water,  but you can walk down the beach and find areas with a little less if you want to get into the ocean.

At end of May, this place was practically empty until a convention started and still didn't seem very busy.   No need to reserve beach or pool chairs,  there are plenty!  We even got a Bali bed each day at the pool.... no extra charge and it was the nicest I've been in.  No problem getting as many beach towels as you need.

Lots of pestering of local vendors at the beach.   Little at the hotel,  although Juan from the Ocean club didn't seem to want to leave us alone.   People at the resort are super nice and eager to help although their English here is not as good as in the Riveria Maya.  Large amount of the best looking male workers I've seen at any resort though!  Lol

Brought our own insulated cups,  but they use a lot of paper cups and paper straws here.   Good for sanitary reasons,  but kinda strange drinking out of a paper straw.

Reservations for specialty restaurants were easy to get nightly and the dress was casual which is always nice for my husband.... no need to pack slacks and dress shoes.  Nice shorts were fine.

They play mostly Latin music here which I grew very tired of....only a few English songs sprinkled in here and there.

I wouldn't recommend this place for small children, but fine for teens.  We loved that it wasn't heavily run by kids. Nightly entertainment was lacking... not big productions like other resorts, but again,  that was fine with us.

Resort is smaller than most we've been to,  but we actually loved that as it was big enough,  but not too big.   Didn't have to walk for miles to room or beach.

Loved that we could get to our room and all restaurants under cover in case we had rainy days.....no umbrella needed,  although they provide one in the room.   They had robes and slippers too.

I'm a big soda drinker and they have Coke, Coke Zero, and Sprite (the D.R. versions).  All in bottles instead of fountain so I was especially glad I brought an insulated mug as I would have them fill it with ice because most of the time the soda bottles were warm.

Food was not good here, much better in Mexico, but I found enough I could eat.  As usual,  the specialty restaurants were better than the buffet.   I really missed having an ice cream shop of some sort.  Mini bar was best we've ever had though....had Lays chips, Oreos, and M&Ms along with some local selections of snacks.

Amazing place.   So glad we came and would definitely come back.   If food is a real priority to you,  you will probably be disappointed (although the pineapple is delicious!).

reviews.text:
A disappointing start to our honeymoon

We checked in today for our honeymoon stay. During the booking process, I clearly mentioned that this trip was for our honeymoon, and I even called the hotel to confirm. They told me that as long as we informed the front desk upon arrival, they would take care of everything.

However, the first thing we were met with at check-in was an aggressive attempt to upsell us to a more expensive room for $2,900 USD. When we declined, they kept lowering the price little by little, which felt pushy and insincere.

To be honest, this whole experience drained our energy from the very start. Instead of feeling welcomed and excited, we began our honeymoon with zero morale. Very disappointing treatment from a hotel we expected so much more from on such a special occasion.

Note: I truly hope you will be able to change this perception. I will sincerely update my review after I leave the hotel, based on the overall experience.

reviews.author: N D
reviews.text: I will write a sincere review hoping that the hotel improves things! We stayed there for a week. The hotel is beautiful; you can tell the owner invests a lot of money. Unfortunately, the staff is very poorly trained and managed. They have an app to request amenities (soap, cotton balls, etc.), which I thought was great, but when you make the request online, you never receive anything. The rooms are very poorly cleaned; the floors are never mowed. I asked for a hairdryer three times, and it wasn't until the third day, when I told them they weren't serious, that they finally gave it to me. The buffet is sorely lacking in choice and taste, but the worst part is the sushi, which is inedible. They try to make sushi with leftover cheese and spoiled ingredients. The guacamole is rarely fresh, the potatoes are undercooked, the desserts look nice but tasteless, the meat is undercooked, and so on. The hotel really needs to do something because this is not a buffet worthy of a 5-star hotel. I've eaten better in 3-star hotels. The drinks in the bars are not Famous and very, very diluted, everywhere in the hotel the staff expects a tip to give you even minimal service! We tipped, but it was never enough… On the beach, the only available bar is reserved for The Reserve club. For everyone else, you have to go all the way to the pool for a drink! Between meals, there's nothing to eat; you have to sit in the beach club, which is à la carte, so you have to stay at the table and wait a long time… For room service, I ordered salmon with rice and a cocktail, and I received it with fries, even though I don't eat fried food! The cocktail never arrived. The person who brought my dinner told me I had to go to the bar! So why do you allow this on the app?!!! Your apps are cheating!!! If you want to be a 5-star hotel, you have to earn it and do things properly! Not to mention the staff who harass you to buy a Meliá membership—no thanks, I don't plan on coming back! There were some positive aspects, though: the pools are large and clean, the grounds are beautiful, the beach is lovely and well-maintained, and there are plenty of chairs—no need to get up early to reserve a spot. The à la carte reservation system works well, Patricia is lovely and very professional; she loves her job and puts a smile on the guests' faces. I never had any trouble booking a restaurant; there was always availability. I really enjoyed the à la carte restaurants; the quality is superior to the buffet. It's delicious, fresh, and flavorful—you can tell experienced chefs are behind the dishes, unlike with the buffet. Our favorite was the Mexican restaurant. The hotel is more expensive than other 5-star hotels in the area. We chose it expecting quality and service, but I was very disappointed; nothing justifies the price! This is my honest opinion. We had a nice week, but it could have been better!

reviews.text:
Our family traveled at the end of May 2025 for one week and had a wonderful time. We were a group of 6 adults and two children. We had two deluxe rooms, one king and the other was two double beds and a sofa bed, overlooking the resort where the pool area is. We had one more deluxe King room overlooking the garden view which was nice and quiet. Rooms were spacious, well maintained and clean.

Staff overall was friendly, met us with smiles and a good time. We also did our share of tips which is important in these all inclusive hotels. Antonio the concierge and Luisa the hotel manager had done a great deal by accommodating our every need. They were very pleasant. Antonio sent us the activities for our family to enjoy each day and planned dinner reservations for us.

Shows were great in the evening. Kidsdom offered different activities for kids everyday, from cookie & pizza making, to flying kites and dance parties. They were very involved with the kids, and took good care of them by providing the necessary attention, if we wanted to enjoy a romantic couple's dinner together.

We did not have circle membership, however it seems as it was worth it to purchase to get extra perks such as better quality alcohol and services.

Overall highly recommend.

From the moment we arrived, we were greeted with warm smiles and everyone was available to help us.

We stayed on the Reserve side in a second-floor with garden and pool view. The mini-bar was restocked daily as promised, and the housekeeping service was consistently excellent.

The beach in front of the resort was great and all the pools  was fantastic.

For dining, we especially enjoyed Sante for breakfast and lunch most days, and also had fantastic experiences at Mina, and Flora.

A special shout-out to our concierge, Adriel Cabrera, who went above and beyond to make our stay special. He provided daily updates on activities, made all dining reservations. His thoughtfulness made our trip unforgettable.

All in all, this was a 5-star experience—beautiful property, excellent service, and memories that will last a lifetime.

reviews.text:
Our stay at the Paradisus Palma Real wasn't the best. It was our fifth time with the Paradisus chain, as we've been to the Paradisus Cancun four times (and if we've been there so many times, there must be a reason). From the moment we arrived, no one escorted us to our room; we had to walk a long way in the rain without even knowing the place, since it was our first time. The food, in general, isn't good. The buffet lacks variety, and the lunch they usually serve near the pool as a snack is always in direct sunlight, which isn't good from a food safety perspective. In fact, some people got food poisoning because of it. The service, in general, is listless and unhelpful; you can tell they don't want to work. We saw many hotel employees practically doing nothing, just wandering around. Another issue is that the staff are pushy and rude. For example, on the beach, the vendors are very insistent on selling you activity packages, so much so that if you move, they move too (bordering on harassment), and they don't leave you alone. And in general, the beach vendors are very annoying and persistent. I don't know if they're just in this section of the hotel or in several hotels, but they should limit their numbers because you can't enjoy the beach peacefully without being approached every ten minutes with someone trying to sell you something. In fact, many times we had to leave the beach for another area because it became unbearable, preventing us from enjoying a full day there. Another incident involved one of the employees at the 36 Degrees bar asking me for a review. He was standing next to me watching me fill it out and touched my phone to enter five stars in the different categories, imposing a rating I didn't agree with.

I must admit that the facilities are very nice and spacious, and the evening shows are enjoyable.

They also have a Circle members' area that's practically deserted. I imagine it's not a very popular membership, so the place was always empty and the employees were just standing around looking at each other. I think that, at the hotel chain level, this membership doesn't seem profitable or strategic enough to justify having a dedicated space for it. They could use that space to offer the other guests a different way to enjoy it.

The service in general isn't good, to be honest. Sometimes you have to ask for things or sort things out yourself because the employees often demonstrate incompetence. If I were to return to the Dominican Republic, I wouldn't stay at the Paradisus again.

reviews.author: JAS M
reviews.text:
An unforgettable experience at The Reserve – More than an all-inclusive, a true oasis of hospitality

Our family—my wife, our two teenage daughters, and I—stayed in the exclusive adults-only area of ​​The Reserve, occupying two rooms. From the moment we arrived, we knew we were in a special place. Upon arrival, we were greeted by Mr. Rafelin during check-in, and his warmth, efficiency, and friendliness set the tone for our entire stay. His personalized attention made us feel valued and welcome from the very first minute.

The resort's facilities are simply spectacular: spacious, elegant, impeccably maintained, and with a design that balances luxury with comfort. The location is another strong point: less than 30 minutes from the airport, on a long stretch of clean, white-sand beach, where every corner of the complex exudes order, care, and an absolute dedication to cleanliness.

The rooms are beautifully decorated and very well-equipped: bathtub, shower stall, top-quality bed and pillows, a well-stocked minibar, and a spacious balcony for relaxing with beautiful views and a serene setting.

But what truly made this stay unforgettable was the warmth and friendliness of the entertainment team. Throughout the day, activities are offered for all tastes, and the evening shows are truly outstanding. The entertainment team—Jairo, Jesús, Fernando, Soranyi—and, in particular, the charismatic Mister Ayayay, were the heart and soul of the resort. Their energy, talent, and warmth transformed every activity into a fun and memorable experience. Their skill as a presenter and dancer is remarkable: they elevated our experience to a level we hadn't encountered at other all-inclusive resorts. Thank you, Ayayay, for everything!

As for the beach service, The Reserve boasts what we consider the best bar in the resort. Gilberto, the bartender, prepares excellent drinks, and Rafael provides exemplary service in the beach and pool area, always friendly, helpful, and with a great attitude.

While the experience was mostly positive, there are aspects that could be improved. The service at the buffets and restaurants is inconsistent: it's slow and somewhat disorganized, and in some cases, the waiters' attitude doesn't meet the standard one expects at a resort of this category. This is especially noticeable during longer stays; we were there for 12 days. We also noticed some inefficiency in room service (bar and snacks), as we had to insist on more than one occasion to receive our order.

That said, we want to highlight that both Laura and the Guest Experience Manager, Juan Peña, were attentive to our feedback, showing a genuine interest in improving the guest experience. This attitude, along with everything else we experienced, leaves us with the impression that these details will be addressed and resolved.

With spectacular weather, sargassum-free beaches, multiple pools, creative workshops—from which we took away wonderful memories—and an infectious energy in every corner of the resort, The Reserve is a place we will undoubtedly return to. And we are convinced that next time, it will be even better.

reviews.text:
A Huge Disappointment at the Paradisus Palma Real – Unacceptable Management

We stayed for 10 days at the Paradisus Palma Real hotel in Punta Cana, a trip we were eagerly anticipating, but which unfortunately turned into a huge disappointment due to the poor management and lack of professionalism of some of the staff, especially the person in charge of restaurant reservations and ensuring the well-being and comfort of guests: a man named Gilbert.

Gilbert was, without a doubt, a complete fraud. Throughout our entire stay, he showed absolutely no interest in helping us. He didn't manage our reservations correctly, he didn't answer our questions, and he didn't care about our comfort. He simply ignored us. For a hotel that prides itself on luxury and high-level service, it is unacceptable to have such an incompetent employee in a key position.

In contrast, we want to highlight the excellent service we received at the beach bar. There, Pedro was an exemplary waiter, with a professional, friendly, and approachable manner—someone who clearly has years of dedicated experience. Marcos Ignacio, another waiter, also deserves a special mention: a true professional, always polite and attentive. They were undoubtedly the best thing about the hotel.

The rooms were fine, comfortable, and clean, although the food, frankly, could be much better, especially considering the hotel's level and price.

Another major problem was the "Reserve" service. We paid a significant supplement because there were six of us and we wanted to enjoy this supposedly premium experience. However, we were unpleasantly surprised to find that the "Reserve" area was closed to the public. We were charged for a service that wasn't available, and we weren't even offered a solution or compensation. We felt this was an abuse and a lack of respect for the customer.

In short, the hotel has potential, but the management is terrible in certain fundamental aspects. Gilbert was a complete disappointment, and charging us for the "Reserve" service without being able to use it was a blatant rip-off. Fortunately, staff like Pedro and Marcos Ignacio redeemed the experience, but for the price we paid, we expected much more.

Thank you, Pedro and Marco, for making our stay enjoyable!

reviews.author: Camila Zuleta
reviews.text:
Beautiful and large hotel, although it has some maintenance issues.

Pools: Excellent. Super large and spacious for comfortable swimming. We used the main pool and the one behind our room in building 20. The only issue is that over time the tiles in the main pool are coming loose, and you risk getting hurt.

Common areas: Excellent decor and cleanliness.

Room: Very good. The bathtub in our room was beautiful, ideal for a soak after a day at the beach. Regarding cleaning, we don't know why, but the cleaning person took the hair conditioner on the second-to-last day, but luckily I had brought some from home. Also, one of the first days we found the nightstand on the floor after cleaning and the balcony door open. Room 2037 has some electrical problems, for example, with the air conditioner by the bed, which sometimes displays an error and requires a tap.

Food: Generally very good, especially if you don't have dietary restrictions like me, as I can't eat gluten due to my celiac disease. They should offer more gluten-free options and place indicators on each food item to show whether it's safe to eat or not, so you don't have to ask every two seconds. At breakfast, there were only rice cakes that were like cardboard, and dry bread. Only the first morning we were there were chocolate chip muffins, which were delicious. The next morning they were all gone, and I had to politely ask if they could get me some, and they gave me the last two they had. There's a real lack of information and training about gluten-free options. At the Flora restaurant, I was disappointed. Despite having indicated the day before when we made the reservation that I couldn't eat gluten, when we arrived and reminded them again, I was served toast with regular bread containing gluten, which my husband had to eat. Then, at dessert, I had no choice but to watch my husband eat his. On the other hand, at the MINA restaurant, there was a situation I noticed where the waiter brought my gluten-free bread on the same plate as the regular bread, and the maître d' stopped him, although I realized the mistake. When they brought it "correctly," I didn't eat it because I was suspicious. Otherwise, everything was fine.

They should add more natural juices to the bar. Not everyone drinks alcohol, nor do we all want to drink artificial juices or just water.

The workshop activities are wonderful and highly recommended.

Another thing they should add is bicycles so people can get around the large grounds; it would be a great activity.

Even though we mentioned we were on our honeymoon, we didn't receive any special attention from the hotel, even though we had just stayed at another hotel where they did provide us with thoughtful touches.

I recommend this hotel for couples or groups of friends.

reviews.author: Danny McSwiggan
reviews.text:
Garden view suite Reserved section

Check in: super fast efficient and easy. We never touched our bags and they were delivered to our rooms immediately.

Room service: Called at 11 pm and ordered a burger and Chicken nuggets. The burger was amazing and the nuggets were pure white meat but a bit doughy. Fries were warm. Food arrived in about 20 minutes.

This resort is the closest I have come to a 5 star. Everything seemed classier and we felt like royalty.

I contacted Alvaro Manuel at Reserved Guest Services before arriving and he ensured we had rooms on the second floor, that we were close to our friend who was traveling with us and that our first dinner reservation was made at Santé. He also made sure to come and see us during our stay and make sure we were happy.

Our butler, Harry was superb. He was so refined and personable. He noticed every detail and ensured all our reservations were made, delivered a bucket of ice every evening (usually with a bottle of quite good Chilean Merlot). He was constantly in communication  with us and sent us the reservation confirmation and the activity schedule every day. Such a pleasure. We will request him next time we stay at this resort.

Every single staff member at this resort was amazing. So professional and helpful and there was NEVER and expectation for a tip (although we tried to tip for every meal and service). You get what you give.

The resort is not too big and very walkable. Also very quiet and peaceful and well groomed.

Beach: groomed twice a day with a giant net in the ocean keeping the seaweed out. Plenty of super comfortable beach beds with 8 inch mattresses. Servers will usually follow you to the bed you want and clean it off, than place towels down and ask you for your first drink order. No silly towel rules, just go up to the hut and take what you need. NEVER had a trouble finding a nice comfortable beach bed, even after 10am.

Drinks: Bars are everywhere and getting service is never an issue. Ginger bar in the lobby does amazing coffees and specialty drinks. In the evening at the plaza there is a Mojito cart which does hand crafted specialty mojitos. The resorts frozen Pina Coladas are made with real pineapple and coconut.

Food: loved every restaurant but our favorite was Flora. Such a chill vibe and the food was amazing. Japanese was fun but the food is nothing special. Since we were Reserve, we went to Santé many times for breakfast and lunch. Both were excellent (omelettes, cappuccinos, fruit smoothies and much more). Lunch seemed to feature seafood like lobster, scallops, shrimp, etc and frequently and amazing beef tenderloin. Taco bar day was my favourite. The buffet was always great food but too noisy and chaotic for me. My tip is to sit outside at Kanna (great tacos and pulled pork) and get whatever food you like from the buffet. Ice cream at the buffet was really good. Friday is Dominican Day and the entire plaza is buzzing with vendors and food and drink.

We attempted to take the free/included catamaran trip but it was cancelled due to crappy weather. They provide towels and a snack BTW.

Workshops: 2 or more every day. We did several and they were free and fun. Go early since they fill up.

Nightly entertainment: Some sort of show every night. Nothing spectacular but always entertaining. Several nights had staff in costume taking pics with guest. Dance party outside the sports bar every night from 9 to 11pm.

Got some bug bites at night. My fault since I brought spray but didn't use it. If you don't bring enough sunscreen, you may have to sell a kidney to buy some at the resort store.

Shopping tip: We went to the downtown mall (Jumbo is amazing) and shopped at the 2 malls there. Uber to the mall was about $15 with tip. It was a fun rainy day activity.

Weather: rain forecasted everyday but really only rained one day. Umbrella in the room.

Thanks again Harry for making our stay so relaxing. Reserved Section is the way to go, so deluxe.

reviews.author: Eryia Irving
reviews.text:
Jose Del Rosario y tairo bartender was very nice and personable. He ensured we were taken care of every day. If we ever needed anything he made sure to find a solution to our problems quickly. Jholfry and Fernando from activities team were also amazing! Very enthusiastic and fun! You can tell they truly enjoy what they do and care to make sure others are having a great time. Kelvin our butler through the reserve experience took great care of us as well. He was always a text away and took pride in delivering professional service. Overall a very clean and well kept resort!

Edited post: I made my original post before I left the resort and I just wanted to add in a few more names of the amazing staff I had the pleasure of meeting. So first off Gilberto and Yuderi at 96 degrees beach bar were such an amazing vibe! They will make sure you’re taken care of while you’re relaxing by the beach. Gustavo at Sante was so attentive and kind. We only requested to see him at breakfast due to his care and overall professionalism. And lastly Kelvin our Butler for the Reserve was pretty great as well. He took care of all our reservations and managed any questions/issues we ran into with urgency.

I didn’t get to talk about the food in my original post. But it wasn’t the best. There needs to be more food options throughout the day. The restaurants close too early and often times the food was served cold (specifically at Kanna). In the Lunch Box there was a server that had the worst attitude possible. He cooks the steaks and hamburgers.  He needs to be fired but he wasn’t wearing a name tag so I’m not sure who he was. The room service menu needs to be updated to include more options as well. If they get the food situation together the resort would legit be a 10/10 for location, beach access, staff, security (they don’t play around and they take pride in their job), and cleanliness.

This is not a party resort. It is more for relaxing. But you can get to downtown punta cana in about 15 minutes with a taxi for about $15-20 USD. Downtown has a decent nightlife and you can definitely have a good time. Overall I felt pretty safe and there was plenty of security around.

Last thing.. if you book the Reserve option (overall a nicer experience) it comes with a free excursion. It’s a boat ride to an island where you can do yoga with a professional instructor or just relax on the beach. They provide lunch and the option to go snorkeling. It is definitely worth it as it lasts about 3 hours.

reviews.text: If you are black or not white, I would not recommend staying at this five-star resort. Yes, the hotel looks appealing, but when it comes to customer service, the staff does not seem to prioritize assistance for anyone who is not white. While dining, I have noticed the staff going out of their way to cater to white guests who do not tip them, whereas black guests, despite tipping, have had to flag down staff just to get their attention. I have also observed that none of the white guests left tips, yet the staff continues to go above and beyond for them. This behavior is difficult to understand.

reviews.author: Claudia Curtis
reviews.text:
Our stay at Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana was overall fantastic, and we would absolutely recommend it, with a few small notes for future travelers. We stayed in a garden view room with a patio that led directly to the pool, which was a beautiful and relaxing setup. The room itself was spacious and comfortable, though it would really benefit from a second garbage can (the only one is in the small toilet area) and a few more hooks in the bathroom to hang towels and toiletry bags. Also, the strangest thing of all is - no wash cloths, and only 2 hand towels the whole time. Apparently it’s not common here, I would have packed my own wash cloths if I had known.  The check-in process was exceptionally smooth as we had a private one in the adults only reserve.
We did pop by the regularly check in desk with a question one day and their customer service could be improved—staff had trouble giving clear directions to restaurants and were not especially helpful over the phone when we tried to follow up on a missed call. However, once we settled in, the service throughout the resort more than made up for it. Dining was excellent overall, especially thanks to Wendy at Sarte and Celia at Mina, who went above and beyond to accommodate my severe dairy allergy with care and attention. While not every server was as knowledgeable about allergies, the food itself was outstanding across the property. We particularly loved the beef tacos at Kanna, the fried shrimp at Kicks, and the ribeye and popcorn shrimp at Sarte. The buffet also impressed us with fresh octopus, calamari, omelets, and fantastic burgers. I would caution though they have great little photos on the digital menus to indicate allergies you’re truly on your own to manage it.  One major disappointment, however, was the coffee—despite having a dedicated coffee bar on property, we struggled to find a truly good cup throughout our five-day stay. Given how strong the food scene was, the poor quality of the coffee stood out even more. On the bright side, the pools and landscaping were impeccably maintained every single day, creating a stunning and serene atmosphere. Emmanuel, our concierge, was thoughtful, patient, and incredibly helpful as we navigated the resort, but the true standout of our trip was Yuderi at the  beach. He was attentive, fast, funny, and always one step ahead, making sure we had comfortable Bali beds, fresh cocktails, and even surprised us with our favorite drinks after an afternoon swim. Thanks to people like Emmanuel and especially Yuderi, Paradisus Palma Real was a truly memorable and relaxing getaway.

reviews.text:
A Perfect Family Getaway – Especially for Kids!

We had an absolutely wonderful stay at this hotel, and I can confidently say it was one of the best family vacations we’ve ever had. The hotel itself is beautiful, well-maintained, and offers everything you could hope for in terms of comfort, dining, and relaxation. But what truly made our stay exceptional was the Kidsdom activities team.

From the moment we arrived, the Kidsdom staff went above and beyond to welcome our children with smiles, energy, and a genuine passion for what they do. The activities were creative, engaging, and perfectly tailored to different age groups. Every day our kids woke up excited to see what was in store—from crafts and games to music, dancing, and themed adventures. The team created a fun, safe, and nurturing environment that allowed us as parents to relax knowing our kids were not just entertained, but cared for.

A heartfelt thank you to the amazing Kidsdom team—you turned our trip into something truly special. We’re already looking forward to coming back!

reviews.author: Autry Tysinger Jr
reviews.text:
This was our first trip to the Dominican Republic and our first (and last) stay at a Melia Resort.
First off, the property and beach were beautiful, however that beauty was overshadowed by issue after issue.
Good experiences...Gustavo in Sante is wonderful. Wanda at the Fahrenheit pool bar is fabulous! The 80-minute couples massage that we paid for was excellent. Out therapists Alba and Maria gave us great deep tissue massages.
Issues that occurred during our stay:
•	We had no concierge on Day 1 and part of Day 2. We were told upon check-in that Adriel would be our concierge, and that our luggage would be delivered within the hour.  I had to call the front desk after 2 hours to have them find our luggage. This caused us to miss dinner on Day 1 . The room service food was terrible. How do you mess up a cheeseburger? Melia can do it! Adriel finally contacted us at 9:30pm via WhatsApp on Day 1. We found out he had left at 5:00pm, so there was no way we would have gotten our luggage without me calling and complaining.
•	On Day 1, The shower was not draining.  I messaged Adrial and also called the front desk. This issue was fixed on Day 4. The water flowed out of the shower into our room and into the water closet.  We had to make a dam out of towels when we used the shower.
•	Called the front desk and messaged Adrial about air conditioning on Day 1 not cooling enough. This issue was fixed late on Day 2.
•	Our Minibar was not stocked upon arrival.
•	Had to visit the Reserve lounge on Day 2 to ask for an on-site concierge, because our concierge, Adrial, was not going to be onsite again on Day 2. We got Alam, our 2nd concierge, that gave us a tour that we should have received on Day 1. He said he would make our dinner reservations. My wife had to send Alam a WhatsApp message to remind him about dinner reservations EVERYDAY or else we would have not gotten dinner reservations. We requested dinner reservations be between 6pm-8pm. Only 1 dinner was scheduled between 6pm-8pm. The rest was after 8pm.
•	We received one message about activities the entire stay from our concierges. This was on Day 1 and we did not receive any more. We were supposed to receive a message every morning about the day's activities.
•	On Day 5, Alum told us he was off for the rest of our stay. We were then assigned to Gustavo our 3rd concierge. I didn't think things could have been worse well Gustavo proved that they could.
•	On Day 5 We were told by Gustavo to wait in our room because the manager was coming by to talk to us. We waited over 2 hours and had to get to our 8:30pm dinner reservation. The manager never showed up.
•	On Day 5 the room was not serviced. Green ('Make up room') light was on since breakfast. Had to complain to Gustavo after coming back from our 8:30pm (turned into 9pm) dinner. The room was finally serviced late. The Minibar was not serviced.
•	On Day 6 the concierge manager and the resort manager, Alvaro Fernandez, met with me and my wife on our room's patio. I told them everything. They both agreed that we did not receive the Reserve service that we had paid for and they agreed to talk to upper management about refunding us the Reserve rate minus the regular resort room rate (wo/ concierge service). We thought everything was going to be settled after that, but NO!
•	Day 7: We were checking out and I had not heard from Alvaro. I messaged him on WhatsApp (see attachment). Since we booked through Costco Travel they are basically not honoring the agreement from Day 6. Melia owns the resort, not Costco!
After we returned, we contacted Costco Travel. They reached out to the resort and the resort is now saying that they are not honoring anything talked about with concierge manager and the resort manager, Alvaro Fernandez on Day 6.
My suggestion…if you go to this resort do not upgrade to the concierge or reserve service. I wish we had had concierges like the other guests had. If you get Adriel, Alam, or (God forbid) Gustavo, you need to request someone else.
